Title: Data-analist
Description:
Ben jij iemand die energie krijgt van het vertalen van data naar bruikbare inzichten? Vind je het leuk om informatieproducten te ontwikkelen waarmee collega's betere beslissingen kunnen nemen? Dan is deze functie als Data Analist bij het CIBG iets voor jou.

Wij zijn het CIBG, een uitvoeringsorganisatie van het ministerie van VWS. In het hart van de zorg, met hart voor de zorg. Wij verbinden de werelden van zorgverleners, zorgaanbieders en mensen met een zorgvraag door gegevens te beoordelen, te registreren en te verstrekken. In de vorm van informatie, registraties of vergunningen. Zodat iedereen kan beschikken over de juiste zorginformatie, waar je ook bent en op elk moment.

Het CIBG werkt de komende jaren verder aan het vergroten van de datavolwassenheid van de organisatie. De basis hiervoor is inmiddels gelegd met de inrichting van ons Azure dataplatform en de ontwikkeling van verschillende informatieproducten. Nu zetten we de volgende stap: het verder versterken van onze data-expertise, het vergroten van het data-bewustzijn en het slimmer benutten van data binnen de organisatie. Als Data Analist lever jij hier een belangrijke bijdrage aan.

Je komt te werken binnen de afdeling Publieke Knooppunten en Registers (PKR), waar je samen met collega's werkt aan de ontwikkeling van informatieproducten die waardevolle inzichten bieden aan de organisatie. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen de wensen van gebruikers en de technische oplossing. Je brengt informatiebehoeften in kaart, vertaalt deze naar functionele ontwerpen en ontwikkelt en beheert dashboards en visualisaties waarmee data toegankelijk en begrijpelijk wordt gemaakt.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Data Engineer, Data Scientist en andere collega's om informatieproducten continu te verbeteren. Daarbij denk je actief mee over nieuwe mogelijkheden en zorg je ervoor dat data op een slimme en betrouwbare manier wordt ingezet. Je voelt je thuis in een dynamische en bestuurlijke omgeving, werkt zelfstandig en weet technische vraagstukken te vertalen naar oplossingen die aansluiten bij de behoeften van de organisatie.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden

Inventariseren van de informatiebehoeften van gebruikers en deze vertalen naar functionele en technische ontwerpen.
Ontwikkelen, beheren en doorontwikkelen van dashboards, data visualisaties en andere informatieproducten voor de organisatie.
Opstellen en onderhouden van datamodellen en bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de dataomgeving.
Samenwerken met de Data Engineer en Data Scientist om informatieproducten optimaal aan te laten sluiten op de beschikbare data en technische mogelijkheden.
Adviseren van collega's en stakeholders over de inzet van Business Analytics en het effectief gebruik van dashboards en rapportages.

Deze rol is zowel vanuit onze locatie in Heerlen als vanuit Den Haag in te vullen, waarbij we wel vragen om af en toe op de andere locatie aanwezig te zijn voor overleg of samenwerking.




Dit vragen wij

Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring op het gebied van Business Analytics en/of front-end development.
Je hebt ervaring met Agile werken, bent een proactieve teamspeler en weet resultaten te behalen.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen van informatieproducten, dashboards en data visualisaties in Power BI voor eindgebruikers.
Je vertaalt de informatiebehoefte van stakeholders naar mock-ups en functionele en technische ontwerpen.
Je hebt ervaring met een Azure Analytics-omgeving, Power BI, Microsoft SQL Server en beschikt over aantoonbare kennis van SQL en DAX.
Je bent in staat dimensionele datamodellen te ontwerpen volgens bijvoorbeeld de Kimball- of Data Vault-methodiek en kunt jouw oplossingen helder toelichten aan stakeholders.

Title: Data Analist - Dienstverlening Zorg en Welzijn
Description:
3 redenen waarom dit jouw baan is



Energie krijgen van data met impact Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van data-analyse en rapportage binnen DZW. Jouw inzichten maken het verschil in besluitvorming en verbetering van dienstverlening in een maatschappelijk relevant domein.
Bouwen in plaats van beheren Data gedreven werken binnen DZW is in ontwikkeling. Je krijgt de ruimte om structuren neer te zetten, datakwaliteit te verbeteren en samen met collega’s te werken aan volwassen informatievoorziening.
Floreren in een omgeving met autonomie en samenwerking Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit de business, IT en het management. Je hebt veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid en invloed op de producten die je oplevert, in een cultuur waar samen leren en verbeteren centraal staat.



Jij doet het

Als Data Analist in het zelforganiserende team Data Management ontwikkel je analyses, rapportages en dashboards die direct waarde toevoegen voor DZW. Je levert inzichten die helpen bij sturing, verbetering van processen en verantwoording richting stakeholders in de pgb-keten. Je werkt voor verschillende onderdelen binnen DZW, waaronder Beheer & Ontwikkeling, en draagt bij aan keten-brede vraagstukken.

Je vertaalt complexe data naar heldere inzichten voor management, teams en ketenpartners. Je bouwt en beheert rapportagemodellen die inzicht geven in prestaties, doorlooptijden, kwaliteit en de impact van veranderingen en nieuwe werkstromen. Daarbij werk je actief samen met business en IT om datakwaliteit te verbeteren en eenduidige definities te borgen.

Als teamlid neem je mede verantwoordelijkheid voor de producten, de samenwerking en de doorontwikkeling van data gedreven werken binnen DZW. Je denkt mee over prioriteiten, procesverbetering en de verdere professionalisering van het datadomein. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en waar jouw expertise dus zichtbaar verschil maakt.

MEET THE TEAM 

Wil je eerst nog meer weten, woensdag 7 oktober van 13:00 tot 14:00 uur organiseren wij een vrijblijvende informatiesessie via Teams. Het doel is je een beter beeld te geven van de SVB als werkgever en van de functie van Data Analist bij de Directie Dienstverlening Zorg en Welzijn. 

Aanmelden kan via recruitment@svb.nl (mailto:recruitment@svb.nl) en vermeld in het onderwerp 'Aanmelden Infosessie Data Analist DZW'

Jij bent het

Wat je echt nodig hebt om succesvol te zijn:



HBO+ werk- en denkniveau
Ervaring met data-analyse en het vertalen van data naar bruikbare inzichten
Ervaring met Power BI en SQL
Begrip van databases en datamodellering
Je kunt data helder visualiseren en presenteren voor verschillende doelgroepen
Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal
Je communiceert makkelijk met zowel de business als IT



Wat je meebrengt of snel wilt leren:



Ervaring met data gedreven werken en verbeteren van datakwaliteit
Ervaring met Excel (Power Query; VBA is een pré, geen must)
Kennis van bedrijfsprocessen; ervaring met de PGB-keten is een pré



Zo werk jij

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:



Samenwerken & beïnvloeden: je werkt makkelijk samen met verschillende disciplines en weet mensen mee te nemen in datagedreven werken.
Verandervaardig: je voelt je thuis in een omgeving in ontwikkeling en helpt actief mee om datavolwassenheid te vergroten.
Analytisch & zorgvuldig: je kunt complexe informatie doorgronden en werkt nauwkeurig, zonder te verzanden in details.
Proactief & creatief: je ziet verbeterkansen, neemt initiatief en komt met oplossingen.



Welke kansen bieden we jou?

Jouw uitdaging, balans en groei: het heeft onze aandacht. Kansen en mogelijkheden om te groeien als persoon en als professional zijn er genoeg. Aan jou de taak om ze te pakken. Ook kan jij bij start als Data Analist Dienstverlening Zorg en Welzijn (op basis van een 36-urige werkweek) rekenen op: 



elke maand maximaal € 5.662,00 brutosalaris (fulltime is bij de SVB 36 uur per week).  
16,33% individueel keuzebudget. Jij kiest zelf hoe je dit inzet: wil je bijvoorbeeld meer salaris, een sabbatical, meer pensioen opbouwen of meer verlofdagen? Aan jou de keuze. 
ruim 5 weken vakantie per jaar. 



Er is nog meer. Ga voor een compleet overzicht naar http://www.werkenbijdesvb.nl/vacatures/arbeidsvoorwaarden (http://www.werkenbijdesvb.nl/vacatures/arbeidsvoorwaarden). 

Jouw werkomgeving

Wij zijn de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB), Directie Zorg & Welzijn. In opdracht van het Ministerie van VWS is DZW in nauwe samenwerking met gemeenten en zorgkantoren verantwoordelijk voor het informeren van mensen met een PGB in het kader van de Wlz, de WMO of de Jeugdwet en het toetsen en uitbetalen van hun budgetten. Sinds 2015 is DZW uitvoerder van het trekkingsrecht. Dat maakt dat wij een jonge afdeling zijn in een staande organisatie en daarmee nog volop in ontwikkeling. Er is een collegiale en informele cultuur. Samen zetten wij onze schouders eronder om elke dag beter en slimmer te worden, met tevreden budgethouders als resultaat.

Title: Data Analyst / Data Analytics
Description:
Smartedge Client is looking for an individual to help with their Data Analyst / Data Analytics @ Amsterdam, Netherlands / Hybrid Working




Job Description :




Data Analysts I work on analytics tasks such as reporting, visualization and analysis within the scope of their team. They consult with stakeholders in problem-definition, setting success metrics and shaping the way forward through data insights and effective communication with their audience. Data Analysts I have experience managing stakeholders and can do this largely autonomously (seeking for help in complex scenarios). They prioritize their work for business impact, efficiently adapt to business needs, and manage expectations accordingly. They combine their understanding of the business with the knowledge of data, workflows, methods and tooling to largely autonomously drive analysis and reporting within the scope of their team. They can adapt existing tooling and approaches based on business and user needs. They collaborate with peers in their craft and follow best practices ensuring data quality and stability.




Key Responsibilities:




Responsible for owning the design and delivery of parts of Data Analytics solutions based on business requirements, contributing to bringing them from the initial idea-generation phase to implementation with some supervision.
Responsible for working independently on consuming data, preparing it for analytical use and translating business problems to data stories. Can ask for guidance on more complex tasks.
Responsible for working within the scope of their team and delivering work that informs business decisions for the product / business topic they currently work on.
Responsible for leveraging foundational skills in data analysis and data visualization to answer business questions. They incorporate stakeholder requirements when creating intuitive and insightful visualizations that translate data into actionable insights.
Responsible for connecting and collaborating with stakeholders in operational and project-based roles under the guidance of a manager. Uses effective communication to address their needs and presents data insights in an accessible, business-friendly manner.
Responsible for being flexible in adopting existing internal Data Analytics approaches and expanding their technical competencies when a more efficient way presents itself.
Responsible for growing their own craft skills while leveraging Data Analytics for impact on well defined business problems.
Responsible for supporting junior peers when opportunity presents itself through knowledge sharing and setting a good example.
Responsible for networking and proactively connecting with craft peers beyond the team's scope.
Must be familiar with the larger data ecosystem at client and how it relates to the work they do.
Responsible for connecting with peers in related crafts (ie. Data Engineering) as needed on specific projects to ensure successful outcomes.
Must have high level knowledge about the goals of their area (ie. track / vertical).
Responsible for ensuring quality of their own work by validating it through peer review.




If this sounds like a role you would be interested in or if you know someone in this field.




Connect with me or email me at vineetha.s@smartedgesolutions.co.uk

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Analyst based in Netherlands.

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of the fraud analytics side of a growing user segmentation system.

You’ll analyze behavioral and fraud-related signals to distinguish legitimate users from suspicious activity.

Your work will directly support product decisions, revenue-sharing models, and user verification strategies.

You’ll collaborate closely with product, data, and analytics colleagues to turn insights into practical fraud controls.

Because fraud patterns continuously evolve, you’ll regularly refine detection signals and monitor how effectively segments perform over time.

You’ll also investigate ambiguous cases and identify opportunities to improve review processes and fraud prevention tools.

The role is part of a fast-moving, international environment where analytical thinking and cross-functional collaboration have a direct impact.

Accountabilities


Review and continuously refine fraud signals, adding, removing, and adjusting indicators to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users.
Analyze signals such as IP spoofing, VPN usage, unusual gameplay patterns, and other behavioral indicators to identify potential fraudulent activity.
Own the fraud-related components of the user segmentation system, including defining how signals should be interpreted and monitoring segment performance over time.
Partner with product and data teams to determine appropriate verification approaches for different markets, including facial verification, ID scanning, phone verification, and other methods.
Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases, and identify opportunities to make the review process more efficient and effective.
Identify gaps in available fraud signals and assess third-party tools or solutions that could strengthen the product roadmap.
Translate analytical findings into practical recommendations and operational fraud controls.


Requirements


Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and influence fraud detection or prevention decisions.
Experience designing, refining, or evaluating fraud signals, user segmentation frameworks, detection rules, or review processes.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate complex or ambiguous user behavior using data.
Understanding of how fraud tactics evolve and an interest in continuously adapting detection approaches accordingly.
Ability to collaborate effectively with product, data, and other cross-functional teams to turn analysis into actionable solutions.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to investigations.
Ability to communicate analytical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to participate in meetings, work with documentation, and communicate clearly in a fast-paced international environment.


Benefits


Remote working opportunity within Europe, with Warsaw preferred for collaboration with team members based there.
Opportunity to take ownership of an important fraud analytics function within a growing product area.
Direct exposure to product strategy, user segmentation, fraud prevention, and verification technologies.
Collaboration with experienced product, data, and analytics professionals in an international environment.
Opportunity to influence fraud detection processes and contribute to decisions across multiple markets.
Exposure to evolving fraud patterns, analytical challenges, and emerging verification solutions.
A role where data-driven insights have a direct impact on product and business decisions.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). Title: Senior Business Data Analyst SME Operations
Description:
Als Data Analyst binnen SME Operations help je operationele data om te zetten in inzicht, actie en verbetering. Je werkt nauw samen met operationele teams en stakeholders om businessvraagstukken te begrijpen en te vertalen naar analyses die betere besluitvorming ondersteunen.

Jouw rol als Senior Business Data Analyst SME Operations

Hoewel rapportages en dashboards nog steeds onderdeel zijn van de functie, ligt de nadruk steeds meer op analytics in plaats van op het maken van dashboards. Je identificeert patronen, knelpunten, trends en oorzaken, en helpt SME Operations slimmer en proactiever met data te werken. Daarnaast onderzoek je hoe AI-tools en -technieken kunnen bijdragen aan snellere analyses, betere voorspellingen en efficiëntere manieren van werken.

Je combineert analytisch denkvermogen met businessinzicht: je bent niet alleen geïnteresseerd in wat de data laat zien, maar vooral in wat dit betekent voor operationele prestaties, klantervaring en procesverbetering. Binnen KPN SME Operations werk je mee aan het verbeteren van service, efficiëntie en klantresultaten door betere sturing en meer inzicht. Je maakt deel uit van een team dat de operatie helpt te groeien van beschrijvende rapportages naar voorspellende en diagnostische analytics.

Je werkt samen met collega’s uit de operatie, procesmanagement en andere data- en transformatieteams om inzicht te creëren in prestaties en verbetermogelijkheden. Jouw werk draagt bij aan besluitvorming over volumes, capaciteit, productiviteit, kwaliteit, klantreisprestaties en operationele effectiviteit. Daarnaast help je mee aan het verder professionaliseren van de analytics-capaciteit binnen SME Operations door data-analyse, automatisering, storytelling en AI-ondersteunde inzichten te combineren.

Bij KPN geloven we in samenwerking, eigenaarschap en continue verbetering. Door verschillende perspectieven en expertise samen te brengen, creëren we betere inzichten en betere resultaten voor onze klanten en collega’s. Binnen SME Operations speelt data een belangrijke rol in het verbeteren van service, het verminderen van complexiteit en het ondersteunen van betere besluitvorming. Deze functie is een belangrijke schakel in die ontwikkeling.

Onze focusgebieden


Analyse van operationele prestaties
Trend- en root cause-analyses
Forecasting en capaciteitsinzichten
Verbetering van processen en klantreizen
Automatisering van terugkerende analyses en rapportages
AI-ondersteunde analytics en inzichtgeneratie
Datakwaliteit en consistentie
Heldere en actiegerichte managementinformatie


Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden


Analyseren van operationele prestaties, trends en afwijkingen binnen SME Operations
Vertalen van businessvragen naar data-analyse en bruikbare inzichten
Ontwikkelen, onderhouden en verbeteren van rapportages en dashboards waar nodig
De focus verschuiven van handmatige rapportage naar geautomatiseerde en inzichtgedreven analytics
Signaleren van oorzaken, knelpunten en verbetermogelijkheden in operationele processen
Gebruikmaken van AI-tools en -methoden ter ondersteuning van analyse, samenvatting en patroonherkenning
Samenwerken met stakeholders om de juiste KPI’s en managementinformatie te definiëren
Bevindingen helder en overtuigend presenteren aan operationele en managementdoelgroepen
Verbeteren van datakwaliteit, rapportageconsistentie en analytische betrouwbaarheid
Bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van een datagedreven cultuur binnen SME Operations


Je werkt met tools en methoden zoals: Power BI, Excel, SQL, Python, AI-ondersteunde analysetools, Databricks of vergelijkbare analyticsplatformen, en automatiserings- en workflowtools.

Dit is je team

De afdeling Service en Delivery: SME Operations, biedt een inspirerende werkomgeving met volop ruimte voor innovatieve ideeën, creativiteit en feedback – allemaal met als doel onze klanten op de meest efficiënte manier de beste service te bieden. Je komt terecht in een dynamisch en leerzaam team, binnen een Operations-afdeling van ongeveer 200 collega’s.

Wat breng

jij ons?

Jij hebt:


Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in data-analyse, business intelligence of operationele analyse.
Uitstekende SQL-vaardigheden voor het extraheren, transformeren en analyseren van data.
Ruime ervaring met BI- en datavisualisatietools zoals Tableau, Power BI of vergelijkbare platforms.
Aantoonbare expertise in statistische analyse, datamodellering, databasebeheer en datawarehousing-concepten.
Gedegen kennis van operationele processen en supply chain- of logistiek management.
Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met het vermogen complexe data te vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten voor zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.
Uitstekende communicatie- en presentatievaardigheden en gevorderde kennis van Microsoft Excel voor data-analyse en rapportage.
Zelfstandig kunnen werken, meerdere projecten tegelijk kunnen managen en beschikken over sterke organisatorische, tijdmanagement- en detailgerichte vaardigheden.
Je hebt een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (C1/C2)


Bij voorkeur:


Ervaring als vakspecialist op het gebied van bedrijfsvoering of analyse
Bekendheid met projectmanagementmethodieken en -tools
Ervaring met Python of R voor gegevensanalyse en automatisering


Wat krijg je

van ons?

Natuurlijk hebben we als werkgever jou ook veel te bieden. Dit krijg je van ons:


Een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal € 5216,- en maximaal € 7843,- afhankelijk van je werkervaring, op basis van 40 uur exclusief 8% vakantiegeld
Vaste 13e maand, een deel krijg je maandelijks uitbetaald en een deel in januari van het volgende jaar. Óf je zet het in voor een FLEX & BOOST doel naar keuze! Klik hier om er meer over te lezen
Jaarlijks een individuele en collectieve verhoging conform onze CAO
€ 1500 per jaar aan inzetbaarheidsbudget dat je naar eigen inzicht mag gebruiken voor bijvoorbeeld trainingen, coaching en cursussen
Flexibele vrije dagen: onze collega’s mogen zelf (in samenspraak met de manager) bepalen hoe zij met verlof omgaan
Een goede werk-privé balans (zoals 2 dagen kantoor, 3 dagen thuis, transitieverlof, feestdagwissel naar een feestdag van jouw religieuze of culturele voorkeur)
Thuiswerkshop om je werkplek thuis optimaal in te kunnen richten, uiteraard met een mobiele telefoon & laptop
50% korting op onze producten en diensten, zodat je voordelig kunt internetten, bellen én streamen
Goede reiskostenvergoeding: je krijgt je OV kosten volledig vergoed of € 0,23 per kilometer als je met de auto reist. Kom je liever op de fiets? Dan kun je aanspraak maken op onze fietsvergoeding € 0,40 per kilometer
Mogelijkheid tot het aanschaffen van een leasefiets waar KPN maandelijks aan meebetaalt (bij onbepaalde tijd contract): Van stadsfiets tot e-bike en van racefiets tot speed-pedelec; jij kiest waar je op fietst
Uitstekende pensioenvoorwaarden: een totale inleg van 25% van je pensioengevende salaris waarvan KPN 17,5% inlegt en jij 7,5%


Ons geloof in technologie is groot. Dit wordt nóg krachtiger samen met menselijk contact, daarom ontmoeten we je graag!

Wil je meer weten? Neem contact op met onze recruiter Carlotta via carlotta.markink@kpn.com.

Bij KPN hebben we recruitmenttalent dat slim samenwerkt en zo wint. Daarom wordt acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature niet gewaardeerd.

Title: Revenue Operations Analyst
Description:
Join us at Entrust 

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely. 

  

Get to Know Us 

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future. 

Revenue Operations Analyst (Data Analytics and KPIs)

Position Overview

The Revenue Operations Analyst will play a pivotal role in driving data-driven decision-making and operational efficiency across our revenue teams. This individual will focus on analyzing, visualizing, and interpreting complex datasets to create actionable insights, define and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and enhance the overall optimization of revenue-generating processes.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, the Analyst will collaborate with key stakeholders in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Revenue Operations to ensure alignment across the entire revenue lifecycle. This role requires a high level of analytical expertise, strong attention to detail, and a proven ability to translate data insights into actionable strategies.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and manage dashboards, performance reports, and analytics related to core revenue KPIs, including pipeline health, sales velocity, customer acquisition cost, net revenue retention, and other key business metrics.
Perform deep-dive analyses to evaluate trends, identify opportunities, and address challenges in revenue operations.
Collaborate with internal departments (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance) to gather and centralize operational data for comprehensive analysis.
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of data reports by maintaining strong data governance processes across relevant platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
Work with leadership teams to define and standardize KPIs that align with corporate objectives.
Provide data-driven recommendations to optimize go-to-market strategies, streamline processes, and improve team performance.
Support forecasting and scenario planning efforts by identifying trends and insights from historical data.
Assist in ongoing revenue strategy projects, including pricing optimization, territory modeling, and customer segmentation.


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s Degree in a quantitative field (Business Administration, Economics, Finance, etc.).
Demonstrated experience (2-4 years) in data analytics, business intelligence, or revenue operations.
Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
Self-starter with a proactive attitude and the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Preferred Qualifications


Strong analytical mindset with experience in SQL, R, Python, or other analytical tools for large-scale data analysis.
Proven experience creating and managing reliable KPI dashboards and real-time reporting frameworks.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex data insights to non-technical audiences.


At Entrust, we don’t just offer jobs – we offer career journeys. Here is what you can expect when you join our team: 


Career Growth: Whether you’re a budding developer or a seasoned expert, we’re invested in your professional journey. With learning-forward initiatives and exciting challenges, your growth is our priority. 
Flexibility: Life is all about balance. Whether you’re remote, hybrid, or on-site, we offer flexible options that fit your lifestyle. 
Collaboration: Here, your voice matters. Our teams thrive on sharing ideas, brainstorming solutions, and working together to build a better tomorrow. 


We believe in securing identities—but it doesn’t stop there. At Entrust, we’re passionate about valuing all identities. Our culture is built on diversity, inclusion, and respect. From unconscious bias training for our leaders to global affinity groups that connect colleagues across the globe, we’re creating a community where everyone is encouraged to be themselves. 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

If you’re excited by the prospect of innovating, growing your career, and collaborating in a dynamic environment, Entrust is the place for you. Join us in making a difference. Let’s build a more secure world—together. 

  

Apply today! 

For more information, visit www.entrust.com.  Follow us on, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube

Title: Data analist regionale werkgelegenheid
Description:
Wil jij meewerken aan het maken van belangrijke statistieken over de arbeidsmarkt? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog!

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Je werkt samen met drie collega’s aan het samenstellen van de statistiek over de regionale werkgelegenheid. We vragen via een enquête aan bedrijven met verschillende vestigingen naar het aantal werkzame personen per vestiging en/of gemeente.

Je verwerkt, beoordeelt en corrigeert, waar nodig, de enquêtegegevens die bedrijven aanleveren. Je neemt contact op met bedrijven als de verstrekte gegevens daartoe aanleiding geven.

Je analyseert de gegevens per bedrijfstak en per gemeente. Daarna stel je tabellen samen met informatie over regionale werkgelegenheid. Het CBS publiceert deze informatie elk jaar.

Je werkt mee aan verbeteringen in het werkproces en de programmatuur van de statistieken waaraan je werkt.

We leiden je op tot een breed inzetbare analist die ook aan andere statistieken van het team Arbeidsmarkt kan bijdragen.

Je toekomstige collega's

Team Arbeidsmarkt maakt statistieken over de arbeidsmarkt van werknemers en bestaat uit ruim 25 gemotiveerde medewerkers.

Het Team Bestaat Uit Drie Clusters


Een cluster verwerkt de polisadministratie; de registratie waarin informatie over elke baan in Nederland is opgenomen.
Een cluster maakt statistieken op basis van de polisadministratie.
Een cluster maakt statistieken over cao-lonen, vacatures, ziekteverzuim, vakbondsleden, stakingen en regionale werkgelegenheid. Dit is het cluster waarin de vacature ontstaat.


Daarnaast werken we samen met andere teams aan projecten voor externe opdrachtgevers, zoals ministeries en het UWV. Daarbij gaat het om onderzoeken zoals de Monitor loonverschillen m/v en Vaardig met vaardigheden.

Dit ben jij


Je hebt een aantoonbaar hbo-werk- en -denkniveau.
Je vindt het leuk om data te verwerken en te analyseren. Het is een pluspunt als je al werkt met IT-tools voor data-analyse, zoals SQL, R en/of Python.
Je werkt nauwkeurig en resultaatgericht, bent in staat om zelfstandig je eigen werk te plannen en te organiseren en kunt goed wisselen tussen werkzaamheden.
Je communiceert professioneel, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, met berichtgevers. Daarbij stem je toon en inhoud zorgvuldig af op de situatie.
Je hebt affiniteit met het inhoudelijke werkterrein van het team.


Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:


Een salaris van minimaal € 3579,- en maximaal € 4999,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.
8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. In totaal is dit 16,5% bovenop je salaris. Dit noemen wij het Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Je bepaalt zelf hoe, wanneer en op welke manier je dit budget wilt inzetten.
Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP Pensioenfonds.
Een laptop (Microsoft of Apple) en mobiele telefoon (Android of iOS).
Twee tot drie dagen thuiswerken, de rest ben je aanwezig in ons onlangs gerenoveerde gebouw. In je team maak je daar verder afspraken over.


Kom werken aan de feiten

We sluiten de vacature op zondag 11 oktober.

De selectie vindt plaats in de week van maandag 12 oktober.

Title: Senior Data Analyst Advertising
Description:
How do you help bol make better decisions?

Bol.com continuously advances its platform to create a better tomorrow for over 13 million customers and 50,000+ trading partners. Our advertising business plays an increasingly important role in that ambition — and increasingly, so does the clarity with which we can explain how it's performing. As a Senior Data Analyst, you're the person leadership and key stakeholders turn to when they need to understand not just what the numbers say, but what to do about it.

The biggest challenge

Advertising via bol keeps growing, and so does the complexity of explaining why. Revenue moves, but the story behind the movement often doesn't move with it. Is display underperforming, or is the market shifting? Is a driver structural, or a one-off? As a senior analyst you own that story end-to-end: framing the right question, building the analysis that answers it, and staying in the room until the answer actually changes how the business acts. AI is fast taking over the repetitive parts of this work like dashboarding or descriptive questions, freeing you to spend more time on the analysis and the room, not less.

What you'll do as a Senior Data Analyst – Business Analytics

You'll join 20+ analysts in bol's Advertising Analytics team, working closely with internal stakeholders — Leadership, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Business Development. Within the Business Analytics sub-team, we aim to be the steering model of the advertising via bol department. We shape the strategy, explain performance and guide execution of core initiatives.

In practice:


Own analyses end-to-end: from framing an ambiguous business question with a stakeholder to shipping the analysis and staying involved until it changes a decision
Build and maintain driver trees and financial narratives that explain how advertising revenue moves, and why
Dive deep into the performance of our advertising propositions, developing domain expertise stakeholders come to rely on
Apply causal inference, statistical, or econometric methods where correlation isn't good enough — and recognize when it isn't needed
Use AI to eliminate the low-value repetitive parts of your work, and reinvest that time into deeper analysis and stakeholder engagement
Coach junior analysts on problem framing, technical craft, and operating as a genuine analytical partner rather than an order-taker
Write clean, reusable SQL and Python that scales and solves genuine problems


Why you can make a difference

You have 4+ years of hands-on analytics experience, SQL and Python are second nature, and you know how to turn a messy question into a shipped answer. Here's the thing: we're looking for a rounded profile. Some analysts are tech-savy; comfortable with causal inference, econometrics and our full tech stack. Others are strongest on the domain and ownership side: real retail media domain knowledge, end-to-end ownership, staying until insights actually land, coaching junior analysts, and using AI to buy back capacity for higher-value work. You can have a spike on one of them, but we want a minimum level for both.

Where you'll be working

You'll join an international group of 20+ analytics professionals in bol's Advertising Analytics team, working with key stakeholders across leadership, finance, sales, marketing and business development. You will be part of the Business Analytics team. We are the internal-facing arm. You won’t talk to advertisers directly, but you will collaborate with colleagues that decide where our advertising business will go next. Your goal is to help our Retail Media business make sharper decisions. You'll find a mix of colleagues that share a low tolerance for dashboard-and-move-on work: everyone here is expected to own the question, not just answer it. We all bring something special to the table and expect the same of you.

Something for you?


Story finder: You don't stop at "revenue is down." You keep digging until you can say why, and what to do about it.
Insight activator: Your definition of done isn't a dashboard or a deck. It's the moment a stakeholder makes a better decision because of something you surfaced.
Driven mentor: You make the analysts around you sharper. Not by telling them what to do, but by teaching them how to think.


Nothing for you?


Dashboard deliverer: You've built some visually stunning dashboards in your career. Which is how you measure their impact.
Lone analyst: Stakeholder management distracts from the real work. You'd rather just interact with data.
Comfort zone cartographer: You've mastered a solid analytics stack and see no compelling reason to stretch into causal thinking or deeper stakeholder ownership.


We take pride in our B Corp certification and strive for continuous improvement every day. Our annual bonus is tied to sustainability goals, and we are committed to equality and equal opportunities for all.Perks of having a blue heart


29 days: to recharge
Travel costs: Public transport, car, parking & charging covered
Pension plan: 75% premium covered
Annual bonus: Based on sustainability goals

Title: Digital Analyst
HTML:
Turn B2C data into sharper journeys, smarter trading and stronger growth.

Lijnden | B2C (Ecommerce, IT, UX & Online Merchandising) | 40 hours | Full-time

At Just Brands, we build menswear brands with character. PME Legend, Cast Iron and Vanguard each have their own voice, their own audience and their own place in the market. In B2C, growth is shaped by thousands of decisions across ecommerce, retail, CRM, digital marketing, site merchandising, site experience, IT, UX and marketplaces.

The challenge is not having more data. The challenge is knowing what matters, what it means and what to do next. That is where ecommerce performance, customer behaviour, trading insights and business intelligence come together.

But what really sets us apart is how we work together.

We’re team first. No ego, no unnecessary layers, no endless talking, no corporate theatre. We back each other, speak up, take ownership and keep pushing for better. We work hard, stay sharp and make sure there’s room to enjoy the ride too.

That’s where you jump onboard.

Why this role matters

This is where ecommerce analytics, B2C performance and digital decision-making become commercial impact. As our Ecommerce Performance Analyst, you support data-driven decision-making across all B2C channels: Retail, E-Commerce, Digital Marketing & CRM, Site Merchandising, Site Experience, IT & UX and Marketplaces.

You collect, analyse and interpret data to generate actionable insights that improve performance, customer experience and operational efficiency. You help teams understand what is happening, why it is happening and which actions will create better results. You are not here to build dashboards that quietly gather dust.

You are here to turn B2C data into decisions that teams trust, use and act on.

What you’ll do

  • Support data-driven decision-making across all B2C channels, including Retail, E-Commerce, Digital Marketing & CRM, Site Merchandising, Site Experience, IT & UX and marketplaces;
  • Collect, analyze and interpret data to generate actionable insights that improve performance, customer experience and operational efficiency;
  • Build, maintain and improve dashboards for ecommerce performance, customer behavior, campaign performance, trading, funnel performance and channel results;
  • Design forecasting tools to anticipate customer behavior, sales trends, demand patterns and commercial opportunities;
  • Provide performance analytics to senior stakeholders, supporting decision-making and P&L accountability across online channels;
  • Lead department-wide projects that improve data collection, data integration and financial insight generation across B2C operations;
  • Analyze ecommerce KPIs such as revenue, conversion rate, traffic quality, average order value, margin, retention, customer lifetime value, funnel drop-off and product/category performance;
  • Translate data into clear recommendations for Ecommerce, CRM, Digital Marketing, Site Merchandising, Retail, Marketplaces, UX and IT;
  • Monitor digital marketing and CRM performance across paid media, email, automation flows, campaign traffic and customer segments;
  • Support ecommerce trading rhythms with weekly and monthly insights on what is selling, what is slowing down and where commercial opportunities sit;
  • Analyze customer journeys and identify friction points across web shops, apps, landing pages, checkout, content and onsite experience;
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation, including test setup, measurement, analysis and learnings;
  • Improve data quality, tracking consistency, reporting definitions and governance across B2C;
  • Help teams understand the story behind the numbers by presenting insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What success looks like in your first year

  • B2C teams use your dashboards and insights in weekly and monthly decision rhythms;
  • Ecommerce, CRM, marketing, site experience and marketplace teams make better decisions based on trusted data;
  • You identify conversion, trading or customer journey opportunities that lead to measurable business improvements;
  • Forecasting becomes sharper and helps teams anticipate sales trends, customer behavior and commercial risks;
  • Data collection and integration improve, reducing noise, manual work and reporting confusion;
  • Senior stakeholders receive clearer performance analytics that support P&L ownership and better prioritization;
  • A/B tests and experiments create learnings that change how we build campaigns, pages and customer journeys.

What makes this role exciting

  • You work across the full B2C ecosystem: ecommerce, retail, CRM, digital marketing, marketplaces, site experience, UX and IT;
  • You sit close to revenue, conversion, customer behaviour, trading performance and P&L decisions;
  • You influence both commercial performance and customer experience for three strong menswear brands;
  • You work on dashboards, forecasting, experimentation and strategic B2C projects;
  • You help shape how a growing international business becomes more data-driven;
  • You turn scattered data into clear direction, which is where the magic gets wonderfully operational.

You’ll probably love this role if you…

  • enjoy turning messy data into clear direction and practical next steps;
  • like investigating why performance changes, not just reporting that it changed;
  • understand that good analytics is part numbers, part business sense and part storytelling;
  • get energy from working with ecommerce, marketing, CRM, UX, IT and marketplace teams;
  • care about both performance and customer experience;
  • prefer impact over perfection and want your work to change decisions.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, Ecommerce or a related field;
  • 5+ years of experience in ecommerce analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, performance analysis or B2C data analysis;
  • Strong knowledge of ecommerce KPIs: conversion rate, revenue, AOV, traffic quality, margin, retention, CLV, funnel drop-off and product/category performance;
  • Strong experience with GA4, SQL, Excel and Power BI or Tableau;
  • Experience building dashboards, reporting structures and forecasting models;
  • Experience with digital marketing analytics, CRM analytics, campaign performance and customer journey analysis;
  • Experience with A/B testing, experimentation, CRO or UX analytics is a strong plus;
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect commercial, financial and customer data;
  • Comfortable working with cross-functional teams in a fast-moving retail or ecommerce environment;
  • Strong communication skills: you can explain insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Fluent English; Dutch or German is a plus.

What Just Brands is really like

We’re team first. In B2C, that means we challenge assumptions with data, keep conversations sharp and turn insight into action. No ego. Just practical collaboration, honest decisions and a team that likes improving what actually matters.

You’ll Join a Company Where

  • People help each other out;
  • Ideas and people matter more than job titles;
  • Hard work matters, and so does enjoying the ride;
  • If something can be better, we improve it.

What you get

  • Salary depending on experience and background;
  • End-of-year bonus equal to one gross monthly salary;
  • Healthy and varied lunch every day;
  • Exclusive access to our own Gym, including classes such as boxing, yoga and padel;
  • Parties and drinks that will be talked about for years to come;
  • Staff discount on our clothing.

Ready to turn ecommerce performance data into decisions that change results?

Still reading? Good sign.

If you want to work close to ecommerce, CRM, marketing, marketplaces, customer behaviour and real commercial decisions, this could be your next step.

Ready to apply?

Title: Commercial Analyst
Description:
Position Title:Commercial Analyst

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 44045

In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.

About The Role.

McCain feeds the world — from the fries in your favorite restaurant to the snacks in your freezer. Behind every commercial decision we make sits a question only data can answer: Where are we winning? Where are we losing? What should we do next? That's the work of this role.

You'll be the analytics partner to our QSR channel team, supporting the largest customer relationships in global foodservice. You’ll have access to our syndicated data, and rely on your creativity and skills to source new data. Your dashboards and analyses won't sit on a shelf; they'll shape how we work with customers, set targets, and place bets for the years ahead.

What You’ll Be Doing.


Sit with QSR sales leads to understand their growth plans, then build the data products (dashboards, deep-dives, scorecards) that let them track and act on those plans week to week.
Stitch together internal data (Salesforce, SAP, Databricks) with syndicated sources (Datassential, Technomic, Circana/NielsenIQ) to answer questions.
Design semantic models in Power BI that hold up under real stakeholder use — clean DAX, performant Power Query, and reporting that people genuinely return to.
Draw on field and customer conversations to bring broader context to the analysis, so the story explains not just what happened but why
Lead the evaluation and onboarding of new third-party data sources when the existing stack can't answer the question.
Partner with IT and other Commercial Analytics teams so the solutions you build plug into the broader McCain data ecosystem rather than becoming one-off islands.
Translate analysis into story — the kind that lands in a customer meeting, not just a quarterly review.


What You’ll Need To Be Successful.


3+ years in a data analyst, BI developer, or commercial analytics role, working directly with sales, customer, or commercial datasets.
Power BI at a builder level — you've designed and maintained semantic models that other people depend on, not only consumed dashboards someone else built.
Strong DAX — comfortable writing time intelligence, iterators, and context-aware measures; can diagnose and fix a slow or incorrect calculation.
Data modeling fundamentals — star schema, fact/dimension design, handling slowly changing data, and knowing when to push logic upstream vs. into the model.
Comfort working across multiple source systems (Salesforce, SAP, Databricks) and a bias toward fixing data quality at the source rather than patching it in the visual layer.
Experience with AI development tools and comfort using GPT tools to write and debug code
Commercial business acumen — you can translate a stakeholder's vague ask ("we want to understand the customer better") into a concrete analytical plan, and you push back when the data won't support the conclusion they're hoping for.
Communication and data storytelling — you can present an analysis to non-technical leaders, defend the methodology, and make the "so what" land.
Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline — or equivalent demonstrated experience.
Preferred / strong plus
SQL — can read, write, and validate queries independently (joins, window functions, CTEs). You use it to check whether the data is telling the truth before publishing a report.
Experience in CPG, retail, or foodservice — especially supporting a QSR, grocery, or large-customer channel.
Hands-on work with syndicated industry data: Datassential, Technomic, Circana (IRI), NielsenIQ, or similar foodservice panels.
Working knowledge of Salesforce, SAP (ECC or S/4HANA), and Databricks — or comparable enterprise source systems and lakehouse platforms.
Experience working in a global or matrixed organization, with comfort navigating multiple stakeholders across regions and functions.
Exposure to Python or PySpark for data prep and analysis beyond what Power Query handles efficiently.
Familiarity with version control (Git), Power BI deployment pipelines, or other practices that bring engineering discipline to BI work.
Knowledge of the UK / European retail or foodservice landscape.

Benefits Of The Role.


Real customers, real decisions. You're not building reports for the sake of it. The QSR channel is one of McCain's most strategic, and your work is read by our top leaders.
Scope to build, not just maintain. This isn't a ticket-queue analyst role. You'll have room to choose tools, propose new data sources, and shape how we measure commercial performance in GB&I and Europe.
A data team that takes the craft seriously. You'll join a Global Commercial Analytics function that invests in modern tooling (Power BI, Databricks), values clean semantic modeling, and treats analysts as partners to the business — not order-takers.

Title: CMNL - Data Analyst (Social)
HTML:
DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

At DEPT®, we believe the best social work happens where creativity, culture and data come together. We create social-first campaigns and always-on content for brands such as bol, Ziggo, Nikon and Praxis. As our client portfolio continues to grow, so does the need to make smarter, faster and more informed decisions. That's where you come in.

Job Purpose

As a Social Data Analyst, you'll help shape the future of social by turning data into actionable insights. You'll work closely with strategists, creatives and community managers to uncover opportunities, measure impact and continuously optimise our work.

You'll become the go-to expert for social performance, helping both our teams and our clients understand what drives results and, more importantly, why.

Whether it's analysing campaign performance, building dashboards, conducting competitive audits or uncovering emerging trends, your insights will directly influence creative and strategic decisions.

As our Social Data Analyst, you'll help us:

  • Build a more data-driven way of working.
  • Deliver stronger reporting and actionable insights.
  • Improve both paid and organic social performance.
  • Strengthen creative and strategic decision-making.
  • Elevate our new business pitches with high-quality social audits and competitive analysis.
  • Increase efficiency by allowing creatives and strategists to focus on what they do best.
  • Scale our social offering as we continue to grow.


In short: better insights lead to better content, stronger strategies and better business results.

What You'll Do

  • Analyse paid and organic social performance across multiple clients and platforms;
  • Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable recommendations;
  • Build and maintain reporting dashboards and performance frameworks;
  • Conduct social audits and competitive analyses to support new business pitches;
  • Identify audience, platform and content trends that can strengthen client strategies;
  • Partner with strategists and creatives to optimise content based on performance insights;
  • Define and monitor the KPIs that truly matter for each client;
  • Support quarterly business reviews and client presentations with data-driven storytelling;
  • Continuously improve how we measure social success across DEPT®.


What You Bring

  • 2–5 years of experience in social analytics, digital analytics or performance marketing;
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and their metrics (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Pinterest, etc.);
  • Experience with reporting tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau;
  • Comfortable working with platform analytics and social listening tools like Brandwatch & Emplifi;
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate numbers into compelling stories;
  • Experience conducting competitor analysis and identifying market opportunities;
  • Excellent communication skills, you can explain data to both specialists and non-specialists;
  • Curious, proactive and always looking for ways to improve;
  • Located and directly available to start working from our offices in the Netherlands;
  • Full working proficiency in Dutch and English.


WE OFFER

  • A flexible, hybrid working policy (2-3 days from the office, depending on location) and the opportunity to work from abroad for 13 weeks a year.
  • 24 vacation days per year and the possibility to buy an unlimited number of extra vacation days.
  • DEPT®/YOU Learning Menu and DEPT®/YOU Special Programs. Develop your skills with courses and programs tailored to your needs.
  • Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, gym and wellness discounts, and healthy lunches at the office.
  • Get a discount on your lease bike and ride in style. You can also enjoy hassle free-commutes with an NS Business Card.
  • A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021, has been named a Great Place To Work since 2022 in the Netherlands and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
  • Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
  • You can discover even more employee benefits here.


WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

Title: Data Analist
HTML:
Data Analist in Groep Business Control team

✓ Hybride werken | ✓ 25 vakantiedagen | ✓ Veel vrijheid & verantwoordelijkheid | ✓ Opleidingen & ontwikkeling | ✓ Sterk groeiende organisatie

Jij maakt van data betrouwbare stuurinformatie. Wij zorgen dat jij de ruimte krijgt om impact te maken.

Krijg jij energie van data die écht iets vertelt? En vind je het leuk om niet alleen cijfers inzichtelijk te maken, maar ook mee te denken over wat ze betekenen voor de organisatie? Als Data Analist bij VDK Groep zorg jij ervoor dat we steeds slimmer gebruikmaken van onze data.

Je brengt structuur aan, ontwikkelt dashboards en KPI’s en helpt collega’s om op basis van betrouwbare informatie de juiste beslissingen te nemen. Je werkt binnen het Group Business Control team en bevind je precies op het snijvlak finance en data. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken, te verbeteren en verder te bouwen aan datagedreven werken binnen VDK.

Over VDK Groep

VDK Groep is een sterk groeiende organisatie in de installatietechniek met een duidelijke buy-and-buildstrategie, gecombineerd met autonome groei. VDK Groep bestaat inmiddels uit meer dan 150 zelfstandig opererende bedrijven in binnen- en buitenland. Met ruim 7.000 vakmensen zijn we actief in Nederland, Duitsland, België, Zweden, Oostenrijk en Zwitserland en realiseren we gezamenlijk meer dan € 2 miljard omzet.

Onze bedrijven opereren zelfstandig binnen de groep. Daarmee combineren we lokaal ondernemerschap en korte lijnen met de kennis, mogelijkheden en slagkracht van een grotere organisatie. Binnen VDK zijn vrijwel alle specialismen op het gebied van installatietechniek vertegenwoordigd.

Onze peoplefocus komt terug in drie kernwaarden: #sfeermeesterschap, #ondernemerschap en #rentmeesterschap.

Binnen het Group Business Control team werken we aan steeds betere inzichten in onze organisatie. Door de groei van VDK neemt ook de hoeveelheid beschikbare data toe. Daarmee groeit de behoefte aan betrouwbare stuurinformatie, slimme dashboards en analyses die ons helpen om betere beslissingen te nemen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Analist ben jij de schakel tussen ruwe data en bruikbare stuurinformatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat data uit verschillende bronnen op de juiste manier wordt gestructureerd, opgeschoond en gekoppeld. Vervolgens vertaal je deze informatie naar overzichtelijke dashboards, KPI’s en analyses waar de organisatie daadwerkelijk mee verder kan.

Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de cijfers. Je onderzoekt waar opvallende ontwikkelingen vandaan komen, signaleert trends en helpt collega’s om de juiste inzichten uit de beschikbare data te halen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Structureren, mappen, opschonen en beheren van data uit verschillende bronnen;
  • Meedenken over en zorgdragen voor één betrouwbare versie van de waarheid (one version of the truth) voor data uit verschillende systemen;
  • Bewaken en verbeteren van de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van data;
  • Ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van BI-dashboards en rapportages;
  • Opstellen van nieuwe KPI’s die aansluiten bij de informatiebehoefte binnen VDK;
  • Uitvoeren van analyses en vertalen van uitkomsten naar concrete inzichten;
  • Signaleren van trends, afwijkingen en kansen binnen de beschikbare data;
  • Meedenken over het slimmer en efficiënter inrichten van dataprocessen;
  • Ondersteunen bij het dataonderdeel van de onboarding van bedrijven binnen VDK Groep.

Je bent onderdeel van het Groep Business Controller team. Samen bepaal je welke informatie nodig is om goed te kunnen sturen en zorg je ervoor dat bijvoorbeeld accounts en KPI’s op de juiste manier worden verwerkt in dashboards. Tegelijkertijd werk je nauw samen met onze data engineers, die verantwoordelijk zijn voor het ophalen en beschikbaar maken van de data.

Wat breng jij mee?

Je bent analytisch sterk en vindt het belangrijk dat data klopt. Tegelijkertijd ben je niet iemand die alleen achter een scherm naar cijfers kijkt. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op, stelt vragen en wilt begrijpen waarom bepaalde informatie nodig is.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van Business Analytics, Bedrijfskunde, Finance & Control, Business IT & Management, Data Science of een vergelijkbare opleiding;
  • Ervaring in een data en finance gerelateerde functie, bijvoorbeeld als Data Analist, Business Analist, Reporting Analist, FP&A, of BI Consultant;
  • Ervaring met datamapping en het opschonen en modelleren van data;
  • Ervaring met het bouwen en doorontwikkelen van BI-dashboards;
  • Een goede beheersing van Excel en ervaring met databewerking;

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Coop Sverige – Together we make food-Sweden sustainable

At Coop, data plays an increasingly important role in how we understand our customers, improve our operations and make better decisions. With over 4 million members and data across stores, logistics and digital channels, we have both the scale and the opportunity to create real impact. To add to this, our data platform runs on an architecture suitable for providing agentic analytics!

Within our AI & Business Intelligence organization, we have built a modern analytics platform that we are proud of – and we are now looking for a Senior Data Analyst to help us turn even more of that data into action.

Om Tjänsten

You will join our Analytics team within AI & Business Intelligence, working closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and stakeholders across Coop.

As a Data Analyst, you sit at the intersection of technology and business. The role is not only about answering questions with data, but understanding the problem behind the question, challenging assumptions and determining what we should actually do with the insight.

You will have considerable freedom in how you approach problems. We believe in building reusable, scalable solutions in code rather than repeatedly solving the same problem manually.

What You Will Do


Translate business challenges into analytical questions, solutions and recommendations aid all of Coop in decision making
Work with large datasets across customer behaviour, sales, assortment, logistics and digital channels and develop scalable and reusable solutions with any too you see fitting the purpose.
Build analytical agents, dashboards, ad hoc analyses or any other data product that democratizes our data.
Challenge existing questions and ways of working – moving from “can you analyse this?” towards “this is what we should do.”


Who are you?

We believe you enjoy operating at the intersection of data, technology and business. You are curious enough to dig into the details, but can also step back and understand the bigger picture.

You don't see an analysis as finished when the numbers are correct – you want to understand what they mean and what action they should lead to. You are comfortable taking ownership even when the path forward is not completely defined.

We believe that you


Have experience turning business needs into analytical questions and solutions.
Are comfortable programming in SQL and Python, with experience of PySpark or similar technologies and have experience working with version control, such as Git.
Have strong business understanding and can connect analytical findings to concrete actions and can communicate this effectively with any audience.
Understand fundamental statistical methods and when different analytical approaches are appropriate.


It’s meritorious if you


Have experience from a modern cloud-based data platform or Lakehouse environment.
Have worked with providing agentic analysis, analytics engineering, BI tools or code-first analytical workflows.
Have worked in a scale-up, technology company, consultancy or another environment where broad ownership is expected.
Have experience from retail, e-commerce or another data-intensive consumer business.


About Us

The grocery trade is a stable, long-term industry, and Coop’s offering is essential to the transition toward a greener, more sustainable future. You’ll join a culture defined by humility, initiative and strong values, where we take joint responsibility and genuinely want to help each other succeed. Our office in Solna Business Park offers a modern work environment with great transport links, a fantastic staff restaurant, and the option of hybrid work in agreement with your manager. At Coop, we work for our 4.2 million members, making us by far the largest cooperation in Sweden.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Hiring Manager Emil Nilsson (Emil.Nilsson@coop.se) or the recruiter Andreas Nilsson (andreas.nilsson2@coop.se)

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst- Join Our Growing Team

Location: Stockholm or Remote Sweden




Natlink builds technology for coordination and response. A hunting team spread across several kilometres of forest. A dog working a scent line out of sight of its handler. Someone collapsing from cardiac arrest in a Swedish town, and the nearest trained volunteer needing to reach them before the ambulance can.

Underneath, it's the same problem: get the right people to the right place quickly, usually outdoors, often where the network barely works. Our services are used by close to a million Europeans, through WeHunt, Tracker GPS devices, Burrel cameras and Heartrunner.




Why this role exists

We spent the past 6-months building the data platform: BigQuery, dbt and Lightdash. It's live and the company runs on it. What we don't have yet is the layer between that platform and the people who need to use it.

Right now, most teams still have to come to us. That's the constraint. The job is to close it, in two directions at once: build the things in Lightdash that let support, marketing, product, commercial and finance answer their own questions, and do the deep analytical work that nobody in those teams could do for themselves.

You'd be the most senior analyst here, working across the whole business rather than inside one function.




The team

Four people, reporting to the Head of Data. A data engineer on the platform, an analytics engineer on the model layer and the definitions behind Lightdash, and you on everything the business actually touches. Natlink is around a hundred people and backed by Verdane, so the data function is small, visible and expected to matter.




What you'll work on

Making teams self-sufficient. This is the larger half of the job.

Building the explores, dashboards and self-serve surfaces in Lightdash that teams use daily without asking you first
Sitting with support, marketing, product, commercial and finance often enough to know how they actually think, what they're deciding, and where they get stuck
Working out which questions each team asks repeatedly, and making those answerable without you
Feeding definitions and gaps back to the analytics engineer, so the model layer grows toward what the business needs




Deep analysis nobody else can do.

Retention and subscription behaviour, including predictive work
Customer value across hardware and subscription together, which is harder than either alone
How teams and communities use the products, which is social data rather than individual data
Marketing effectiveness across markets
What support conversations reveal about churn before it appears in the numbers




The data

Most analyst roles offer clicks and transactions. You get those, and a good deal more.

Continuous positioning telemetry from devices working in real terrain. Behaviour from groups coordinating together rather than individuals using an app alone. Hardware and subscription revenue inside a single customer relationship. Trail camera data from remote sites. Emergency response data where the outcome variable is how quickly someone reached a person in cardiac arrest. Support and marketing across several markets with different cultures, seasons and regulations, and demand that swings hard enough each year to break most off-the-shelf models.

It's an unusually varied set for a company this size, and very little of it has been properly analysed. That's the opportunity.




What you'd grow into

Raising the analytical standard as the team grows. The formal data literacy work across the company sits with the Head of Data for now, and you'd take an increasing share of it over time as the self-serve foundation you're building makes it possible.




How we work

Priorities are set with the leadership team through our data steering group, led by the Head of Data. You work on what the company has agreed matters, and you're expected to argue when you think it has that wrong. This is not a ticket queue.

Numbers that leave the building come from the data platform, not from source systems. We don't publish figures we can't reconcile or trust.

We're deliberately AI native. Claude Code and Cursor daily, conventions files in every repo, agents and automated flows in production. It's why a team this size can support a company this size. What matters is how you review and challenge what an agent produces, not how fast you can generate something.




What you need on day one

A track record of analysis that changed decisions rather than reported on them, and two or three examples you can walk us through
You've built something in a BI or semantic layer that non-technical people genuinely used on their own, and you can say what made it work when so much self-serve doesn't
Strong SQL, and comfort working inside a dbt-modelled warehouse
The judgment to know when statistical or predictive modelling is warranted and when it isn't
Credible in the room with product, marketing, commercial and finance, including at executive level
You already work with AI coding agents every day




Nice to have

Experience from a subscription business
Geospatial or sensor data
Swedish, Finnish or Norwegian, since much of the source data and the user base is
An interest in the outdoors, dogs, or the emergency response side of what we do




You'll fit if

You'd rather answer five questions that change a decision than close fifty that don't, and you can tell which is which before you start. You'd rather teach ten people to pull the number themselves than be the one they depend on, and you get something out of watching someone find their own answer. You go looking for the question instead of waiting to be handed one. You say the uncomfortable thing early, when it's still cheap, and you're happy to be wrong in public if it gets us to the right answer faster.




You probably won't if

You want to work from the data and not from the people. Half of this job is in conversation with teams who don't think in tables, and if that reads as an interruption to the real work, it isn't the role. Or you need a groomed backlog and precedent to work from: most of this is still unwritten, and you'd be the one writing it. Or you'd rather go deep in one domain than move across product, hardware, marketing, support and finance.




How we hire

A first conversation with the Head of Data, followed by a short online psychometric and personality assessment you can complete from home in your own time. After that comes an interview with the team, and a working session where we hand you a real modelling problem and spend an hour on it together. You'll get the material shortly beforehand, not days in advance, and you're encouraged to use Claude, Cursor or whatever you normally work with. No take-home assignment. We'd rather see how you think than ask you about it.




To apply:

https://natlink.careers.haileyhr.app/

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Acast

Since 2014, Acast has been building the world’s most valuable podcast marketplace, creating the technology that connects podcast creators, advertisers, and listeners. Its marketplace spans more than 140,000 podcasts, 3,300 advertisers, and one billion quarterly listens. Crucially, those listens are monetized wherever they happen—across any podcast app or listening platform.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our BI team as the trusted data partner for Finance, Product, Sales, and Content Managers who work day-to-day with our podcasters. This role puts you at the forefront of agentic analytics, building the foundation that empowers AI agents to help stakeholders directly query and navigate complex data on their own. Spanning full-stack data work from raw data to consumption-ready dashboards, the position is as much about people and clear context as it is about data, so you'll spend as much time listening, clarifying, and building trust as you will building models.

The best person for this role is someone who genuinely enjoys sitting with a stakeholder's half-formed question, working out what they're really asking, and bringing back an answer that makes their decision easier. You'll care as much about how something lands with the person asking as about whether the number is right.

What You´ll Do


Be the first person Finance, Product, Sales, and Content Managers turn to when they have a data question they can't quite put into words yet, and help them find the words.
Own and evolve our core reporting infrastructure and data models in dbt and Omni across podcast consumption, listens, views, revenue, payout, and product analytics metrics - structuring underlying business logic so AI agents in Omni can reliably answer stakeholder questions in real time.
Build and maintain dashboards that people actually understand and want to use, not just ones that are technically correct.
Notice patterns and risks in payout, platform, and podcast consumption metrics before they become someone else's problem, and flag them early and clearly.
Support Content Managers and Product teams with the data behind podcast consumption analysis, covering listens and views metrics as well as performance trends and payout questions, and help Sales understand what the numbers mean for their conversations with advertisers.
Support teammates by explaining your thinking, documenting decisions, and making it easy for others to pick up where you left off.
Collaborate closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers, developers, and Product Managers to ensure consistency across data models, metrics, and definitions.


Who you are


Someone who listens well and asks good follow-up questions before jumping to a solution.
Strong SQL and dbt skills, proficiency in BI tools like Omni, and experience accelerating analytics development using AI tools such as Cursor or Claude.
A steady, careful approach to data that people can rely on — especially where finance and payouts are involved.
Comfort holding several relationships at once — Finance, Product, Sales, and Content — without losing warmth or clarity under pressure.
A collaborative, generous way of working: sharing context, mentoring where helpful, and making the people around you better at their jobs too.
Proven ability to translate complex business logic into robust, maintainable data models and clear metrics definitions.


Where you will be

Most of our teams are hybrids with some members co-located in offices and some working remotely. For this role you can work remote within Sweden, or based out of our central Stockholm office.

Culture

Acast is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin or any of the other wonderful characteristics that make us different.

Culture is our number one priority as a business. We believe people come first, and we work every day to enable autonomy, continuous improvement and bring out the best in people. We’re global and have remote teams, so it’s even more important that we strive for an open, inclusive and caring environment where everyone feels visible and welcome.

We consider ourselves a modern organization driven by strong values to create the best, most fulfilling and nurturing culture.

We very much look forward to finding the next great person to join our cause!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Syntrace builds conversational knowledge for institutional investors. We capture, organize and synthesize private conversations into source-backed knowledge a firm can build on.




We are now hiring a Data Analyst, based in Stockholm.




We are growing fast, and every decision is better with the right numbers behind it. Which customers get the most value and what makes a team adopt Syntrace across a firm.




You will turn our data into decisions. You will analyze how customers use the product, measure the quality of what our AI delivers and give product, sales and leadership the insights they need.




Our users trust us with the most sensitive conversations they have. That makes security part of the product, not a feature on top of it. We measure how the product is used, never what is said.




What you bring:




- A few years of experience in data analysis, or a strong academic background in a quantitative field.

- Strong SQL, and experience with Python or a similar language for analysis.

- The ability to turn a vague question into a clear answer, and explain it simply.




What you get:




- A founding role with real ownership, including options in the company.

- A senior team that has scaled companies before.

- The chance to shape how a company understands itself.




To apply, send a short note to careers@syntrace.com about yourself.




If you know someone who should read this, send it to them.
