Title: Data Analyst I NOCCO, Barebells & Vitamin Well
Description:
Vitamin Well Group develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.




We are building a team to lead the next phase of Vitamin Well Group’s digital business, working across e-commerce, data and AI.




We are now looking for a Data Analyst to join us in a new, global role. You will work from underlying data through to analysis – spanning data modelling, transformation and quality through to dashboards and insights – helping shape how we structure, connect and use data as our digital business grows. Working closely with our Analytics Lead and AI Lead, you will join while much of our data capability is still being built.




About the role

This is a hands-on role that brings the technical and analytical sides of data together. You will work directly with data using SQL, build and transform datasets in a modern cloud data environment, and take that work through to analysis, visualisation and business decisions.




Your work will connect you with Digital Sales, CRM, Performance Marketing, Social, Product and Engineering. One project could involve modelling customer and transaction data, another connecting a new marketing data source or improving how we measure retention or LTV. At other times, you might start with an open-ended business question and work your way from the underlying data to an analysis that leads to action.




What you will work on

Build and maintain reliable, reusable data models and transformations.
Turn open-ended business questions into structured analysis and actionable insights.
Analyse customer behaviour and growth across areas such as acquisition, retention, attribution and customer lifetime value.
Create dashboards and self-serve analytics that enable teams to understand and act on their KPIs.
Work with different data sources, contributing to ingestion, integrations and data quality.
Collaborate with Product and Engineering on event instrumentation, schema design and data best practices.




What you can expect

Plenty left to build. You are joining a growing data setup, with the opportunity to improve what exists and help shape what comes next.
Problems that are not already solved. Multiple brands, markets and digital channels bring real complexity – and plenty for someone who likes figuring things out.
High ownership from the start. You will be expected to bring your perspective, challenge existing approaches and drive your work forward, working closely with our Analytics Lead and AI Lead.
A fast-growing international business. Your work sits behind the digital growth of Barebells, Vitamin Well and NOCCO, with the pace and change that comes with it.




Who you are

You have hands-on experience working with data from source to insight. You have experience with data modelling and cloud data platforms, and know how to turn underlying data into analysis that supports business decisions.




You move naturally between the technical and analytical sides of the work – understanding how data is structured and transformed while also investigating business questions, identifying what matters and communicating your findings clearly.




You are curious, technically sharp and pragmatic. You enjoy getting into complex problems, finding your way forward when the answer is not obvious and taking ownership from question to solution.




We believe you have:

Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working directly with data from databases.
Experience with analytical data modelling and transformation tools such as dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar.
Experience working with cloud data platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS, Snowflake or Databricks.
Experience turning data into analysis, dashboards and visualisations that support business decisions.
A good understanding of ELT/ETL workflows and how data moves between sources and systems.
Working knowledge of Python.
Professional proficiency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.




Chances are, you have also worked with some of the following:

APIs, integrations or data pipelines.
AI-native coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar.
Sales and marketing data from platforms such as Shopify, GA4, Meta or Google Ads.
AI/LLM products, event instrumentation or experimentation.




How to apply

Application deadline: October 12th 2026

We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.




Life at Vitamin Well Group

At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.




Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.




Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.




As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. The purpose of the tests is to evaluate candidates as objective as possible and identify the best possible match for the role. The tests are based on solid research and are taken through our partner Alva Labs.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This is us




At Avenga, we believe that human creativity empowers technology that matters. Operating globally, our 6000+ specialists provide a full spectrum of services, including business and tech advisory, enterprise solutions, CX, UX and Ul design, managed services, product development, and software development.

This is the job

We are looking for a Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer to join the Power Forecasts product team. You will work with customer and time-series data to support power grid forecasts and help transform manual forecasting processes into automated, data-driven workflows.

You will combine data analysis, Python development, data modelling, and visualization to generate insights that support grid development, investments, reinvestments, and business decisions.




This is you

4 years of experience working with large datasets, preferably customer data and time-series data
Experience with data analysis, data manipulation, data modelling, and communicating insights to stakeholders
3 of experience writing clean and efficient code in Python or a similar programming language
Professional experience with data visualization tools, particularly Power BI
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to communicate complex findings and key insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience in the power grid industry or broader energy sector
Relevant academic degree, for example in Engineering Physics, Energy Systems, Electrical Power, or another relevant technical field




This is your role

Automate parts of the power forecasting process that were previously performed manually by developing Python solutions in a Databricks environment
Analyze customer and time-series data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities to improve forecasting methodologies
Investigate and develop potential improvements to existing forecasting approaches in collaboration with colleagues from different areas of expertise
Build and improve Power BI reports, including data modelling, calculations, and new functionality
Update power forecasts for specific regions and areas by processing input data and generating quantitative and qualitative insights
Collaborate with municipalities and local grid customers to collect and clarify relevant input data
Investigate data availability and collect, combine, and prepare data from different sources
Perform data quality checks and ensure the reliability and consistency of analytical outputs
Prepare and present findings and forecasting results to relevant stakeholders




What awaits you at Avenga?




At Avenga, everyone matters. We provide equal opportunities in recruitment, career development, and leadership, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion, or any other characteristic. We are committed to fostering a work environment where our diverse community of employees, candidates, and business partners actively shapes our growth. By bringing together people from different backgrounds and experiences, we build a workplace where everyone feels free to be themselves while honoring the boundaries of others.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Enterprise GTM
Description:
Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking — from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We're an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Come create with us, and let the world feel your work.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join an embedded, AI-native analytics team that sits inside the commercial and product domains driving our growth. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the VP of Revenue Operations and Global Sales Leadership as we scale our enterprise business — defining what success looks like across the full bow-tie funnel, from pipeline generation to expansion revenue, and proving it with data. You'll have a dedicated mandate within the Enterprise GTM org while drawing on the shared infrastructure, engineering support, and peers of our central Data & Analytics team.

What you'll do


Partner with RevOps and Sales leadership to define success metrics, surface growth opportunities across the enterprise bow-tie funnel, and shape GTM strategy with evidence — proactively raising the questions stakeholders haven't thought to ask.
Build and refine the models that steer the business — customer segmentation for territory and capacity planning, lead and account scoring for pipeline quality, and forecasting for pipeline and revenue.
Make our data trustworthy for agentic analytics — enrich context and metadata, and use AI coding tools to ship instrumentation and data-quality fixes directly so both people and AI tools can rely on it.
Own the analytical backbone of how the enterprise business is steered — KPI and metric definitions aligned across Sales, Marketing, and Finance, and the monthly, quarterly, and annual performance forums, owning the narrative, not just the slides.
Close data gaps and build scalable, self-serve measurement infrastructure so GTM teams can monitor long-term performance without you in the loop.
Uphold rigor as self-serve expands — push back on false precision in pipeline and forecast numbers, set the bar for what good analysis looks like, and resist sophistication, statistical or AI, where a simpler approach serves the decision better.


What you'll bring


Senior-level influence. You've driven real business impact by shaping decisions at the leadership level and moving revenue outcomes.
High agency. Habit of driving decisions through tailored communication and data storytelling.
Sharp analytical instincts. You scope vague questions with vetted frameworks, state hypotheses up front, and reason to a defensible answer even with imperfect data.
Sound judgement about data. A solid grasp of statistics and the discernment to know when past data predicts the future and when to override it for where the business is heading.
Technical versatility. Proficiency across SQL and Python (notebooks in Hex), dbt (on BigQuery), plus experience with AI coding tools and techniques including context engineering and evals.
PLG/SaaS fluency. Hands-on experience in product-led and SaaS businesses, with a solid grasp of subscription economics and the metrics that drive them.


Music to our ears


Experience across the B2B GTM funnel — Sales, Marketing, and RevOps — with funnel, segmentation, and forecasting analytics.
Data modelling know-how and experience with semantic layers.
A track record of defining metrics and steering frameworks for enterprise or 0→1 commercial motions.


What we'll offer


A fast-paced environment with real room for personal growth and tangible impact on the business.
The chance to help write the new playbook for running Analytics in the AI era, combining timeless principles with fresh learnings from emerging tooling.
A diverse, collaborative team of Analysts and Engineers building together.


Equal opportunity employer

We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.

Application

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!




Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:

We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 450+ employees from 45+ nationalities




We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.




The role:

As a Senior Data analyst, you’ll be responsible for the team's quantitative insights. From understanding our data, identifying problems, to working with product, tech, and design on hypothesizing solutions. You’ll be the driver of our experimentation and learning efforts and will collaborate with different teams.




What you will do

Understanding Truecaller's data.
Taking ownership of quantitative insights for your team, playing a crucial role in product development.
Defining experiments, overseeing their setup, and analyzing their results to drive decision-making.
Developing and maintaining key performance indicators (KPIs) for the team, ensuring their tracking, reliability, and reporting.
Creating data pipelines and dashboards to measure the team's KPIs and effectively communicate insights to both the team and leadership.
Coaching and mentoring the team on experimentation and data-driven product development processes, fostering a culture of data-driven decision-making.




What you bring in

4+ years of experience in Data Analytics
Experience in using SQL to extract, transform, and analyse data
Experience in data visualisation tools like Looker (preferred), QlikSense, Tableau, or Power BI
Experience in mentoring, coaching, and evangelizing about data in product development
Experience in digging into different data sources to understand why specific customer behaviours happen
Fluent in spoken and written English




It would be great if you also have

Big data query tools (we use BigQuery).
Experience with data from mobile applications.




What we offer:

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:




A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.




Come as you are:

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.




Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code: https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/




Sounds like a great opportunity?




We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.




We only accept applications in English.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
E.ON in Sweden is part of the international energy group E.ON SE with headquarters in Essen, Germany. The group employs around 70,000 people in 17 countries. Around 2100 dedicated employees work in Sweden. Our Nordic head office is located in Malmö. In Sweden, we supply electricity, heating and smart energy solutions to more than one million households and businesses. E.ON's role is to take responsibility for and drive development forward, so that more people can make the transition. With our investments and our customers' willingness to contribute, we are working to continue to electrify society and meet the energy needs of the future.

Om oss

Vill du använda data för att lösa några av samhällets mest spännande framtidsfrågor? Hos oss blir du en del av gruppen Nätstrategi, där vi ansvarar för och driver den strategiska utvecklingen av regionnätet. Gruppen består av nätplanerare, kraftsystemingenjörer och en dataanalytiker/data scientist som tillsammans bidrar med olika perspektiv och kompetenser.

Din roll

I rollen som Data Analyst arbetar du nära verksamheten och får möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad. Du fångar upp behov från olika specialistroller inom Nätstrategi och omsätter dem till konkreta, tekniska lösningar som skapar värde i vardagen.

Vi tror att du har ett par års erfarenhet från en roll som Data Analyst, Data Scientist eller liknande, där du arbetat med analys, databehandling och utveckling av datadrivna lösningar.

Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL.
Goda kunskaper i Git samt erfarenhet av GitHub, GitLab eller motsvarande plattform.

Högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom relevant område, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.

Kunskap om standarder för utbyte av kraftsystemdata, exempelvis CIM eller CGMES.

Vi tror också att du trivs med att samarbeta, är nyfiken på verksamheten bakom datan och tycker om att omsätta komplex information till användbara insikter. Din chef Ida leder med ett öppet och inkluderande förhållningssätt. Hon tror på att skapa förutsättningar för både individuell utveckling och gemensamma framgångar. Genom lyhördhet, tillit och kontinuerlig utveckling arbetar hon för att alla i teamet ska känna sig delaktiga, uppskattade och ha möjlighet att växa i sin roll.

På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.

Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin egen hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är t.ex. arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill!

Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är 5 oktober.

Då vi arbetar med samhällsviktig verksamhet är anställningen säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att en säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan anställning.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Nordic Knots is building a global Scandinavian design house for the modern home. Starting with hand-crafted rugs, the brand has expanded rapidly into new home categories including textiles, curtains, and bedroom collections. As we scale across markets, channels, and product categories, the volume and complexity of our data is growing just as fast and we are looking for an entrepreneurial, business-minded Senior Data Analyst to join our team in Stockholm.




This is not a reporting only role. We need a builder and an owner: someone who understands the business behind the numbers, who is just as comfortable debugging a broken data model as explaining a margin development to the commercial team, and who is genuinely excited about what AI can do for how a company works with its data. You will be the person the organization trusts when asking "is this number right?" and the person who makes sure the answer is yes.




We are a small team, and that shapes the role in the best way: the scope is broad, you own your domain end to end, and you are close enough to the business to see your work turn into decisions fast.




The Role & What You'll Do

Working closely with Finance, Tech, Operations, Buying & Merchandising, and the commercial teams in the US, UK, and Sweden, you will take ownership of our business intelligence layer: the data warehouse, the business logic within it, and the quality of what comes out of it. You will also take a leading role in bringing AI into how we work with data.




Key Responsibilities:

Business Intelligence Reporting Logic: Own the reporting logic and technical implementation behind our reporting, making sure the numbers our KPIs are built on are correct, consistent, and reliable. KPI definitions sit with our Finance team; you are the person who makes sure the data behind them holds up.
Data Warehouse & Data Models: Maintain and develop our data warehouse and the business model logic within it, including new sources, structural changes, and the continuous updates that follow a fast-growing product and market portfolio.
Data Quality & Root Causes: Profile and monitor our data quality, find the errors before the business does, and drive the work of tracing issues back to their root cause in our source systems together with the teams that own them.
New Metrics & Definitions: Dig into potential new metrics, dimensions, and definitions together with Finance and the commercial teams, and build them into our systems so we can answer questions we have not been able to answer before.
Complex Analysis: Support and lead more complex analysis projects across assortment, pricing, demand, channel performance, and profitability.
AI Initiatives: Take part in and lead AI initiatives within the organization, from agentic analytics and automation to identifying and building the use cases with real business value.
Data Accessibility: Make data more accessible across the organization through documentation, self-service, and enablement so that team members can answer their own questions with confidence, at the highest possible quality.
End-to-End Ownership: As part of a small team, you own your area from groundwork to strategy including the hands-on parts, such as data cleaning and mapping and quick turnarounds on ad-hoc requests from the business.




Who You Are

Most importantly, you are commercially curious and quality-obsessed. You are not satisfied with a query that runs; you want a number that is right and a definition the business agrees on. You are pragmatic, take real ownership of your domain, and enjoy an environment where you can see the impact of your work quickly.




We believe you have:

Analytics Background: 5+ years of experience as a data analyst, BI developer, analytics engineer, or similar. Ideally from retail, e-commerce, consumer goods, or another data-rich commercial environment.
Technical Craft: Strong SQL and solid, hands-on experience with modern cloud data warehousing, data modelling, and BI tooling. You know how to build a data model that holds up over time.
Commercial Understanding: A real grasp of how a consumer brand makes money and the ability to translate business questions into data structures and back again.
Quality & Root-Cause Mindset: Structured, methodical, and persistent about data quality, with the communication skills to drive fixes in systems and processes you do not own yourself.
AI Curiosity: Genuine interest and preferably hands-on experience in applying AI and automation to analytics work, with the judgement to tell a real use case from a demo.
Entrepreneurial Drive: High agency, agility, and enthusiasm for a fast-paced environment where you wear multiple hats and build things that did not exist before you arrived.
Hands-On Attitude: Comfort moving between strategic development and detailed, practical work. The person who designs the data model is also the person who gets it right in the details.




What The Role Offers

Unusually broad scope for a single role, you will touch nearly every part of the business, and see the results of your work in decisions made the same week.
The mandate to shape both our data platform and our AI agenda, rather than inheriting someone else's.
High autonomy, close collaboration with the commercial and tech leadership team, and short distance from idea to implementation.
An international, fast-paced environment with a passionate, collaborative team.




Nordic Knots

Nordic Knots was founded in 2016 by Liza Laserow, Fabian Berglund, and Felix Berglund. We are a fast-growing direct-to-consumer Scandinavian interior design brand with the USA as our major market.




Nordic Knots was born from a culture of thoughtful design that lasts beyond seasons and trends. Fusing function and aesthetics with a Scandinavian sensibility, we craft timeless textiles for the modern home. We believe that great textiles are foundational and can transform a house into a harmonious home - framing the most beautifully curated lives.




The head office as well as the flagship store is located at Birger Jarlsgatan in central Stockholm. We have a constantly growing team across Sweden, the USA, and the UK.




What We Offer

We are a driven team with high ambitions and an entrepreneurial, open-minded culture where new ideas and initiatives are encouraged. At Nordic Knots, everyone plays a meaningful role in contributing to our continued growth.




We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants who bring different perspectives, experiences, and ideas to our team.




Location

This position is based at our headquarters in Stockholm with close interaction with our US and UK teams.

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
Craft:

Data, Analytics & Strategy

Job Description:

We are looking for a Product Analyst to join the team working on game difficulty, progression, and economy in Candy Crush Saga. Together with product managers, game designers, engineers, and data scientists, you will help ensure that our 23,000+ levels and game features combine into a balanced, engaging, and evolving player experience.

This is a hands-on analytics role close to the game: you will turn player data into clear answers, dashboards, and recommendations that shape day-to-day product decisions affecting millions of players.

Your role within the Kingdom


Monitor and report on game difficulty, progression, and economy KPIs, keeping the team informed about how players experience the game
Analyze player behavior across levels and features to identify friction points, trends, and opportunities
Design, monitor, and analyze A/B tests related to difficulty, features, and economy
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that make key metrics accessible and actionable for the team
Investigate product questions and hypotheses with reliable analysis
Define tracking specifications for new features so the data needed to understand player behavior is available and reliable
Present findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders with varying levels of data literacy


Skills to create thrills

Product & Player Understanding


Good product sense with genuine curiosity about player experience, engagement, and frustration
Ability to translate product questions into concrete analyses and metrics


Analytics


Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale behavioral or player data
Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis
Experience building dashboards and reports that drive decisions
Solid understanding of A/B testing, experimental design, and statistical inference


Communication & Collaboration


Ability to communicate findings through clear visualization and storytelling
Comfortable working iteratively and cross-functionally with product managers, game designers, engineers, and data scientists
Pragmatic and organized, able to balance multiple analyses and priorities


Tasty bonus points


Experience with game analytics, progression systems, or virtual economies
Experience in the games industry or other large-scale consumer products
Familiarity with experimentation platforms and live-operated products
Experience defining event tracking or working with analytics instrumentation


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

Du blir en del av vårt team på Advanced Analytics & AI, inom avdelningen Airport Insights. Arbetet bedrivs i nära samarbete med andra delar av verksamheten.

Du arbetar bland annat med kapacitets- och analys av passagerarflöden, framtida behov och kapacitetsbegränsningar samt effekter av förändringar i drift och infrastruktur. Du får också möjlighet att bidra till utvecklingen av prognosmodeller och AI- och ML-baserade lösningar.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av avancerat analysarbete och som trivs med att ta ansvar från frågeställning till färdigt beslutsunderlag. Du är analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad och har lätt för att göra komplexa samband begripliga och användbara för en icke-teknisk målgrupp.

Vi ser att du har:


Relevant akademisk utbildning, exempelvis civilingenjörsexamen
Minst 5 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av avancerat analysarbete i Power BI och Python
God förståelse för kapacitets- och/eller flödesanalys
Kunskap inom prognos- och modellutveckling samt automatisering
Förmåga att bearbeta, transformera och modellera stora datamängder
Vana att kommunicera komplexa analysresultat på ett tydligt och användbart sätt till verksamhet och beslutsfattare
Ett starkt intresse för att förstå verksamhetsfrågor och omsätta dem till data och beslutsstöd
Mycket god svenska och god engelska i tal och skrift



Meriterande med erfarenhet av Databricks.

Title: Analytiker - If Företag
Description:
Är du vår nästa tillväxtanalytiker?

Brinner du för att omvandla data till insikter som gör verklig skillnad – både för våra kunder och vår affär? Vill du vara med och forma framtidens företagsförsäkring, hitta nya affärsmöjligheter och skapa tillväxt? Då kan du vara den vi söker som vår nya analytiker inom Commercial Sverige!

Om rollen

Som analytiker hos oss blir du en nyckelspelare i den tillväxtresa vi är på. Du kommer att arbeta som spindeln i nätet mellan produktutvecklare, underwriters, sälj och ledning och bidra med datadrivna insikter som hjälper oss att fatta smarta beslut för att gynna både tillväxt och lönsamhet. Du kommer ansvara för vår prissättning av en eller flera produkter och vara med och utveckla morgondagens försäkringserbjudande till företag i Sverige. Rollen innebär både operativt och strategiskt analysarbete, där du får möjlighet att påverka och skapa värde för våra kunder.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden


Löpande analysera och tolka data och omvandla komplexa analyser till tydliga insikter och konkreta åtgärder
Ansvara för att följa upp och utveckla prissättning och lönsamhet av vår svenska försäkringsportfölj
Utveckla och underhålla rapporteringsverktyg och dashboards som ger affären rätt beslutsunderlag samt arbeta för att löpande förbättra datakvalitén
Identifiera trender, beteenden och förbättringsområden som stärker vår affär och lönsamhet
Vara en aktiv sparringpartner till ledning och kollegor i affärsutveckling och strategiska initiativ
Bidra till utvecklingen av nya produkter och tjänster för företag


Vi erbjuder

Hos If Får Du Mer Än Bara Ett Jobb – Du Blir En Del Av Nordens Ledande Försäkringsbolag Med Starkt Fokus På Innovation, Hållbarhet Och Kundvärde. Vi Erbjuder


Ett inkluderande och prestigelöst arbetsklimat där alla är välkomna
Möjlighet att påverka och utvecklas i en nordisk organisation
Flexibel arbetsplats med möjlighet till hybridarbete
Ett starkt nätverk av analytiker och affärsutvecklare
Attraktiva personalförmåner, inklusive friskvård, hög pension, lunchförmån, sociala aktiviteter och rabatt på försäkringar


Om teamet

Företagsförsäkringar i Sverige är ett uttalat tillväxtområde för If. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team inom Produkt & Underwriting, Företag Sverige, där vi kombinerar affärsförståelse med analytisk skärpa för att gemensamt skapa bästa förutsättningar för tillväxt. Vi arbetar nära våra partners och kollegor i hela Norden, och du kommer att ha goda möjligheter att samarbeta över landsgränser och kompetensområden.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har ett intresse för dataanalys och vill utveckla din förmåga att omvandla siffror till insikter. Du har också förmågan att kommunicera insikter på ett engagerande och lättförståeligt sätt.

Du Är


Nyfiken på data och drivs av att förstå vad siffrorna faktiskt säger
Strukturerad, noggrann och har ett kritiskt öga för detaljer
En lagspelare som trivs med samarbete och kunskapsdelning
Pedagogisk och har förmågan att tydligt kommunicera siffror, insikter och rekommendationer i både tal och skrift


Du Har Också


Masterexamen eller motsvarande inom matematik, statistik, ekonomi, etc
Intresse av Python, SQL, R eller likande programmeringsspråk är meriterat
Vana av att arbeta i verktyg som Excel, Power BI, Tableau eller liknande är meriterande
Talar och skriver svenska och engelska flytande
Erfarenhet av aktuariellt eller kvantitativt analysarbete, exempelvis i bank- eller försäkringsbranschen, är meriterande men inte ett krav


Övrig information och rekryteringsprocessen

Sista ansökningsdag: Screening och intervjuer sker löpande - skicka in din ansökan redan idag eller senast 2026-10-08.

För att söka: Bifoga ditt CV och svara på rekryteringsfrågorna i ansökningsprocessen.

Placeringsort: Stockholm, Bergshamra.

Resor: Resor inom Sverige och Norden förekommer.

Start: Så snart som möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse.

För frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Charlotte von Plomgren, Head of P&UW Vehicle and Analysis Sweden, charlotte.von.plomgren@if.se.

Slutkandidater kommer att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll innan en anställning kan bli aktuell.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Title: Analyst | EY-Parthenon Data & Analytics | Stockholm
Description:
Will you shape the future or will the future shape you?

Are you passionate about understanding what drives business performance, the latest technology, and M&A? Are you excited about finding new and innovative ways to solve problems? Within Data & Analytics you will have the opportunity to be part of a new wave of business analytics within the world of M&A, helping our clients get faster and deeper insights than ever before.

We’re currently looking for ambitious graduates and professionals with up to two years of experience to join us in August 2027.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

In your role you will help our clients uncover the key drivers behind their businesses by building new solutions, analyzing structured and unstructured datasets, and bridge the gap between data owners and users. Whether you are working with a private equity client looking to sell a portfolio company or guiding a corporate client through their first ever acquisition – no project is ever the same, and every transaction presents its own unique set of challenges and analyses.

The one area that will be consistent throughout is the use of data driven solutions to analyze large and complex datasets – building sophisticated transaction driven analyses to help address our clients’ challenges in fast-changing markets. The central driver of the Data & Analytics group is a constant ambition to improve the M&A process, recognizing the significant untapped value that sits in the ever-growing volume of data our world is generating.

Qualifications


Master’s degree in e.g. business, finance, economics, industrial management, data science, engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline
Strong academic performance
Fluency in English
Experience/knowledge of programming languages, AI-enabled tools and data visualization tools, e.g.:
Visualization software such as Power BI, Tableau
Building AI-powered workflows and automation solutions
Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, R, etc. and with version control (e.g. Git)

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Please submit your application now including your CV, cover letter, and university transcripts. Selection and interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the role, please contact William.Ericson@parthenon.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Amanda.Hederstedt@se.ey.com.

Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.

At EY, we value diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, need support, or require adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, don’t hesitate to contact us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.

Title: Web Analyst
Description:
Vill du vara med och bygga upp hur webbanalys, experimentering och datadrivna beslut ska fungera i framtidens ATG? Hos oss får du möjligheten att kombinera analys, teknik och affärsförståelse för att skapa verklig påverkan. Vi söker nu en Web Analyst som vill vara med och stärka vår produktorganisation genom att omsätta digitala användarbeteenden till insikter, hypoteser och förbättringar som gör skillnad för både kundupplevelsen och affären.




I rollen får du:

Ansvara för spårning, datainsamling och utveckling av mätstrukturer för våra digitala plattformar.
Genomföra djupgående analyser av kundresor, användarbeteenden, digitala flöden och kampanjer.
Segmentera användardata och identifiera beteendemönster som hjälper verksamheten att fatta bättre beslut.
Utveckla dashboards, KPI-strukturer och uppföljning som skapar tydlighet och riktning för produktteamen.
Samarbeta nära produktägare, utvecklare, marknad, affär och andra analytiker för att skapa största möjliga värde.
Bidra till att utveckla hur vi arbetar med datadrivna beslut, digital optimering och kundupplevelse framåt.




Det här är en roll för dig som vill vara med och forma något, inte bara förvalta det som redan finns. Du kommer in i ett läge där analysområdet utvecklas snabbt och där du får stora möjligheter att påverka både arbetssätt, metoder och prioriteringar.




Är det här du?

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av webbanalys och som trivs i gränslandet mellan data, teknik och affär. Du tycker om att förstå helheten bakom siffrorna och drivs av att omsätta insikter till konkreta förbättringar och affärsvärde. Som person är du självgående, initiativrik och nyfiken. Du trivs i en miljö där du förväntas ta ansvar, identifiera möjligheter och driva arbetet framåt utan att någon detaljstyr dig. Vi tror också att du motiveras av att bygga nytt, utmana befintliga arbetssätt och skapa förändring tillsammans med andra. Du är inte rädd för att ha ambitioner. Tvärtom. Vi söker personer som vill utvecklas, påverka och göra avtryck samtidigt som de hjälper teamet och verksamheten att lyckas. För att trivas hos oss behöver du också vara kommunikativ och skicklig på att skapa engagemang kring data och analys hos olika typer av intressenter.




Vi ser att du har:

Flera års erfarenhet inom webbanalys eller liknande område.
Erfarenhet av analys av digitala produkter eller digitala tjänster.
Goda kunskaper i SQL.
Erfarenhet av webbanalysverktyg.
Erfarenhet av tracking, datainsamling och datakvalitet.
Erfarenhet av KPI-uppföljning och dashboarding.
Erfarenhet av experimentering och A/B-testning.
Förmåga att omsätta komplex data till tydliga insikter och rekommendationer.
Erfarenhet av att samarbeta med produktteam, verksamhet eller andra tvärfunktionella intressenter.




Meriterande:

Python eller R.
Erfarenhet från produktorganisationer.




We are the game

I mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vår vision är att leverera världens bästa spelupplevelse. Vi gillar att samarbeta och uppmuntrar varandra att tänka och testa nytt. Självledarskap och kompetensutveckling är viktiga delar för oss. Vi bryr oss om varandra och våra kunder och vi vill så klart också att alla tävlingshästar ska må bra. Hela vårt överskott går till hästnäringen – något som både känns och gör gott.




Join the game!

Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor vid Solvalla, alldeles intill travbanan. Hos oss får du möjligheten att kombinera analys, teknik och affärsförståelse för att skapa verklig påverkan. Vi söker nu en Web Analyst som vill vara med och stärka vår produktorganisation genom att omsätta digitala användarbeteenden till insikter, hypoteser och förbättringar som gör skillnad för både kundupplevelsen och affären.


I rollen får du:

  • Ansvara för spårning, datainsamling och utveckling av mätstrukturer för våra digitala plattformar.
  • Genomföra djupgående analyser av kundresor, användarbeteenden, digitala flöden och kampanjer.
  • Segmentera användardata och identifiera beteendemönster som hjälper verksamheten att fatta bättre beslut.
  • Utveckla dashboards, KPI-strukturer och uppföljning som skapar tydlighet och riktning för produktteamen.
  • Samarbeta nära produktägare, utvecklare, marknad, affär och andra analytiker för att skapa största möjliga värde.
  • Bidra till att utveckla hur vi arbetar med datadrivna beslut, digital optimering och kundupplevelse framåt.


Det här är en roll för dig som vill vara med och forma något, inte bara förvalta det som redan finns. Du kommer in i ett läge där analysområdet utvecklas snabbt och där du får stora möjligheter att påverka både arbetssätt, metoder och prioriteringar.


Är det här du?

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av webbanalys och som trivs i gränslandet mellan data, teknik och affär. Du tycker om att förstå helheten bakom siffrorna och drivs av att omsätta insikter till konkreta förbättringar och affärsvärde. Som person är du självgående, initiativrik och nyfiken. Du trivs i en miljö där du förväntas ta ansvar, identifiera möjligheter och driva arbetet framåt utan att någon detaljstyr dig. Vi tror också att du motiveras av att bygga nytt, utmana befintliga arbetssätt och skapa förändring tillsammans med andra. Du är inte rädd för att ha ambitioner. Tvärtom. Vi söker personer som vill utvecklas, påverka och göra avtryck samtidigt som de hjälper teamet och verksamheten att lyckas. För att trivas hos oss behöver du också vara kommunikativ och skicklig på att skapa engagemang kring data och analys hos olika typer av intressenter.


Vi ser att du har:

  • Flera års erfarenhet inom webbanalys eller liknande område.
  • Erfarenhet av analys av digitala produkter eller digitala tjänster.
  • Goda kunskaper i SQL.
  • Erfarenhet av webbanalysverktyg.
  • Erfarenhet av tracking, datainsamling och datakvalitet.
  • Erfarenhet av KPI-uppföljning och dashboarding.
  • Erfarenhet av experimentering och A/B-testning.
  • Förmåga att omsätta komplex data till tydliga insikter och rekommendationer.
  • Erfarenhet av att samarbeta med produktteam, verksamhet eller andra tvärfunktionella intressenter.


Meriterande:

  • Python eller R.
  • Erfarenhet från produktorganisationer.


We are the game

I mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vi bryr oss om varandra och våra kunder och vi vill så klart också att alla tävlingshästar ska må bra. Hela vårt överskott går till hästnäringen – något som både känns och gör gott.

Title: Consumer Analyst
Description:
Are you passionate about building true consumer preference—turning data and insights into real user and business impact?

At Instabee, we are on a mission to become the undisputed #1 service in the eyes of our consumers. We are now looking for a Consumer Analyst to join our Consumer Department. In this role, you will play a fundamental part in building the analytical foundation and insights required to ensure our organization is aligned, informed, and accountable for delivering a superior consumer experience across all markets.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen and the ability to communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders.

About The Role

As Consumer Analyst, you will translate complex data and consumer signals into clear, actionable insights that can drive strategic and tactical impact. Partnering with teams across Data & Analytics, Product, Design, Operations, Strategy and Market to understand challenges, synthesize insights from diverse sources, and co-create solutions grounded in consumer and business relevance.

Your goal is to build a solid foundation for consumer, brand, and experience analytics, making insights accessible and actionable company-wide. Whether you are mapping the behavior of different consumer segments, uncovering what drives long-term retention, or tracking the impact of a new product feature, you will play a key role in guiding our journey toward becoming the undisputed #1 service in all our markets.

What You'll Do


Manage the Consumer Scorecard: Define and evolve our core KPIs (NPS, User ratings, Brand preference, CSAT, MAU, Consumer base metrics, Operational metrics etc.) to ensure a trusted, single source of truth for our performance across the full consumer journey and lifecycle.
Analyze Loyalty & Retention: Conduct cohort and retention analysis to identify the key drivers of consumer satisfaction and long-term loyalty. You’ll explore how different user segments behave and evolve, and translate user and service delivery insights into cross-functional guidance for the most effective ways to win, delight, and retain our consumers.
Analyze Consumer Behavior: Dive deep into user behavior across web, app, communications and customer service channels. You will analyze funnels and identify drop-off points to provide concrete product and experience recommendations. This includes proactively identifying tracking gaps and defining what needs to be measured and how, to ensure decisions are grounded in reliable data.
Translate Data into Action: Synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into concise, actionable insights. You will provide a holistic lens to ensure we deliver a seamless and superior experience across the entire consumer journey.
Co-create Analytical Foundations: Partner with data and tech teams to ensure our data collection is high-quality, scalable, and reliable. You’ll help shape the tracking and data structures (e.g., GA4, BigQuery) required to turn digital behavior into trustworthy insights.
Drive Performance Insights: Enable data-driven decision-making through forecasting, trend analysis, and the development of automated dashboards in Tableau, Steep or similar tools.
Collaborative Problem Solving: Act as the consumer analytics partner for teams across Instabee, helping them move past the "what" to understand the "why" behind consumer behavior.
Drive Experimentation: Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests—taking ownership from the initial hypothesis to the final conclusion and recommended next steps.


Your profile

You are an analytical problem-solver with a natural drive to uncover patterns and understand exactly what drives consumer behavior and business performance. You are curious, proactive, and motivated by creating real-world results rather than theoretical perfection. You don't just provide data; you see it as your mission to provide the actionable insights that enable our teams to deliver a great consumer experience and our business to grow.

Experience & Mindset


Analytical Experience: 4-5+ years of experience in consumer analytics, digital analytics or a related field - ideally within a fast-paced service or e-commerce environment.
Commercial Curiosity: You have a strong business acumen and a natural drive to understand the "why" behind the numbers. You focus on what is relevant and actionable for the business, and proactively surface insights and opportunities.
Problem Solver: Strong analytical and numerical skills with a business-oriented mindset. You excel at bringing structure to ambiguous problems and can navigate complex datasets to find the most impactful answers.
Communication: You can translate complex analysis into sharp, actionable narratives for diverse stakeholders. You communicate insights clearly and confidently to stakeholders at all levels, from junior teams to senior leadership.
Collaboration: Team player who enjoys working across Product, Tech, and Business teams to develop insights and build solutions together.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, IT, Statistics, Business, or other relevant field.


Analytical toolkit


Consumer Analytics: Proven ability to synthesize various internal and external consumer data into holistic consumer analytics and insights.
Digital Analytics: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, GA4, or similar behavioral tracking platforms.
Data Foundations: Proficiency in SQL and Python or similar, and experience working with large datasets.
Visualization: Ability to build and maintain clear dashboards and funnels that give our teams an ongoing view of consumer health (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Steep).
AI coding tools: Experience in using AI tools in your analytical work is an advantage.
Experimentation: Hands-on experience designing, running, and evaluating A/B tests is an advantage.
Tracking: Knowledge of digital tracking implementation and Google Tag Manager is an advantage.


What You'll Get

We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!

Benefits

Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:


Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


Get to know us

In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.

We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.

This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.

Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

Title: Business Analyst - Data & Analytics
Description:
Vi är inte som andra fastighetsbolag. Vi är Balder.

Vill du vara med och utveckla hur Balder använder data för analys, uppföljning och bättre beslutsfattande?

Vi söker dig som vill kombinera stark verksamhetsförståelse med ett praktiskt arbete inom data och Power BI. Här får du en central roll i att utveckla Balders analysförmåga och skapa lösningar som gör data mer tillgänglig, tillförlitlig och användbar i verksamheten.

Om rollen

Som Business Analyst – Data & Analytics omsätter du verksamhetens analysbehov till tydliga KPI, datakrav och användbara beslutsstöd. Du ansvarar för att utveckla och förvalta våra rapporter i Power BI och säkerställer att data, definitioner och beräkningslogik är korrekta och enhetliga.

Tillsammans med verksamheten och våra tekniska datateam driver du utvecklingen från behov och kravställning till validerad data och färdig analyslösning. Du bidrar även till att utveckla nya sätt att använda data, exempelvis genom självserviceanalys och möjligheten att chatta med data.

I rollen kommer du även att:


Omsätta analysbehov till tekniska krav på datakällor, datamodeller, transformationer och dataflöden.
Driva och prioritera utvecklingsbehov mot dataplattformen tillsammans med data engineers, arkitekter och andra tekniska specialister.
Definiera affärsregler, beräkningslogik, dimensioner och gemensamma begrepp tillsammans med verksamheten.
Praktiskt analysera, felsöka och validera data och logik genom hela flödet, från källsystem till rapport.
Utveckla dashboards och semantiska modeller i Power BI.


Vi söker dig som har


Ett par års erfarenhet av att utveckla rapporter och analyslösningar utifrån verksamhetens behov.
Djup praktisk kompetens inom Power BI, där du även skapat dig kunskap inom ex. DAX, Power Query, datamodellering, semantiska modeller och prestandaoptimering.
Goda kunskaper i SQL och erfarenhet av att analysera, transformera, felsöka och kvalitetssäkra data.
God förståelse för datalager, dimensionell modellering och dataflöden.


Har du en bakgrund som BI-utvecklare, Data Engineer eller liknande teknisk roll ser vi det som ett stort plus. Erfarenhet av Snowflake, utveckling av datalager eller dataplattformar samt generativ AI, semantiska lager och lösningar som gör det möjligt att ställa frågor och chatta med data är även det starkt meriterande.

Vem är du?

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du gillar att arbeta nära verksamheten och förstå vilka frågor och behov som faktiskt behöver lösas med hjälp av data. Du är analytisk och tekniskt nyfiken, men också praktiskt lagd och trivs med att själv undersöka, utveckla och kvalitetssäkra lösningar. Du tar initiativ och driver arbetet framåt, samtidigt som du kan göra komplex data och tekniska samband begripliga och användbara för andra.

Låter detta som en tjänst för dig?

Kul! Vi arbetar med löpande urval så skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning. Tjänsten är placerad på vårt kontor i Göteborg/Stockholm, med arbete på plats fem dagar i veckan.

I denna process ber vi dig inte skicka med personligt brev, utan vill i stället att du besvarar våra urvalsfrågor. Vi använder oss av rekryteringstester för att hjälpa oss göra ett så bra och objektivt urval som möjligt. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen kommer även ett arbetsprov att tillämpas.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterare Gabriella Hagström, gabriella.hagstrom@balder.se.

Hjärtligt välkommen till oss och en bransch som är full av möjligheter!

Balder äger, förvaltar och utvecklar bostäder, kommersiella fastigheter och hotell i Sverige, Danmark, Finland, Tyskland, Storbritannien och Norge. Vi skapar attraktiva och trygga områden för människor att bo i och där nya affärer utvecklas.

Title: Senior Product Analyst - Consumer Experience
Description:
What We Do At Qliro

At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are a company of dedicated, friendly and highly competent people that together have redefined what Qliro and payments can be. We are now on a journey of scaling our business both here in Sweden and the Nordics.

What You Will Do

Title: Credit Risk Management & Performance Analyst
Description:
About The Role

We are looking for an analyst with strong business capabilities to join our team. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of data analysis and business decision-making. You will analyse our performing credit portfolios, evaluate and improve pre-collection activities, and provide analytical support for portfolio sales and transactions across our markets.

You will work with everything from SQL-based data analysis and performance monitoring to presenting clear recommendations to business owners and management. We are looking for someone who does not stop at explaining what happened, but can identify why it happened and what we should do next.

Key Responsibilities


Analyse the performance of performing credit portfolios, including payment behaviour, early delinquency, roll rates, vintages, customer segments and profitability
Identify emerging risks and opportunities and translate findings into concrete business recommendations
Measure and improve pre-collection strategies, including customer selection, contact channels, treatment strategies, vendor performance and cure rates
Design and evaluate tests to determine the incremental impact of pre-collection initiatives
Develop robust SQL analyses, datasets and recurring performance reporting
Support portfolio sales and forward-flow transactions through portfolio segmentation, data-tape preparation, cash-flow and pricing analyses, due diligence and post-sale performance monitoring
Ensure strong data quality, consistent definitions and clear documentation
Present findings in a concise and commercially relevant way to business stakeholders, committees and management
Collaborate with colleagues across Credit Risk, Collections, Finance, Commercial & Data as well as country teams and external partners


Qualifications And Experience


Strong SQL skills and experience working with large and complex datasets
A relevant academic background in finance, economics, statistics, mathematics, data science or a similar quantitative field
Experience within credit risk, portfolio analytics, consumer finance, collections or another data-driven financial environment
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with commercial judgement
Ability to turn complex analyses into clear conclusions and practical recommendations
A structured and independent working style, with strong attention to data quality and detail
Strong communication skills and confidence working with both technical and business stakeholders
Professional proficiency in English
Experience with Power BI, advanced Excel, pre-collection, portfolio sales or debt-purchase transactions is a plus


We Offer

You will join a developing Group function with a clear mandate and close access to decision-makers. The role offers broad exposure across markets and products, significant ownership of your analyses and the opportunity to directly influence how we manage portfolio performance, prevent future credit losses and execute portfolio transactions.

Title: Analyskonsult – från affärsfråga till insikt
Description:
Söker du en roll där affärsfokus alltid kommer först – och där AI redan är en naturlig del av hur vi utvecklar analyslösningar?




Vi söker nya kollegor till Stockholm.

Den här rollen handlar om att göra data begriplig och användbar. Oavsett om du skapar dashboards, stöttar beslutsfattande eller hjälper till att definiera vilka visualiseringar som passar bäst för problemet – vi söker någon som ser helheten och inte är rädd för att dyka ner i detaljerna




Vi söker dig som har både öga för design och förståelse för data, och som brinner för att göra information tillgänglig och användbar.




Vad du får göra hos oss

Du kommer att arbeta i uppdrag hos våra kunder och verkligen förstå deras behov på djupet. Du omsätter affärsfrågor till datadrivna analyser, prognoser och beslutsstöd som gör skillnad i vardagen. En viktig del av ditt arbete blir att utforma dashboards och rapporter som inte bara ser bra ut i teorin, utan faktiskt används och skapar värde.

Du kommer att:

Arbeta med moderna BI-verktyg (Power BI, Tableau, Looker m.fl.) och bygga lösningar i SQL, Python eller liknande.
Vara en del av hur AI förstärker analytics – exempelvis i prediktiva modeller och automatiserad analys.
Utveckla dig själv och bidra till kunskapsdelning i vårt starka community av data- och AI-specialister.




Vi är ett team av passionerade experter som delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och skapar värde tillsammans. Här får du frihet att påverka och en kultur där nyfikenhet och samarbete står i centrum.




Vi tror att du har med dig

Vi letar efter en erfaren BI- och analysspecialist som vill göra verklig skillnad tillsammans med oss. Du har en stark förståelse för affärsprocesser och vet hur man omvandlar dem till smarta datalösningar som skapar värde. Hos oss får du arbeta med moderna verktyg, utveckla din kompetens och bidra till ett öppet och kunskapsdelande community.

Vi tror att du har:

Flera års erfarenhet av att arbeta med analys/BI, som konsult eller internt
Förmåga att förstå affärsprocesser och översätta dem till datadrivna lösningar
Vana att skapa analyser och visualiseringar som används för beslut
Djup kompetens i moderna BI-verktyg (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) samt SQL
Nyfikenhet på hur AI och nya tekniker kan göra analys ännu mer värdeskapande




Vad du får av oss

Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter låg hierarki, självständighet och ansvar, värdeskapande arbete och trevliga kollegor. Här kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar.

Meningsfulla projekt: Arbeta i en agil miljö där du kan påverka teknikval och arbetssätt för att skapa de bästa lösningarna
Flexibilitet och autonomi för att utforma ditt arbete med flextider– läs mer från vår blogg.
Ständig utveckling: Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare ligger längst fram i teknikutvecklingen.
Innovativ kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av de främsta experterna inom data, analys och utveckling




Utöver detta får du även ta del av följande förmåner:

Fast lön oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande
30 semesterdagar
Sjukvårdsförsäkring för både din mentala och fysiska hälsa som täcker dig även utanför tjänstetid
Friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr via Benify.
Ett brett nätverk av erfarna specialister från olika områden inom tech att samarbeta med
Intern coach för att stödja ditt välbefinnande
After Work och hobbyaktiviteter
Fredagsfrukost




Vilka är vi?

Solita är ett värderingsstyrt konsultbolag med över 2200 medarbetare i 9 länder, varav 230 i Sverige. Vår storlek gör oss tillräckligt stora för att vara en stabil och innovativ arbetsgivare, men samtidigt tillräckligt små för att värna om våra medarbetare och kunder. Med bred kompetens inom digital transformation erbjuder vi en dynamisk arbetsmiljö. Hos oss får du friheten att utvecklas, både professionellt och personligt.




Intresserad av att höra mer?

Låter det som en spännande utmaning? Skicka gärna in din ansökan – eller bara din LinkedIn-profil om du vill hålla det enkelt. Om du har några frågor, hör gärna av dig till Maja Oderstedt eller Jacob Beck alternativt skicka ett mail till skicka ett mail till maja.oderstedt(at)solita.se

Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande och ser fram emot att höra hur du vill utvecklas framåt.

Title: Business Analyst - Digital Commercial Analytics
Description:
Job Description



At H&M, we are committed to creating meaningful growth through customer-centric and data-informed decision making. We are now looking for a Business Analyst to join the Digital Commercial Analytics team.



In this role, you will combine commercial understanding, analytical expertise and stakeholder collaboration to identify opportunities, evaluate business performance and support sustainable growth across our digital business. You will work closely with QCP (Quantified Commercial Plan), Marketing, Digital, Controlling and Sales Markets to translate data into insights and recommendations that strengthen commercial decision-making and execution.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Analyse digital and commercial performance to identify opportunities, risks and growth drivers.
Turn strategic business questions into actionable insights and recommendations through customer, sales and behavioural analysis.
Develop business cases and support prioritisation of initiatives and investments.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to understand customer behaviour and the drivers behind business performance.
Partner with QCP to develop, maintain and evolve frameworks, tools, guidelines and best practices.
Drive best practices, analytical frameworks and capability development for Commercial Business Analysts across Sales Markets, enabling more consistent and impactful commercial decision-making.
Provide analytical support and insights related to post-purchase customer experience, fulfilment, returns and customer behaviour.
Support business reviews, hindsight analyses and strategic planning through fact-based recommendations.
Contribute to the continuous development of analytical methods, tools, technologies and ways of working within the team.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH



You will be part of the Digital Commercial Analytics team within the Digital Unit in the Commercial function, working closely with global and local commercial stakeholders, analysts, data teams and digital functions. The team’s mission is to drive digital business performance through advanced analytics, strategic insights, and business cases that enable better decision-making across H&M’s global online business.



The role reports to the Digital Commercial Manager.



WHO YOU ARE



We believe you are a highly analytical and commercially minded person who enjoys solving complex business challenges through data and insights. You can connect customer behaviour, digital performance and commercial outcomes, translating findings into recommendations that create business impact.



You are comfortable working across functions, influencing stakeholders through a fact-based approach and communicating complex topics in a clear and engaging way.



We are looking for people with:



5+ years of experience within business analysis, commercial analytics, business controlling, commercial planning or a similar field.
Strong understanding of digital business, e-commerce and customer behaviour
Strong analytical capabilities and experience working with complex datasets.
Strong understanding of commercial performance drivers, customer behaviour and digital business KPIs.
Proven ability to develop business cases and translate insights into recommendations and actions.
Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation and modern analytical capabilities to enhance analysis, improve ways of working and strengthen decision-making.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working with analytical tools and platforms such as Power BI, Excel, BigQuery and other data analysis tools.
A collaborative mindset and a passion for driving business impact through insights.

Additional Information



This is a fulltime permanent role based in Stockholm, Sweden. 

If you believe your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your CV in English  before 1st of October.



Diversity, Inclusion, and Innovation



At H&M Group, we're deeply committed to fostering a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We actively seek out qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, national origin, disability, or age.



Our commitment to an inclusive workplace drives our dynamic and forward-thinking culture. Regardless of your background, origin, or preferences, your application is warmly welcomed. We value diverse perspectives and skills, and every applicant contributes to our vibrant, creative community. Join us and be part of the future we're building.



Our Offer



At H&M Group, you're not just joining a team – you're joining a value-driven culture and an expansive tech network. Enjoy perks like staff discount cards, flexible work arrangements, wellness benefits, parental support, and more. Here, you're encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and chart your own growth path. As you flourish, so do we, with opportunities to create tangible impacts and shape the future.  





Additional Information



WHO WE ARE​



H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​



​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​



​WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​



We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.



In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries. 



JOIN US​



Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​



​Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​



​ *We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.​
