Title: HRIS Analyst till Ambea
Description:
Nu söker vi en HRIS Analyst till Ambeakoncernens huvudkontor i Solna.

Ambea är Nordens kunskapsledande omsorgsföretag. Vi verkar genom varumärkena Nytida, Vardaga, Stendi, Altiden, Validia och Klara, och bedriver utbildningsverksamhet inom Lära. Genomgående i våra verksamheter erbjuder vi boende, stöd, utbildning och bemanning inom vård och omsorg. Vi har cirka 38 000 medarbetare på mer än 1000 enheter i Sverige, Norge, Danmark och Finland. Vi ska vara kvalitetsledande i allt vi gör och vår vision är att göra världen lite bättre, en människa i taget. Hos oss kan du utvecklas samtidigt som du gör skillnad för andra. Läs gärna mer

Läs gärna mer här.

Ditt uppdrag

Rollen är en central analytisk och koordinerande funktion inom HR, med uppdrag att stötta våra verksamheter i hela Norden. Fokus ligger på HR-nyckeltal, CSRD-rapportering och HR-ekonomiska frågor i nära samarbete med HR, lön, IT, ekonomi och andra relevanta funktioner.

Rollen ansvarar för att samla, strukturera och analysera data och omsätta den till insikter, beslutsunderlag och tydlig rapportering. En viktig del av uppdraget är också att utveckla hur vi arbetar med data och analys inom HR – att inte bara leverera på dagens behov, utan genom nyfikenhet och verksamhetsförståelse identifiera nya frågeställningar, samband och behov. Rollen utforskar hur automatisering och AI kan användas för att förenkla arbetssätt, skapa smartare analys, effektivare rapportering och ge bättre beslutsstöd.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter


Utveckla och harmonisera gemensamma KPI:er och definitioner för Norden samt visualisera nyckeltal och beslutsunderlag på ett användarvänligt sätt.
Analysera HR-nyckeltal och andra relevanta data för att identifiera trender, samband, avvikelser och bakomliggande drivkrafter samt föreslå åtgärder.
Ta fram analyser och underlag inom HR och löneområdet.
Göra komplex data, analyser och nyckeltal enkla att förstå, relevanta och användbara för verksamheten.
Driva och utveckla people analytics inom strategiskt viktiga områden.
Stöd av analys av data vid bolagsintegration
Koordinera CSRD-rapporteringen för HR-/sociala datapunkter i samtliga nordiska länder, inklusive datainsamling, harmonisering, kvalitetssäkring och samordning med relevanta funktioner.
Utveckla och effektivisera processer för datainsamling och formell rapportering, inklusive hållbarhetsredovisning och årsredovisning, samt underlag vid intern och extern revision.
Driva strategi- och affärsplansprocessen inom HRM och bidra med ekonomisk och analytisk förståelse.


Din erfarenhet och kunskap

Vi söker framför allt en person som kombinerar stark analytisk förmåga, förståelse för HR-nyckeltal, ekonomisk förståelse, intresse för data, system och digitala verktyg samt ett genuint verksamhetsintresse. Personen är nyfiken och självgående och kan gå från en relativt öppen frågeställning till att identifiera relevant data, kombinera olika perspektiv, genomföra analys och presentera tydliga slutsatser och möjliga åtgärder.


Akademisk utbildning inom ekonomi, statistik, HR analytics eller annan relevant inriktning.
Erfarenhet av kvalificerat analysarbete och vana att hantera och kombinera större datamängder.
God förståelse för HR-data och HR-nyckeltal samt förmåga att koppla dessa till ekonomiska och verksamhetsmässiga perspektiv.
Stort intresse för system, data, digitala verktyg och AI samt mycket goda kunskaper i Excel. Nyfiken på hur ny teknik kan användas för att förenkla, automatisera och utveckla analys och rapportering. Erfarenhet av BI- och visualiseringsverktyg är meriterande.
Förmåga att självständigt strukturera komplexa frågeställningar och driva arbetet från data till slutsats.
God kommunikativ och pedagogisk förmåga samt ett prestigelöst och samarbetsorienterat arbetssätt.
Erfarenhet från personalintensiv och/eller nordisk organisation är meriterande.


Vi erbjuder


Ledarskapsutbildade chefer – samtliga chefer går vårt ledarprogram.
Karriär- och utvecklingsmöjligheter – vårt mål är att 7 av 10 personer ska kunna internrekryteras till chefs- eller specialistroller.
Utbildning via vår egna utbildningsorganisation Lära – t ex att leda utan att vara chef, utbildning för dig som ska utbilda andra, rehabilitering, arbetsrätt, utvecklingssamtal och arbetsmiljö.


Vi har självklart även kollektivavtal, förmånsportal, tjänstepension, försäkringar och friskvårdsbidrag.

Om oss

Sedan mars 2025 finns vi i våra nya, moderna lokaler i Origo på Röntgenvägen 3 – med direkt närhet till kommunikationer i Sundbybergs centrum. Du kan läsa mer om våra lokaler här.

Vi ses kontinuerligt i trevliga sammanhang såsom afterwork, fester, alzheimerloppet och andra tillfällen. Vi har omsorgstagare som praktiserar på vårt huvudkontor med allt ifrån administration till facility management för att få möjlighet till utveckling.

Alla chefer genomgår ett gediget ledarskapsprogram där syftet är att skapa ett gemensamt språk och syn på ledarskap. Vi vill ha ledare som är ansvarstagande, skapar tydlighet och delaktighet, coachar, ger och tar emot feedback, är prestigelösa och affärsmässiga.

Övrigt

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare med 6 månaders provanställning

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning

Tillträdesdag: Enligt överenskommelse

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-10-08

Registerkontroll: Utdrag ur belastningsregister skall uppvisas vid en eventuell anställning Som en del av vårt arbetsmiljöarbete kan slumpmässiga drogtester förekomma.

Facklig kontakt: Vision, Magnus Sällström, vision@ambea.se

Ansökan

Välkommen att ansöka via knappen ”Skicka ansökan” nedan. Vänta inte med att ansöka då vi gör urval löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Om du blir kallad till intervju kommer det ingå tester för att främja en transparent och kompetensbaserad process. Du behöver även kunna styrka att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige, genom att uppvisa att du har medborgarskap inom EU/EES eller ett giltigt arbetstillstånd.

Personen är nyfiken och självgående och kan gå från en relativt öppen frågeställning till att identifiera relevant data, kombinera olika perspektiv, genomföra analys och presentera tydliga slutsatser och möjliga åtgärder.

  • Akademisk utbildning inom ekonomi, statistik, HR analytics eller annan relevant inriktning.
  • Erfarenhet av kvalificerat analysarbete och vana att hantera och kombinera större datamängder.
  • God förståelse för HR-data och HR-nyckeltal samt förmåga att koppla dessa till ekonomiska och verksamhetsmässiga perspektiv.
  • Stort intresse för system, data, digitala verktyg och AI samt mycket goda kunskaper i Excel. Nyfiken på hur ny teknik kan användas för att förenkla, automatisera och utveckla analys och rapportering. Erfarenhet av BI- och visualiseringsverktyg är meriterande.
  • Förmåga att självständigt strukturera komplexa frågeställningar och driva arbetet från data till slutsats.
  • God kommunikativ och pedagogisk förmåga samt ett prestigelöst och samarbetsorienterat arbetssätt.
  • Erfarenhet från personalintensiv och/eller nordisk organisation är meriterande.

Vi erbjuder

  • Ledarskapsutbildade chefer – samtliga chefer går vårt ledarprogram.
  • Karriär- och utvecklingsmöjligheter – vårt mål är att 7 av 10 personer ska kunna internrekryteras till chefs- eller specialistroller.
  • Utbildning via vår egna utbildningsorganisation Lära – t ex att leda utan att vara chef, utbildning för dig som ska utbilda andra, rehabilitering, arbetsrätt, utvecklingssamtal och arbetsmiljö.

Vi har självklart även kollektivavtal, förmånsportal, tjänstepension, försäkringar och friskvårdsbidrag.

Om oss

Sedan mars 2025 finns vi i våra nya, moderna lokaler i Origo på Röntgenvägen 3 – med direkt närhet till kommunikationer i Sundbybergs centrum. Du kan läsa mer om våra lokaler här.

Vi ses kontinuerligt i trevliga sammanhang såsom afterwork, fester, alzheimerloppet och andra tillfällen. Vi har omsorgstagare som praktiserar på vårt huvudkontor med allt ifrån administration till facility management för att få möjlighet till utveckling.

Alla chefer genomgår ett gediget ledarskapsprogram där syftet är att skapa ett gemensamt språk och syn på ledarskap. Vi vill ha ledare som är ansvarstagande, skapar tydlighet och delaktighet, coachar, ger och tar emot feedback, är prestigelösa och affärsmässiga.

Övrigt

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare med 6 månaders provanställning

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning

Tillträdesdag: Enligt överenskommelse

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-10-08

Registerkontroll: Utdrag ur belastningsregister skall uppvisas vid en eventuell anställning Som en del av vårt arbetsmiljöarbete kan slumpmässiga drogtester förekomma.

Facklig kontakt: Vision, Magnus Sällström, vision@ambea.se

Välkommen att ansöka via knappen ”Skicka ansökan” nedan. Vänta inte med att ansöka då vi gör urval löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Om du blir kallad till intervju kommer det ingå tester för att främja en transparent och kompetensbaserad process. Du behöver även kunna styrka att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige, genom att uppvisa att du har medborgarskap inom EU/EES eller ett giltigt arbetstillstånd.

Title: BI Analyst
Place: Herlev, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About The Job

We’re looking for an ambitious and curious Analyst with 1–3 years of experience to join our Copenhagen HQ. You’ll be passionate about transforming data into insights and developing high-value analytical solutions that support Flatpay’s continued growth.

As part of our growing Analytics team, you’ll work in a dynamic and collaborative environment where data is central to decision-making. Collaboration, friendliness, and a relaxed atmosphere are important parts of how we work.

In this role, you’ll develop commercial reporting and analysis across different areas of the business. This will include both high-level reporting for senior management and operational reporting that helps teams make better day-to-day decisions.

You’ll become the analytical domain expert for selected areas of the business. This means building a deep understanding of their processes, performance drivers, and data, and taking responsibility for ensuring that stakeholders have the insights they need.

What You’ll Do

As an Analyst at Flatpay, you’ll work across a wide range of analytical and reporting tasks using diverse datasets. Your role will focus on strengthening how we track, understand, and act on commercial and operational performance.

You’ll work closely with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate business questions into clear analysis, reporting, and recommendations. You’ll also review and improve our existing data models and reports to ensure they meet business needs and follow modern analytical practices.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Understanding and exploring business needs related to data, analysis, and reporting
Building and maintaining commercial reports and KPI frameworks
Developing high-level reporting and analysis for senior management
Creating operational reports and dashboards that support day-to-day decision-making
Becoming the analytical domain expert for selected areas of the business
Developing a strong understanding of the processes, KPIs, and performance drivers within your domains
Identifying trends, inefficiencies, risks, and commercial opportunities
Turning complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations
Developing and maintaining reports and dashboards, primarily in Power BI
Ensuring data quality and accuracy through testing and validation
Optimising existing reports and analyses based on business needs and user feedback
Testing and implementing new AI solutions in dashboard development, analytical workflows, or standalone AI applications.


Who You Are

To succeed in this role, you should be comfortable working with data and have practical experience with Power BI and SQL. You’re naturally curious, eager to understand how a business works, and motivated by turning data into decisions and measurable commercial impact.

You’re independent, results-driven, and adaptable, and you perform well in a fast-paced and agile environment. You enjoy working closely with stakeholders, challenging existing ways of working, and communicating analytical findings clearly to both operational teams and senior management.

Your Skills And Experience


1–3 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role
Experience developing reports and visualisations in Power BI
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
The ability to explain commercial and analytical concepts clearly and simply
A degree in economics, business, computer science, data analytics, or a related field
A strong business mindset and focus on commercial results


Nice to have


Experience with commercial or operational performance analysis
Experience creating reporting for senior management
Familiarity with data modelling tools such as dbt
Experience working in a fast-growing or international company
Knowledge of the payments or fintech industry


Why Flatpay?


Work from our HQ in Copenhagen and play a key role in shaping how we use data across the business
Take ownership of analytical domains and become a trusted partner to key stakeholders
Work on reporting ranging from senior management insights to operational decision support
Have a high-impact role with visibility across multiple parts of the organisation
Join a fast-paced environment where insights quickly turn into action


Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

Title: Country Data Analyst - IKEA Denmark (Service Office in Taastrup)
Place: Taastrup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
WHO YOU ARE
You are a curious and collaborative Data Analyst who enjoys turning data into clear, reliable and useful insights for the business. You are motivated by building strong data foundations, creating dashboards and analyses that people trust, and helping IKEA Denmark make better and faster decisions. 

Most importantly, you are motivated by creating value through data and by contributing to an inclusive team where knowledge sharing, learning and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

We believe you bring many of the following strengths:

•Has solid experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, BI Developer or similar role 
•Is highly skilled in SQL and Phython, and is comfortable working with large and complex datasets 
•Has strong experience with data modelling, data transformation and creating reliable data structures for reporting and analysis 
•Has practical experience with MS Fabric and Power BI, including building clear dashboards, semantic models, measures and automated reporting solutions 
•Understands how to turn business needs into data requirements, analysis and user-friendly reporting solutions 
•Can translate data into clear stories that help stakeholders understand performance, identify gaps and decide what to do next 
•Works in a structured and proactive way, with the ability to prioritise and drive tasks forward independently 
•Is curious about AI and motivated by exploring how AI can improve the way we work with data, analysis and decision-making 
•Enjoys working closely with stakeholders and being part of a collaborative team where knowledge sharing, curiosity and continuous improvement are important

You do not need to tick every box to be successful in this role. If you are excited about the opportunity and believe your experience can contribute to our team, we would love to hear from you.

A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US
In this role, you will help IKEA Denmark turn data into trusted insights and decision support. You will work closely with the Insights & Analytics team and stakeholders across the Danish organisation to understand business needs, build strong data solutions and make performance easier to understand and act on. 

Your work will include: 

•Building and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions that support business performance follow-up 
•Creating data models, measures and datasets that are reliable, scalable and easy to use 
•Writing SQL queries to extract, transform and prepare data for analysis and reporting 
•Conducting exploratory analysis to identify patterns, gaps, opportunities and business drivers 
•Working closely with Insights Leaders to combine analytical findings with business and customer understanding 
•Translating business questions into data requirements and clear analytical solutions 
•Helping improve data quality, definitions and documentation together with the Data Governance & Activation Leader 
•Using and exploring AI-supported ways of working to make analysis, reporting and insight generation more efficient 
•Communicating findings in a simple and visual way that helps stakeholders understand what is happening, why it matters and what actions could be taken

TOGETHER AS A TEAM
You will be part of the Insights & Analytics team in IKEA Denmark, a team with a clear purpose: to help IKEA Denmark make better and faster decisions by bringing together data, insights, business understanding and customer perspectives. 

Today, we are five colleagues in the team: two Insights Leaders, one Data Analysts, one Data Governance & Activation Leader and the Insights & Analytics Manager. We work closely together across our different areas of expertise and partner with functions across the Danish organisation. 

As a team, we believe in openness, curiosity and togetherness. We have a high team spirit, and we want everyone to feel safe to share their opinion, challenge constructively and contribute with their unique perspective.

Apply now!
At IKEA, we believe that diverse perspectives help us make better decisions and create better solutions. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every qualification listed. We value different backgrounds, perspectives and ways of thinking.

If you have questions to the position, you are welcome to reach out to Insights & Analytic Manager, Anders Jensen on anders.jensen6@ingka.ikea.com

Additional information
•Working Hours & Contract: The position is 37+ hours per week on a salaried contract (funktionærkontrakt), where additional hours and overtime are included in the salary. 
•Flexible Hours: Flexible working hours (typically 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM). 
•Remote Work: Opportunity to work from home up to 2 days a week. 
•Compensation: Salary according to qualifications and in line with IKEA’s salary policy. 
•Benefits: We offer various employee benefits, including: pension scheme, health insurance, massage scheme, subsidized canteen, staff discount, discount schemes with partners, annual gift, and bonus scheme, etc. 
•Reporting Structure: Reporting to the Insights & Analytics Manager. 
•Work Location: IKEA Service Office, Taastrup. 
•Start Date: We are looking for someone to start as soon as possible or by agreement. 
•Application Deadline: Apply by 13th of october at the latest.

Title: Dataanalytiker med stærke formidlingsevner til analyseteamet i Beskæftigelses-, Integrations-, og Erhvervsforvaltningen
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Søg jobbet

Område

Politik og administration

Ansøgningsfrist

09.10.2026

Arbejdstid

Fuldtid

Jobtype

Fastansættelse

Søg jobbet

Er du skarp til dataanalyse og samtidig dygtig til at formidle komplekse indsigter klart og forståeligt?

Så er du måske vores nye kollega i analyseteamet i Beskæftigelses-, Integrations-, og Erhvervsforvaltningen i Københavns Kommune.

Vi søger engagerede dataanalytikere, der kan arbejde struktureret med data i Power BI og omsætte data til værdifuld viden for organisationen.

Om stillingen

Som dataanalytiker bliver du en central del af vores analyseteam, hvor du arbejder med at bearbejde, analysere og visualisere data, der understøtter beslutningstagning på tværs af organisationen. Du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at data ikke blot bliver analyseret – men også forstået og anvendt. Data og analyser spiller en vigtig rolle i mange af forvaltningens sager, og du vil derfor få en bred kontaktflade. Du skal derfor befinde dig godt til rette i et område med stor bevågenhed og betydning for hele forvaltningen.

Dine opgaver vil være en kombination af faste opgaver og ad hoc-bestillinger og vil spænde lige fra analyse, formidling og beslutningsoplæg til koordinering og projektledelse. Du vil desuden udarbejde notater, indstillinger, andre skriftlige oplæg og præsentationer, der understøtter ledelse, direktion og politiske processer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være


Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af rapporter og dashboards i Power BI
Analyse af data med fokus på at identificere mønstre, tendenser og forbedringsmuligheder
Formidling af analyseresultater til både faglige specialister og ikke-tekniske interessenter
Sparring med kolleger og ledelse om datadrevne beslutninger
Bidrag til udvikling af datakvalitet og datastandarder.


Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du


Har erfaring med databehandling, -analyse og -visualisering og er fortrolig med værktøjer som Excel og Power BI
Har en relevant videregående uddannelse med en stærk kvantitativ profil, f.eks. økonomi, statskundskab, statistik, sociologi, social datavidenskab eller lignende
Har en analytisk tilgang og evner at arbejde struktureret med data
Er stærk i skriftlig og mundtlig formidling og kan gøre komplekse analyser let forståelige
Er nysgerrig, proaktiv og trives i samarbejde med forskellige fagligheder
Er opsøgende på samarbejde og ser det som en forudsætning for at lykkedes.


Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med datamodellering, f.eks. ved brug af SQL, Python eller lignende værktøjer, og hvis du tidligere har arbejdet i større organisationer med mange interessenter.

Et godt arbejdsmiljø med plads til udvikling og fordybelse

Vi tilbyder en spændende stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at omsætte data til analyser og ledelsesinformation, der bidrager til et stærkt beslutningsgrundlag for chefer, direktion og politisk niveau samt til udviklingen af forvaltningens indsatser til gavn for både borgere og virksomheder.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt analyseteam i Danmarks største Beskæftigelses-, Integrations-, og Erhvervsforvaltning, hvor opgaverne er komplekse og samfundsvigtige.

Området er i disse år præget af implementeringen af beskæftigelsesreformen, som giver kommunerne større frihed og ændrer de organisatoriske og styringsmæssige rammer.

Det giver dig en unik mulighed for at være med til at forme og udvikle, hvordan data anvendes til at understøtte fremtidens indsatser. Det betyder også, at du vil arbejde i en organisation i bevægelse, hvor der er plads til nye idéer og initiativer.

Vi lægger vægt på din faglige og personlige udvikling og tilbyder gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling, sparring med dygtige kolleger og indflydelse på egne opgaver. Samtidig har vi et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med høj grad af samarbejde, fleksible arbejdsforhold og en god balance mellem arbejdsliv og fritid.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt.

Lønnen afhænger af dine kvalifikationer og forhandles indenfor rammerne af lokal løndannelse.

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst mellem Kommunernes Landsforening og relevant faglig organisation.

Yderligere oplysninger

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte budget- og analysechef Julie Alsing på 51 63 34 00.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Vi afholder samtaler den 20. og 21. oktober.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Kan du omsætte komplekse behov til dataprodukter, der kan bruges på tværs af syv banker?

Bankdata er i gang med at bygge et nyt datafællesskab og en ny fælles cloudbaseret dataplatform, som skal gøre det lettere for vores medlemsbanker at arbejde datadrevet.

Til det arbejde søger vi en Senior Data Analyst, der både forstår forretningen og har gode kompetencer inden for data og datamodellering.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores medlemsbanker, Data Governance, forskellige domæneteams og dine kolleger på dataområdet. Sammen skal I forstå behovene, skabe fælles begreber og omsætte dem til genanvendelige dataprodukter.

En del af dit arbejde vil i første omgang være tæt knyttet til vores nye fælles CRM-system, men rollen favner bredere. Derfor leder vi først og fremmest efter dig, der kan arbejde med data og forretningsbehov på tværs af forskellige områder.

Det betyder, at du skal kunne bevæge dig fra dialogen om, hvad data skal kunne bruges til, til den logiske og fysiske modellering af den løsning, der gør det muligt.

Byg data én gang – og skab værdi på tværs

Du bliver en del af et produktteam med otte kolleger og en Product Owner. Teamet arbejder tæt sammen med vores andet dataproduktteam og med kolleger og kunder på tværs af Bankdatas datafællesskab.

Datafællesskabet er nyt og skal være et fælles fundament, der gør det lettere for vores syv medlemsbanker at arbejde mere datadrevet.

Det betyder også, at du ikke udvikler en løsning til én enkelt bank. Du skal kunne løfte blikket og være med til at finde fælles modeller og standarder, der fungerer på tværs – samtidig med at bankerne har forskellige behov.

Et af de områder, du kommer til at arbejde med, er vores nye fælles CRM-system. Her skal vi udvikle dataprodukter og datamodeller, der kan genbruges på tværs. På sigt kan du også komme til at arbejde med dataprodukter inden for andre forretningsområder.

Dit bidrag – fra forretningsbehov til dataprodukt

Som Senior Data Analyst får du end-to-end ansvar for udvalgte dataprodukter – fra de første dialoger om behov og begreber til modellering, udvikling og løbende forbedring.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:


afdække behov sammen med vores medlemsbanker, domæneteams, Data Governance og øvrige samarbejdspartnere
arbejde med begrebsmodellering og omsætte forretningsbehov til konkrete dataprodukter
arbejde med logisk og fysisk datamodellering
udvikle genanvendelige dataprodukter på vores nye cloudbaserede dataplatform
sikre dokumentation, datakvalitet og gode standarder i tæt samarbejde med Data Governance
identificere muligheder for at optimere og modernisere eksisterende dataløsninger
bidrage til fælles datastandarder og best practices
sparre med kolleger og dele din viden i teamet og på tværs af dataområdet.



Som seniorprofil forventer vi samtidig, at du kan tage ansvar for helheden. De dataprodukter, vi bygger, skal ikke alene fungere internt i Bankdata, men skabe værdi på tværs af vores medlemsbanker.

Det første år lærer du både bank og data at kende

I dine første 6–12 måneder kommer du til at opbygge gode relationer til kolleger og samarbejdspartnere i Bankdata og vores medlemsbanker.

Du lærer Bankdatas systemlandskab og datastrømme at kende og får indsigt i den finansielle verden og de forskellige behov, vores medlemsbanker har.

Samtidig kommer du hurtigt i gang med at udvikle dataprodukter på vores nye cloudplatform sammen med domæneteams, kunder og kolleger. I den første periode vil en del af dit fokus være på data til vores nye fælles CRM-system og på at modernisere og videreudvikle de eksisterende dataløsninger på området.

Du forstår både forretningen og data

Vi leder efter en Senior Data Analyst, der trives i feltet mellem mennesker, forretning og teknologi.

Du har erfaring med dataarbejde, men det er vigtigt for os, at din profil ikke kun er teknisk. Du er nysgerrig på den forretning, data skal understøtte, og du kan gå ind i dialogen med brugere og kunder, forstå deres behov og omsætte dem til modeller og løsninger.

Vi forestiller os, at du har nogle års erfaring med dataarbejde i cloudmiljøer eller datavarehuse og gerne erfaring med flere af følgende områder:


datamodellering og tæt samarbejde med forretningen
logisk og fysisk datamodellering
moderne dataarkitektur, fx medaljonarkitektur og Domain-Driven Design
data engineering i cloudmiljøer – gerne Azure
datakvalitet, lineage og performance
Python og SQL samt ETL/ELT og datapipelines.



Har du erfaring med CRM-systemer – fx Microsoft Dynamics – er det en fordel, men ikke et krav. Erfaring fra finans eller IT er også en fordel, men heller ikke afgørende.

Din uddannelsesbaggrund kan fx være inden for naturvidenskab, økonomi, informationsvidenskab, BI eller finans. Den præcise uddannelse er mindre vigtig end din erfaring og din evne til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem data og forretning.

Du kan skabe overblik og få mennesker med

Det er vigtigt, at du kan løse opgaver på egen hånd og samtidig indgå godt i samarbejde med andre.

Du kan skabe overblik i komplekse problemstillinger og bevæge dig mellem det konceptuelle, forretningsmæssige og tekniske niveau uden at miste helheden.

Du er tillidsskabende og god til at opbygge relationer – både med tekniske kolleger og med mennesker hos vores kunder. Og du kan forklare komplekse dataløsninger, så de giver mening for mennesker med meget forskellig teknisk indsigt.

Samtidig håber vi, at du har en kan-ikke-lade-være-tilgang til ny teknologi og er nysgerrig på nye muligheder og måder at arbejde med data på.

Et dataområde i udvikling – med plads til din udvikling

Du kommer ind i et område med store ambitioner for data og med mulighed for selv at udvikle din faglige retning.

Du kan specialisere dig yderligere inden for Data & Analytics, datamodellering, Data Governance og moderne dataplatforme. Du får også mulighed for at arbejde med nye teknologier og være med til at forme, hvordan vi arbejder med data i cloud.

Som seniorprofil får du mulighed for at sparre med og udvikle mindre erfarne kolleger, og på længere sigt kan rollen også være et skridt i retning af fx en lead-rolle.

Fælles for det hele er, at du kommer til at arbejde med data, der betyder noget – i løsninger, der skal fungere på tværs af syv selvstændige medlemsbanker i en sektor, hvor data er både forretningskritisk og stærkt reguleret.

Er du klar til at tage næste skridt?

Så send os dit CV allerede i dag via nedenstående link. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi finder den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Vice President Birthe Boysen på bio@bankdata.dk

Velkommen til Bankdata

Bankdata bygger software til finanssektoren. Vi er næsten 1100 kolleger på holdet, og vi udvikler digitale produkter, platforme og infrastruktur, som ca. hver tredje dansker, 200.000 virksomheder og flere tusinde bankansatte bruger hver dag.

Vi tror på struktureret personlig udvikling, et solidt kollegialt fællesskab og at ambitiøse medarbejdere med fleksible og bæredygtige arbejdsliv præsterer bedre. Bliv klogere på arbejdslivet i Bankdata her.

Hos Bankdata arbejder vi målrettet med at fremme mangfoldighed og diversitet blandt vores medarbejdere, og vi opfordrer derfor alle uanset kønsidentitet, alder og kulturel baggrund til at søge job hos os.

Bankdata er en af Danmarks vigtigste teknologivirksomheder. Vi går på arbejde for at finde teknologiske svar på finanssektorens forretningsproblemer. For at udvikle og bygge fremtidens digitale bank.

Title: Senior Insights Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
A great opportunity to turn data into proper impact in a global retail organization.




In the position as Senior Insights Analyst, you will turn data from our Databricks Lakehouse into trusted insights that shape better decisions across Flying Tiger Copenhagen.




You will own the semantic layer, build powerful self-service datasets, and create reporting and analytics that put meaningful insights in the hands of the people who need them.




You will report to the Enterprise Architect and become a key member of the Architecture & Engineering department at our HQ in the heart of Copenhagen.




Responsibilities include:

Design and deliver insights and reporting solutions across all technology and business initiatives, including semantic layer on Databricks and optimization of Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, reports and dashboards.
Define, document and govern KPI definitions to ensure consistent metrics and a single source of truth across the business.
Implement reporting governance and quality standards, including certified datasets and workspace management.
Enable self-service analytics for business users, including training, documentation and best-practice guidance.
Translate business questions from departments into clear analytical deliverables and deliver demos and handovers to end users.
Act as the senior analytics resource on the team and provide guidance on analytical, data modeling and data visualization best practices.




This is you:

+5 years of experience in data, analytics or business intelligence roles, with progressive responsibility for data modeling and insights delivery.
Hands-on dimensional modeling experience - star/snowflake schema design, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions and aggregation strategies.
Hands-on experience with Power BI (including semantic modeling), and Databricks (including semantic layer design and definition).
Strong SQL capabilities for building robust and maintainable analytical datasets; Python for analytics is a plus.
Experience with KPI and metric frameworks, data governance and self-service analytics enablement. Retail industry experience is a plus.




As a person, you are analytical, solutions-oriented, and skilled at turning data into clear, actionable insights. You have strong data storytelling and visualization skills and communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences.




Finally, you are a natural project manager and collaborative team player who enjoys engaging stakeholders, driving initiatives forward, and delivering presentations and training to empower end users.




Flying Tiger Copenhagen offers:

A fantastic central Copenhagen location.
Attractive pension scheme.
Private health insurance (including children).
Flexible working, including the option to work from home.
A fun, social, and dynamic culture.
Events, Friday bars, staff clubs, and more.
An international workplace rooted in Scandinavian values.
Daily restaurant-quality food.
…and much more.




If this sounds like the right professional match for you, we encourage you to apply. Please include a short motivation text in the top of your CV – cover letter is not required.




Did you know?

We take climate action seriously and work continuously to reduce our carbon footprint. This includes shifting from plastic to renewable materials and ensuring our stores run on renewable energy. Our efforts are validated by external experts through the Science Based Targets initiative. Learn more about our sustainability work here: https://flyingtiger.com/en-de/pages/sustainability

Title: Senior UX Data Analyst
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Usability Engineering & LUXCE



Are you an experienced UX Data Analyst interested in contributing to improving the user experience within hearing technology? And would you like to work for an international company that improves the quality of life for people with hearing loss around the world?

Technical Skills And Creativity

You will join Usability Engineering and Device Lean UX Center of Excellence within R&D at Demant - a team of around ten specialists responsible for device UX, usability design and compliance across our hearing aids, accessories and supporting systems.

Our task is to shape, monitor, and measure user experience, interaction and usability throughout the entire development process, from idea to launch and beyond. That takes a deep understanding of customer and user needs, combined with a technical and creative approach.

You will work alongside our Usability Engineers and UX Domain Architect. Your primary responsibility will be to build the data foundation, tools and standards that make our user research and usage data measurable, comparable and actionable across the organization.

The team works across functions within R&D, QA/RA, Sales & Marketing, and Product & Portfolio Management. You will therefore work closely with a broad range of stakeholders.

You Can Look Forward To The Following Responsibilities



Data engineering and Power BI: Build and maintain dashboards and data pipelines that bring UX insights together with market, product and usage data from our wider data sources.
Data management and governance: Establish the structure, taxonomy and quality standards for our research repository, so studies can be found, reused and compared over time by people and by AI.
Storytelling and visualization: Support our engineers in analyzing and presenting their material so it lands with Epic Owners, Product Managers and leadership - from individual studies to cross-study synthesis. You will also be providing material for data-driven decisions on what to prioritize going forward.
Methodological sparring: Advise on statistics and analytical design in usability tests and market studies (sample size, significance, benchmarking).
AI in the analysis workflow: Explore and introduce ways AI can make prototyping, testing, analysis, synthesis and reporting more efficient - responsibly and in line with our data policies.



We imagine that you



Have professional experience in data analysis, ideally in research, product development or quality environment. You may hold a BSc or MSc in a relevant field such as engineering, information science, data science or cognitive science.
Are confident in Databricks, Power BI and in modelling data from multiple sources (SQL or equivalent).

Description:
Job Description



Senior Data Analyst

Posting Start Date: 9/29/26

Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, | Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

Senior Data Analyst – SAP Reporting & Stakeholder Alignment


Location: Copenhagen, Denmark or Lisbon, Portugal
Working hours: Full-time
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type: Permanent


Are you passionate about turning business questions into meaningful data solutions? Do you enjoy working with stakeholders, solving complex data challenges, and transforming data into insights that drive better decisions? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

As our new Senior Data Analyst, you will join the Data & Insights team and report directly to the Head of Data & Insights. In this role, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and SAP data, ensuring reporting requirements are clearly defined, translated into actionable data solutions, and delivered with accuracy and impact.

You will work closely with Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, and Data Engineering teams to support data-driven decision-making while improving reporting processes and data quality across the organization. This is a great opportunity to influence business decisions, collaborate across functions, and help shape the future of data and analytics at STG.

What Your Day Will Look Like

In this role, you will typically focus on:


Partner directly with business stakeholders — Finance leadership, Sales/Commercial, Supply Chain/Operations — to understand their reporting and data needs, and translate them into concrete data requirements.
Work closely with data engineers to scope, request, and validate data pulled from SAP, acting as the translation layer between business language and technical/data specifications.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, validate, and consolidate data for recurring and ad hoc reporting.
Build and maintain Excel-based models, trackers, and reports that stakeholders rely on for decision-making.
Consolidate data into stakeholder-ready reporting, and supporting data checks.
Act as the go-to person for scoping ambiguous stakeholder requests — clarifying what's actually needed, managing expectations, and pushing back constructively when a request isn't well-defined or feasible.
Identify data quality issues at the source and work with SAP module owners and data engineers to resolve them.
Document data definitions, sources, and logic so reporting stays consistent and auditable month over month.
Continuously look for ways to streamline the process rather than repeating manual work each cycle.


What You'll Bring


5+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar data-facing role, ideally in a retail or consumer business.
Strong SQL skills — comfortable writing and troubleshooting complex queries independently.
Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data modeling; Power Query is a plus).
Familiarity with SAP data structures, particularly FI (Finance) and SD (Sales & Distribution).
Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), or willingness to learn it, is a plus.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Business, Economics, Finance, Data/Statistics, Engineering, or related).
Proven experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders and translating them into technical/data specifications.
Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align multiple stakeholders (including Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, and IT/data engineering) with sometimes competing priorities, and communicate trade-offs clearly.
Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity and turning it into a structured plan.


Working At STG & What To Expect

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.

At STG you'll find more than a role. You'll find opportunities to grow, learn from talented colleagues, and contribute to initiatives that help drive business performance across a global organization.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Ready to be part of something bigger?

Apply now and discover much more.

Our recruitment process

Requirements

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:


Recruiter screen
Interview with the hiring team
Final interview with key stakeholders


Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

"Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs."

Title: Vi søger BI-specialist med stærke kompetencer inden for Power BI, dataanalyse og ledelsesrapportering
Description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle datadrevet ledelsesinformation og skabe Power BI-løsninger, der giver ledelsen et stærkt grundlag for at styre driften? Er du teknisk stærk i Power BI, skarp på data og god til at omsætte komplekse datamængder til overskuelige rapporter så er det måske dig, vi søger.




I Vurderingsstyrelsen står vi over for en stor opgave med vurderingen af landets erhvervs-, land- og skovejendomme. Det stiller krav til stærk og anvendelig ledelsesinformation, der gør os i stand til at følge produktionen, identificere udvikling og tendenser og understøtte ledelsens beslutninger.




I vores kontor, Produktionsstyring og Faglig Afklaring, søger vi derfor en teknisk stærk BI-specialist til vores BI-team. Teamet består i dag af tre kolleger, der udvikler og vedligeholder vores Power BI-løsninger, og sammen skal I videreudvikle vores BI-område og ledelsesrapportering.




Som BI-specialist bliver du en del af et team, hvor I sammen har ansvar for at udvikle, vedligeholde og optimere vores rapportering i Power BI. Du kommer ind i et eksisterende fagligt miljø, hvor der allerede arbejdes med Power BI, men hvor vi ønsker at styrke vores tekniske BI-kompetencer og videreudvikle den måde, vi arbejder med data, rapportering og ledelsesinformation på.




En væsentlig opgave for teamet er at udvikle vores rapporter, så ledelsen får et enkelt, aktuelt og anvendeligt billede af produktion, fremdrift, resultater og relevante styringsparametre.




Sammen med dine kolleger skal du have styr på processen fra data og forretningsbehov til den færdige rapport eller det færdige dashboard. Det kræver, at du både kan gå i dybden med den tekniske BI-løsning og forstå den drift og forretning, som rapporteringen skal understøtte.




Som medarbejder vil dine primære opgaver være fokuseret på arbejdet med at:




omsætte forretningsbehov til konkrete løsninger
udvikle, opbygge og optimere Power BI-rapporter og dashboards
udvikle standardiseret ledelsesrapportering
bearbejde, strukturere og analysere data fra forskellige datakilder
udvikle og optimere datamodeller samt arbejde med DAX og Power Query
analysere data og identificere tendenser, afvigelser og sammenhænge, der kan understøtte ledelsens beslutninger
kvalitetssikre data og rapportering og bidrage til ensartede definitioner og datagrundlag
bidrage til udviklingen af vores øvrige digitale værktøjer – gerne med erfaring inden for Power Apps og Power Automate.




Teknisk stærk BI-profil med analytisk blik

Vi søger dig, der har solid praktisk erfaring med Power BI og databearbejdning, og som har lyst til at bringe din specialistviden ind i et team, hvor I udvikler løsningerne sammen.




Du kan gå i dybden med data og tekniske problemstillinger, men samtidig løfte blikket og forstå, hvad data skal bruges til. For os handler god BI ikke alene om at præsentere tal. Rapporteringen skal gøre det lettere at forstå, hvad der sker i driften, hvorfor det sker, og hvor der kan være behov for opmærksomhed eller handling.




Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:




har solid erfaring med udvikling af rapporter og dashboards i Microsoft Power BI
har stærke kompetencer inden for DAX, Power Query, datamodellering og datavisualisering
kan arbejde selvstændigt med komplekse datasæt og omsætte dem til robuste og brugervenlige BI-løsninger
har en stærk analytisk forståelse og kan omsætte data til relevant ledelsesinformation
har erfaring med eller interesse for udvikling af ledelses dashboards og ledelsesrapportering
sparre med ledere og kolleger om, hvordan data bedst kan understøtte produktionsstyring og opfølgning
dele viden og sparre fagligt med de øvrige BI-medarbejdere, så vi sammen udvikler vores løsninger og kompetencer kan afdække forretningens behov og omsætte dem til konkrete BI-løsninger
har blik for datakvalitet, struktur og sammenhænge på tværs af data
kan formidle komplekse data og analyser enkelt og forståeligt
trives i et team, hvor vi lægger vægt på samarbejde, faglig sparring og videndeling
arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og proaktivt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver fra behov til færdig løsning.




Det vil være en fordel, hvis du desuden har erfaring med Power Apps og Power Automate og kan se muligheder for at kombinere BI, automatisering og digitale løsninger til at understøtte forretningen.




Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund kan være forskellig. Det afgørende for os er din tekniske BI-faglighed, dine datakompetencer og din evne til at omsætte data og forretningsbehov til løsninger, der kan anvendes i den daglige styring og ledelse.




Bliv en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø

Som BI-specialist i Produktionsstyring og Faglig Afklaring indgår du i et kontor med 18 engagerede og meget kompetente kolleger, hvor vi er fælles om at vedligeholde et stærkt fagligt miljø i en uformel og tillidsfuld atmosfære – med højt til loftet og godt humør.




Jobbet kræver engagement og indsats, og derfor tilbyder vi også rammerne for et godt arbejdsliv for dig som medarbejder, hvor der er god balance mellem arbejde og fritid, og hvor du har høj indflydelse på egne opgaver og udvikling.




Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansøgning med CV og eksamenspapirer bedes sendt via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest den 24. september 2026. 1. samtaler til stillingen afholdes løbende. Evt. 2. samtaler med personanalyse forventes afholdt den 9. oktober 2026.




Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte souschef Maria Schneekloth på telefon 72 38 12 98.




Der vil forud for ansættelse blive indhentet referencer og straffeattest.




Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Ansættelse vil være i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.




Din arbejdsplads vil blive en af vores 2 lokationer, Universitetsvej 2, 4000 Roskilde (Trekroner) eller Brovejen 15A, 4930 Maribo.




Tiltrædelse snarest muligt.




Om Vurderingsstyrelsen

’Vi sikrer, at boligejerne får en mere retvisende og gennemskuelig ejendomsvurdering’




Vurderingsstyrelsen varetager alle forhold om ejendomsvurdering og beskatning af ejendomme. Styrelsens opgave er at udarbejde mere retvisende og gennemskuelige offentlige vurderinger af grunde og ejendomme og sikre korrekt betaling af skatten på baggrund af disse. Fremtidens vurderinger bliver baseret på nye og detaljerede data. Det skal sikre, at borgere og virksomheder kan have tillid til, at de bliver beskattet på et korrekt grundlag. Vores værdier er ansvar, udsyn, faglighed og samarbejde.




Vi er en arbejdsplads med mange forskellige fagligheder. De er alle i spil i dagligdagen, hvor vi lægger vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø og en stærk samarbejdskultur, hvor alle trives, tager ansvar og bidrager til den fælles opgave. Vi har et godt kollegaskab med en uformel omgangstone og vi tror på, at en fornuftig balance mellem arbejdsliv og privatliv giver motiverede og tilfredse medarbejdere.




Vurderingsstyrelsen har ca. 1400 ansatte og er en arbejdsplads i vækst, og vi har derfor løbende brug for nye, engagerede kolleger.




Læs mere om Vurderingsstyrelsen på www.vurdst.dk

.

Vurderingsstyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Jobbet kræver engagement og indsats, og derfor tilbyder vi også rammerne for et godt arbejdsliv for dig som medarbejder, hvor der er god balance mellem arbejde og fritid, og hvor du har høj indflydelse på egne opgaver og udvikling.

(DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Ansættelse vil være i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.


Din arbejdsplads vil blive en af vores 2 lokationer, Universitetsvej 2, 4000 Roskilde (Trekroner) eller Brovejen 15A, 4930 Maribo.


Tiltrædelse snarest muligt.


Om Vurderingsstyrelsen

Title: Staff Fullstack Data Analyst (Commercial Analytics)
Description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Please note:

Applications will be open until 2nd October 2026 at 10.00 CEST.

We will not review any application before the closing window so, please, don't rush to apply and ensure you use the time to submit a high quality, personalised application.

About The Role

Growth Intelligence owns the commercial data layer that powers Pleo's GTM engine — acquisition, retention, propensity modelling, and customer health. The team supports RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success, and senior commercial leadership with the data and models they need to make faster, smarter decisions.

As a Staff Full Stack Data Analyst, you are the senior technical voice for commercial analytics at Pleo. You set the architectural direction for Growth Intelligence's analytics layer, define what good looks like for the team, and shape how GTM data is structured, governed, and consumed by people and increasingly by AI tools.

You bring technical depth, commercial instinct, and organisational reach in equal measure. You move between architecture reviews and executive presentations, between defining metric contracts and mentoring the analysts who implement them. You don't just answer questions - you identify the right ones, and you make sure the answers compound over time.

Who you'll work with

You will report to the Senior Manager of the Growth Intelligence team. You will partner closely with senior commercial leadership, Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Success teams; the onboarding and self-serve product teams; Data Scientists and Analytics Engineers across the broader data organization; and Data Services & Governance on standards and semantic layer ownership. You will be a visible, senior presence across the entire data community at Pleo.

What you'll be doing


Own the architectural direction of the analytics layer for customer acquisition, onboarding, growth, and retention. You'll be making systemic decisions about how models are structured, layered, and governed, not just what gets built next.
Identify and resolve upstream data quality issues at source, treating quality gaps as governance and contract problems, articulating the business risk they create, and driving the org-level changes needed to fix them durably.
Define canonical GTM metric definitions in the semantic layer, in partnership with Data Services & Governance while ensuring RevOps, CS, CX, BI tools, and AI tooling are working from the same source of truth, and holding that standard over time.
Partner with senior commercial leadership to shape the questions worth answering.
Lead in-depth analysis of customer behaviour, commercial performance, and retention patterns.
Design and govern the team's approach to experimentation ensuring statistical rigour, scalable methodology, and clear criteria for what constitutes a meaningful result.
Build analytics explicitly architected for self-serve and AI access: structured, documented, and reliable enough for business teams, conversational analytics tools, and AI features to consume autonomously.
Mentor and develop analysts on the team through code reviews, design discussions, and deliberate knowledge-sharing, raising the collective standard of analytical craft.
Contribute to engineering and analytical standards across the broader data community, participating in cross-team reviews and helping define what production-grade analytics looks like at Pleo.


For extra context, you'll also be leveraging technologies including SQL, dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Amplitude, HubSpot, Zuora, or Vitally.

What you bring


Prior experience operating at Staff or Lead level in data analytics or analytics engineering roles in a fast-paced SaaS organisation.
Expert knowledge of SQL and dbt: you write clean, tested, well-architected models and can make and defend layering decisions for a team, not just yourself.
Solid proficiency with Python for data analysis and manipulation.
Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD practices for analytics code.
BigQuery fluency, including performance optimization and cost considerations at scale.
Mastery of a modern BI tool such as Looker or Omni.
Commercial specialisation: you have worked in a commercial analytics focused role and understand GTM metrics, customer lifecycle economics, and how data connects to revenue outcomes at a strategic level.
Systems thinking on data quality: you approach quality gaps as governance questions, identify root causes upstream, and drive fixes that last rather than patches that don't.
Strong understanding of data contracts: schema ownership, SLAs, and the organizational dynamics required to make producer-consumer agreements stick.
Understanding of how analytics outputs serve AI tools and self-serve analytics as first-class consumers: you design for machine access as well as human access, and you know why metric consistency becomes critical as AI tooling scales.
Track record of advising senior GTM stakeholders around shaping the question as much as answering it, and communicating risk and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical leaders.
Experience mentoring analysts and raising team capability


Why this role is a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:


You excel at turning large, interconnected and complex problems into well structured, clearly defined and pragmatic solutions. If you are comfortable navigating ambiguity within a fast-paced SaaS organisation, and can generate clarity, you'll find this role very exciting.
You find hands-on technical work as exciting as stakeholders management, delivery management and governance strategy.
You have operated as a Technical Lead for Commercial / Growth Analytics within a 500+ people SaaS organisation and understand the recurring topics, challenges and goals businesses of our scale experience.


This role is NOT a good fit for you if:


You prefer to specialise deeply in one technical area rather than wear multiple hats. This role requires you to move between architecture, analysis, experimentation, stakeholder management, and mentoring.
You are not comfortable operating at senior leadership level and shaping ambiguous commercial questions into solvable data problems. You'll often need to define what success looks like before you can measure it.
You need clean problem definitions before you can start. The commercial data environment here is genuinely complex: definitions evolve, ownership is shared, and the right answer sometimes requires organisational negotiation as much as analysis.
You think of standards and governance as someone else's job. At this level, you are part of how the organisation decides what good looks like.


How you'll develop in this role


By the end of your first six months, you will have left the analytics layer in structurally better shape, not just fixed individual dashboards, but addressed the underlying quality, governance, and architectural gaps that were causing repeated pain for RevOps, CS, and CX teams.
You will have driven at least one meaningful governance outcome: canonical GTM metric definitions agreed with Data Services & Governance, embedded in the semantic layer, and actively used so that analysts, BI tools, and AI features are working from the same numbers.
You will have established yourself as a trusted partner to commercial leadership, not just the person who delivers the analysis, but the person they bring in when they're not sure what question to ask.
You will have shipped something that changed what was possible: not improved plumbing, but unlocked a capability or decision that couldn't have happened without you.


Show Me The Benefits


Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).
For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:


Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
Core skills test: an async technical exercise designed to assess your coding fundamentals.
Hiring Manager interview: a 60-minute experience-based interview to deep dive into your domain knowledge, technical expertise and ability to lead initiatives.
Pleo Challenge: a live practical and technical case study designed to assess your domain knowledge, problem solving, and insights generation skills.
Final interview: a 30-minute conversation with a senior leader focusing on your behavioural skills.


Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:


We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
For this role, technical experience, seniority and commercial domain expertise all matter equally. Ensure your CV reflects the actual experience you have in each of these areas.


About Your Application


English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Title: Associate Data Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Get To Know Us:

SS&C is leading the way. We continue to look for today's and tomorrow’s brightest talent, those who embody a spirit to improve not only their lives, but those around them. From college students to seasoned and experienced professionals, we encourage you to apply. SS&C prides itself on hiring diverse, honest, dynamic individuals who value collaboration, accountability, and innovation, to name a few.




Role: Associate Data Analyst

Locations: Copenhagen, Denmark | Hybrid 6 days a month







The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Associate Data Analyst to join our Copenhagen office and become part of a specialised, collaborative, and close-knit team working at the intersection of finance, data analytics, and securities litigation.

As an Associate, you will contribute to a broad range of research and analytical activities, including evaluating securities class actions, estimating potential investor recoveries, analysing settlement opportunities, and supporting the identification and assessment of new business opportunities.

The position combines financial analysis, data analysis, litigation research, and business research. You will work with financial and trading data, legal and regulatory filings, institutional investor information, and internal analytical models to support the evaluation of complex litigation matters.

You will be given hands-on responsibility from an early stage and gain broad exposure to securities markets, institutional investors, class action litigation, and data-driven financial analysis.




What You Will Get To Do:

Assist with the calculation and analysis of potential damages and settlement recoveries in securities class actions, including securities fraud, IPO, merger, and other shareholder litigation matters.
Collect, validate, and analyse financial, trading, market, and litigation data used in case evaluations and recovery estimates.
Conduct research on securities class actions, court filings, settlement notices, regulatory filings, and relevant market developments.
Review legal filings and settlement documentation to identify class definitions, relevant securities, eligibility requirements, and potential recovery opportunities.
Assist with research and analysis of institutional investors and prospective clients, including their investment strategies, portfolio holdings, SEC filings, assets under management, and potential exposure to litigation opportunities.
Support the development and maintenance of financial, statistical, and predictive models used to evaluate potential litigation outcomes, damages, and recoveries.
Support the preparation and maintenance of loss estimates, price-drop analyses, case valuations, and other internal and client-facing analytics.
Maintain and update internal databases and analytical tools relating to pending litigation, settlements, and institutional investors.
Prepare tables, charts, calculations, and other analytical materials using Microsoft Excel and other data-analysis tools.
Perform ad hoc financial, litigation, and business research as required.
Contribute to the continued development and improvement of research processes, analytical methodologies, databases, and internal tools.




What You Will Bring:

We are looking for a candidate with a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and an interest in working with financial information and complex datasets.

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Law, or another relevant field.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Experience working with data and the ability to analyse and interpret complex datasets.
Strong research skills and the ability to collect, evaluate, and combine information from multiple sources.
Excellent attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
The ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities effectively.
The ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
A proactive approach, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to learn.




The following would be an advantage but is not required:

Experience with SQL, Python, R, or other data-analysis or statistical software.
Experience in financial analysis, investment research, data analytics, business research, or a related area.
Familiarity with SEC filings, including Forms 13F, 13D, and 13G.
Knowledge of securities markets, institutional investment management, or financial instruments.
Experience working with large financial or transactional datasets.
An interest in securities litigation, class actions, or litigation analytics.




Why You Will Love It Here!

Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model
Your Future: Professional Development Reimbursement, including access to SS&C University
Work/Life Balance: Competitive holiday scheme
Your Wellbeing: Competitive benefits designed to support the wellbeing of our staff
Diversity & Inclusion: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity
Training: Hands-On, Team-Customised throughout your career

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds to enable us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking and conversation. It's important to us that we strive to have a workforce that is diverse in the widest sense.

Thank you for your interest in SS&C! If applicable, to further explore this opportunity, please apply directly with us through our Careers page on our corporate website @ www.ssctech.com/careers.

You will work with financial and trading data, legal and regulatory filings, institutional investor information, and internal analytical models to support the evaluation of complex litigation matters.

You will be given hands-on responsibility from an early stage and gain broad exposure to securities markets, institutional investors, class action litigation, and data-driven financial analysis.


What You Will Get To Do:

  • Assist with the calculation and analysis of potential damages and settlement recoveries in securities class actions, including securities fraud, IPO, merger, and other shareholder litigation matters.
  • Collect, validate, and analyse financial, trading, market, and litigation data used in case evaluations and recovery estimates.
  • Conduct research on securities class actions, court filings, settlement notices, regulatory filings, and relevant market developments.
  • Review legal filings and settlement documentation to identify class definitions, relevant securities, eligibility requirements, and potential recovery opportunities.
  • Assist with research and analysis of institutional investors and prospective clients, including their investment strategies, portfolio holdings, SEC filings, assets under management, and potential exposure to litigation opportunities.
  • Support the development and maintenance of financial, statistical, and predictive models used to evaluate potential litigation outcomes, damages, and recoveries.
  • Support the preparation and maintenance of loss estimates, price-drop analyses, case valuations, and other internal and client-facing analytics.

  • Contribute to the continued development and improvement of research processes, analytical methodologies, databases, and internal tools.

We are looking for a candidate with a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and an interest in working with financial information and complex datasets.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience working with data and the ability to analyse and interpret complex datasets.
  • Strong research skills and the ability to collect, evaluate, and combine information from multiple sources.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • The ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities effectively.
  • The ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
  • A proactive approach, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to learn.

  • Experience with SQL, Python, R, or other data-analysis or statistical software.

  • Familiarity with SEC filings, including Forms 13F, 13D, and 13G.
  • Knowledge of securities markets, institutional investment management, or financial instruments.
  • Experience working with large financial or transactional datasets.
  • An interest in securities litigation, class actions, or litigation analytics.

Title: Dataanalytiker til Brugeraktivering
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Brugeraktivering (Markedsføring og Brugerkontakt) bruger DR's egne kontaktpunkter — email, push, in-app og bannere — og førstepartsdata til at skabe relevant, public service-orienteret kontakt med brugerne på tværs af DRTV, DR Lyd og dr.dk. Kontaktpunkterne spiller forskellige roller gennem hele brugerrejsen — fra positionering og interesse til opdagelse, brug og genaktivering. Vi styrer efter både at nå bredt og at skabe dokumenterbar effekt, og vi søger en dataanalytiker, der kan give teamet det data- og indsigtsfundament, det kræver.

Ansvar og arbejdsopgaver

Analyse, dækning og effekt


Kvantitative analyser af brugeradfærd, kanalperformance og kampagneeffekt på tværs af DRTV, DR Lyd og dr.dk
Måling af dækning: unik rækkevidde, frekvens og dækning i prioriterede målgrupper — så vi ved, om vi når de rigtige brugere
Effektmåling og inkrementalitet: design og drift af lift-måling gennem holdout- og kontrolgrupper for aktiverende indsatser — så vi kan svare på, hvad vi faktisk flytter, ikke bare hvad vi nåede ud til
Være med til i samarbejde med Analyse at udvikle måling, der passer til indsatsens formål — også for positionerende og relationelle indsatser, hvor effekten ikke er en klik-konvertering
Mønstre i login, retention, frekvens og segmentrespons — og udlede, hvornår og hvordan brugere med størst sandsynlighed kan aktiveres
Omsætte adfærd til hypoteser, teste dem og levere konklusioner i et format, der kan handles på


Det tekniske fundament — data der bare virker


Bygge og vedligeholde dashboards, der gør teamet datadrevet (email, push, in-app, bannere, flows)
Sikre korrekte, stabile og veldefinerede events og datafelter — og forstå datastrømmene fra CDP og CEP
Udtrække og formatere data til segmentering, personalisering og effektmåling


Samarbejde på tværs


Du bliver en del af Brugeraktivering, men understøtter også Medieplanlægning med data — konkret vedligehold af effektmodellen og kampagne-/dækningsdashboards, så beslutninger om investering og kampagneeffekt hviler på et stabilt grundlag


Om rollen

Datamodenheden i vores felt er under opbygning — så en stor del af det første år handler om at bygge fundamentet: korrekte events, klar struktur på login/retention/frekvens, operationelle dashboards og bedre måling af både dækning og effekt. Det er præcis her, du får indflydelse. På sigt er ambitionen at bevæge sig mod mere avanceret modellering, efterhånden som datagrundlaget modnes.

Du bliver en del af et team på tværs af CRM, indhold, kampagner og analyse, og du refererer til teamlederen for Brugeraktivering.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du har en uddannelse inden for fx statistik, data science, økonomi eller lignende — eller tilsvarende erfaring — og at du er særligt stærk inden for:


Analyse af brugeradfærd, flows og segmentperformance
SQL og dashboarding (fx Mixpanel, MoEngage, Power BI eller Tableau)
Databehandling, datamodellering og datakvalitet
At formidle komplekse indsigter præcist og forståeligt — så de bliver brugt


Det er en fordel, hvis du desuden har:


Erfaring med et CDP/CEP-setup (vi arbejder i Segment og MoEngage) og et data warehouse (fx BigQuery)
Lettere Python til datarens, API-kald og automatisering
Forståelse for brugerrejser i streaming og audio/on-demand


Som person er du grundig og nysgerrig. Du kan tage et bredt mål og gøre det målbart, og du siger det tydeligt, når tallene ikke kan bære en konklusion. Du trives med at bygge noget op, hvor ikke alt er på plads fra start, og du ved, hvornår en analyse er god nok til at blive brugt.

Vi tilbyder


En rolle hvor du er med til at sætte standarden for, hvordan DR måler effekten af kommunikationen til brugerne
Et stort førstepartsdatagrundlag på tværs af DRTV, DR Lyd og dr.dk og et moderne setup med BigQuery, Segment, MoEngage og Mixpanel
Kort vej fra analyse til handling: dine tal indgår direkte i teamets prioritering
Faglig udvikling mod mere avanceret modellering, efterhånden som datagrundlaget modnes
Arbejde der handler om, at flere danskere får glæde af DR's indhold
Fuldtidsstilling (37 timer/uge) med tiltrædelse 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst (AC)


Kontakt

DR ønsker at afspejle samfundet. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, religion, handicap og etnisk baggrund til at søge.

Du kommer til at arbejde i DR Byen, som har metro lige til døren.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte teamleder for Brugeraktivering Søren Ole Andersen, srand@dr.dk, hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, dit cv og relevante eksamenspapirer.

Stillinger i DR søges udelukkende elektronisk.

Du søger ved at klikke på "Søg stillingen" i højre side.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 14. oktober 2026 kl. 12.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 43-44.
