Title: Lead Product Data Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Tech-first. Ego-free. User-obsessed. Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insights they need to make better financial decisions — all directly connected to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.







The role




We need someone who owns product analytics — not just executes it. You'll set the direction for how Skatteguiden uses data to understand its users and make product decisions, and you'll be the person who raises the bar for what good analytics looks like here.




You'll work closely with product managers across our product teams and have real influence on what gets built and why. This isn't a support function. It's a lead role with ownership.







What you'll be working on




Own the product analytics function — define the strategy, set the standards, and drive adoption across product teams
Define and maintain core product metrics and KPIs across the organisation
Design and run experiments — from hypothesis to conclusion
Analyse user behaviour and funnels to identify growth opportunities and friction points
Build scalable dashboards and reporting in close collaboration with the data team
Translate findings into concrete recommendations for product leadership and senior stakeholders







What you bring




Strong SQL skills and experience with complex data modelling
Experience with Snowflake, dbt, Lightdash, Evidence or comparable tooling.
Solid product analytics experience — you've worked closely with product teams and understand what drives a digital product
Strong experimentation design and statistical analysis skills
A track record of owning a product analytics function, not just contributing to one
Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Self-directed and structured — you can take an ambiguous question and turn it into a sharp analysis







Nice to have




Experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse
Experience with Lightdash, Tableau, or comparable BI tools
Python for data processing and analysis







What we offer







Ownership of the product analytics function at one of Denmark's fastest-growing fintech companies
Direct influence on product direction and a seat at the table where decisions are made
A strong data team with high professional standards and a modern tech stack
The opportunity to build something — not inherit a finished function
Office first in Copenhagen — five minutes from Rådhuspladsen, lunch at Claus Meyer, dinner covered if the day runs long







Practical




Start: As soon as possible

Reports to: Head of Data & Operations Planning

Salary: Competitive and based on experience







Our Lean Recruitment Process




Screening call with Christian Payne, 30 min (online)
45-minute onsite meeting with hiring manager and product manager
1-hour onsite case session with hiring manager and team member, followed by a short conversation with Nikolai (CEO), 30 min

Title: Associate Specialist, Purchase Research & Intelligence
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Drive meaningful change

Are you motivated by turning data into insights that influence business decisions? Join our Purchase Research & Intelligence team and help strengthen the analytical foundation behind one of our core commercial functions. In this role, you'll combine data, analytics, and business understanding to support decision-making, improve processes, and contribute to the continued development of a growing and data-driven Purchase organization.

Get a glimpse of our world

Purchase Research & Intelligence (PRI) is the data and reporting function within our Purchase organization. As a recently established team within Commercial Development & Enablement, PRI supports Purchase with reporting, analytics, and commercial insights that enable informed decision-making and continuous improvement.

As part of the commercial organization, Purchase is the team's primary stakeholder and internal customer. Title: BI & Business Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vi søger en analytisk stærk og forretningsorienteret BI & Business Analyst, der brænder for at omsætte data til værdifulde indsigter og skabe sammenhæng mellem forretningens behov og de tekniske løsninger.




I rollen bliver du en central sparringspartner for både Commercial, Production, IT og Finance. Du får en nøglerolle i at forstå forretningens udfordringer, identiﬁcere behov og omsætte dem til brugbare BI-løsninger i tæt samarbejde med både interne interessenter og vores eksterne BI-leverandør.




Du kommer til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem data, teknologi og forretning, hvor din evne til at skabe overblik og forståelse bliver afgørende for virksomhedens fortsatte udvikling.




👉 CFO, Anders Baltzer Thygesen udtaler: "Noget af det bedste ved at arbejde hos os er samarbejdet på tværs af organisationen. Som BI & Business Analyst kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger fra mange forskellige funktioner og får mulighed for at påvirke, hvordan vi bruger data til at udvikle forretningen. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores rejse mod at blive endnu mere datadrevne, og dine idéer og indsigter vil blive lyttet til."




Dine ansvarsområder

Som BI & Business Analyst får du ansvar for at understøtte organisationen med analyser og indsigter, der styrker beslutningsgrundlaget på tværs af virksomheden. Du bliver den naturlige forbindelse mellem forretningen og BI-udviklingen og får en aktiv rolle i at sikre, at løsningerne skaber reel værdi for brugerne.




Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

At indsamle, udfordre og kvaliﬁcere krav fra forretningen
At omsætte forretningsmæssige behov til konkrete analyse- og rapporteringsløsninger At udvikle dashboards, rapporter og visualiseringer, der understøtter ledelsens og organisationens beslutninger
At samarbejde med vores eksterne BI-partner omkring datamodeller og back-end udvikling At bidrage til den løbende udvikling og optimering af virksomhedens BI-landskab
At identiﬁcere muligheder for bedre udnyttelse af data på tværs af systemer, processer og funktioner




Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har et par års erfaring inden for Business Intelligence, analyse eller datavisualisering og motiveres af at skabe forretningsværdi gennem data. Du er nysgerrig af natur og trives med at sætte dig ind i nye problemstillinger, systemer og processer.




Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

Har arbejdet med et eller ﬂere front-end BI-værktøjer
Har erfaring med Power BI og gerne DAX
Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for eksempelvis Finance, Business Intelligence, IT eller lignende
Har en grundlæggende forståelse for systemarkitektur og databaser Har kendskab til SQL og relationelle databaser




Det vigtigste er dog, at du har en stærk forretningsforståelse og evner at omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til løsninger, der skaber værdi for brugerne. Du kommunikerer let med forskellige interessenter og formår at bygge bro mellem tekniske muligheder og forretningsmæssige behov.




Som person

Du er struktureret og analytisk i din tilgang, men samtidig nysgerrig og initiativrig. Du motiveres af at ﬁnde forbedringsmuligheder og udfordre eksisterende arbejdsgange, når der er potentiale for at skabe bedre løsninger.




Vi forestiller os, at du:

Er proaktiv og tager ejerskab for dine opgaver
Er stærk til at skabe relationer og samarbejde på tværs af organisationen
Er nysgerrig på forretningen og interesseret i at forstå, hvad der driver værdiskabelsen Trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og teamwork




Vi tilbyder

Hos os bliver du en del af et solidt og engageret Finance team, og du får en central rolle med stor berøringsﬂade på tværs af organisationen og mulighed for at gøre en mærkbar forskel. Du kommer til at have dit virke i et fagligt stærkt miljø, hvor samarbejde, udvikling og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.




Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

En rolle med stor synlighed og indﬂydelse
Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af virksomhedens BI-setup
Tæt samarbejde med både forretningen og eksterne specialister
Gode faglige og personlige udviklingsmuligheder
Et uformelt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø med fokus på samarbejde og resultater




☝️Lyder det som noget for dig?

Hvis du motiveres af at skabe værdi gennem data og trives i rollen som bindeled mellem mennesker, processer og teknologi, ser vi frem til at høre fra dig.




Og har du spørgsmål om stillingen, så ræk gerne ud til CFO, Anders Baltzer Thygesen på mail ANTH@bellagroup.dk




Hvem er vi? 

Bellagroup er en af Danmarks førende hospitality-virksomheder og driver hoteller, venues, konferencer og events i København. Vores B Corp-certificerede forretning bygger på formålet “Hosting Moments That Matter”. Hvert år byder vi mere end 1 million gæster fra hele verden velkommen. 




På tværs af Bella Center Copenhagen og vores tre internationale hoteller – Copenhagen Marriott Hotel, AC Hotel Bella Sky Copenhagen og Crowne Plaza Copenhagen Towers – råder vi over næsten 1.600 værelser samt mere end 65.000 m² fleksible arealer, møde- og eventfaciliteter. 




Hos Bellagroup starter det hele med mennesker – vores gæster, vores kolleger og de samarbejdspartnere, vi skaber oplevelser sammen med. Det er derfor vi siger: ”When you’re here, it matters”.

Title: Financial Data Management Consultant, Datadriven Banking, Netcompany Banking Services
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description



Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping the financial sector turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.



Netcompany Banking Services 

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.



Responsibilities & technologies



You will become part of a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their businesses through data and insights, working at the intersection of technology and finance. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data. To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in financial data management.



Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.



Your responsibilites will typically include:



Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.



Structuring and collection of data from various sources.



Implementation of financial business logic on data for use in reporting.



Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.



Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.



About you



You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within finance and data management, probably from a bank, an asset manager or similar. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex financial data and challenges. You thrive in an environment focused on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.



To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:



ETL and Database technologies.



Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.



Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.



Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.



The financial sector, including regulatory reporting in the banking sector.



Join an inclusive community 



At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring. 



As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being. 



As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career. 



Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.



All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.



We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Title: Byg fremtidens dataløsninger i Nykredit-koncernen
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være med til at bygge næste generation af dataløsninger for Treasury- og risikoområdet? Og vil du sætte retning for Nykredit-koncernens dataagenda? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Data er afgørende for en moderne finansiel virksomhed. Nykredit-koncernen moderniserer sit datalandskab, og i Treasury & Risk Insights skal flere forretningskritiske løsninger flyttes til den nye dataplatform. Vi søger derfor en senior dataanalytiker, der vil forme næste generation af dataløsninger for Treasury- og risikoområdet. Du får reel indflydelse på både løsningerne, teknologien og vores måde at arbejde på.

Nykredit-koncernen er ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det betyder, at vi kan dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, når det går os godt, og at vi påtager os et særligt ansvar over for det samfund, vi er en del af. Det vil du også opleve, når vi kan byde dig velkommen som senior dataanalytiker.

En reel transformationsopgave

I Treasury & Risk Insights leverer vi data og løsninger til kapital-, likviditets- og risikostyring samt myndighedsrapportering. Det stiller høje krav til kvalitet, transparens og stabilitet.

Nu skal løsningerne moderniseres og flyttes til Nykredit-koncernens nye dataplatform. Vi skal ikke blot kopiere det eksisterende, men forstå, hvad der skaber værdi, forenkle og bygge til fremtidens behov.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver

Du skal styrke datafundamentet for Treasury- og risikoområdet i tæt samarbejde med udviklere, platformansvarlige, dataejere og forretningen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:


Omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov til robuste dataløsninger.
Udarbejde prototyper i SQL og moderne dataværktøjer.
Samarbejde med udviklere om at omsætte design til velfungerende produkter.
Drive migreringen til Nykredits nye dataplatform.
Indarbejde datakvalitet, dokumentation og governance i løsningerne.



Teknologi, der giver nye muligheder

Databricks bliver central sammen med Azure, SQL og moderne principper for datamodellering, integration og automatisering. AI er allerede en del af værktøjskassen og åbner nye muligheder for at analysere, udvikle og skalere løsninger. Du behøver ikke kende alle teknologierne fra første dag. Det vigtigste er en solid datafaglighed og lysten til at lære og omsætte nye muligheder til løsninger, der skaber værdi.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Din titel er mindre vigtig. Du kan være dataanalytiker, business analyst, data engineer, udvikler eller noget helt femte. Det afgørende er, at du kombinerer forretningsforståelse med interesse for data og teknologi.

Vi forestiller os, at du:


har erfaring med datamodellering og komplekse datastrukturer,
trives i feltet mellem forretning og teknologi,
ser muligheder i nye teknologier og arbejdsformer,

Title: Senior Marketing analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst based in Denmark.

This is a senior analytical role focused on improving marketing performance and enabling smarter, data-driven investment decisions. You will shape the logic behind marketing budget allocation across products, channels, and traffic sources. The role combines advanced analytics, experimentation, performance marketing economics, and predictive modeling. You will develop Early LTV models and analytical frameworks that help teams react quickly to performance changes. You will also contribute to AI-powered analytics initiatives designed to uncover root causes, opportunities, and anomalies. Working in a distributed international environment, you’ll have significant scope to turn complex data into practical business decisions.

Accountabilities


Design the high-level logic, rules, and models used to allocate marketing budgets across products and traffic sources, validate the approach, and prepare it for automation.
Develop and validate Early LTV metrics and models to support intra-week performance marketing decisions and dynamic budget allocation.
Build analytical frameworks and tools for performance diagnostics, identifying performance drivers, growth opportunities, and anomalies across products, channels, and campaigns.
Contribute to the development of an internal AI-based analytics tool focused on performance analysis, root-cause detection, and opportunity discovery.
Support the unified BI layer through metric definition, data validation, and selected analytical use cases.
Translate analytical findings into actionable business rules, recommendations, and decision-making models.


Requirements


Demonstrated experience with A/B testing, experimentation, and statistical analysis.
Strong SQL skills, with the ability to independently work with large datasets, develop complex analytical queries, and validate data quality.
Strong knowledge of mathematical statistics and experimentation, including the ability to design validation and backtesting methodologies and correctly interpret results.
Solid understanding of performance marketing economics and key metrics, including LTV, CAC/CPA, ROI/ROAS, conversion funnels, cohorts, and attribution.
Ability to develop decision-making models and communicate analytical findings through clear, practical recommendations.
Strong proficiency with Google Sheets and/or Excel.
Experience working with BI tools such as Superset, Tableau, or Power BI.
English proficiency at B2 level or above.
Experience with Python for data analysis and modeling is a strong advantage.
Experience with forecasting, optimization, budget allocation models, Early LTV/predictive LTV, or automated analytical products and AI/LLM-based analytics tools is highly valued.


Benefits


Fully remote, full-time opportunity.
Initial pay level or salary range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.
28 calendar days of vacation per year.
7 wellness days per year that can be used for personal matters, recovery, or rest without taking sick leave.
Referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful candidate recommendations.
50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and professional meetings.
Corporate discounts for English lessons.
Health benefits, including reimbursement of up to $1,000 gross per year per employee where corporate medical insurance is not available. This can be used toward personal health insurance or eligible medical expenses for the employee and close relatives.
Workplace support, including equipment and workplace essentials in offices or coworking locations. Where applicable, reimbursement of up to $1,000 gross once every three years is available for coworking costs or home-office equipment such as a desk, chair, and internet.
An internal gamified recognition system where colleagues can award bonuses that can be exchanged for merchandise, team-building activities, massage certificates, and other rewards.
A remote-first environment with an international team working across different locations.


How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Title: Business Intelligence Consultant
Company: SameSystem - Retail WFM | Part of ECIT
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
BI Consultant




Please note that fluency in Danish is a requirement for this position.

Due to the summer holidays, please expect a longer processing time.




SameSystem

Are you ready to turn data into real commercial value for some of Europe's largest retail and hospitality brands? At SameSystem, we empower companies like Bestseller, Nike, Normal, and Matas to optimize their operations daily with our cutting-edge AI-driven Workforce Management Solution. We're looking for a BI Consultant who is as comfortable building a clean dashboard as sitting across the table from a customer explaining what it means for their business.

This is a full-time role, and you'll join our Customer Success team in Copenhagen. You'll own the business intelligence and reporting side of our platform: building and maintaining reports in our BI tool, Sisense, and being the person our customers and colleagues turn to when a number needs to make sense. We've deliberately placed this role in Customer Success rather than in a back-office data team, because the reporting is only worth as much as the commercial insight it drives. This role suits someone who is happy behind the screen building things properly, but who does not want to only sit behind the screen.

This is a new role, so the right person will have real influence over how we build, package, and deliver the analytics side of our platform.




Key responsibilities

Building the reports

Design, build, and maintain BI reports and dashboards in Sisense, with strong attention to data integrity, performance, and usability
Translate customer and internal requirements into robust data models and reporting logic
Own reporting quality across accounts, including validation, troubleshooting, and iterative improvement
Develop new reporting capabilities and scope custom development work as our customers' needs grow




Working with customers

Join customer meetings and represent the BI and analytics part of the SameSystem platform
Talk specific development and scoping with customers, and translate their business questions into what we can actually build
Help customers see the value in their data, and support Customer Success and Sales in retention, upselling, and expansion through analytics
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Support to feed customer needs back into the platform




What we're looking for

Proven experience building reports and dashboards in a BI tool. Experience with Sisense is a strong plus; solid experience with a comparable tool (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik) is very welcome
Enough experience under your belt to own your work end to end
Strong SQL and data modelling skills, and the instinct to build things properly rather than just quickly
Commercial acumen. You understand that a report exists to drive a decision, and you're comfortable talking value and scope with customers
Confidence in client-facing settings, presenting clearly to both operational and managerial stakeholders
The balance we keep coming back to: someone who can do focused, hands-on build work and also step into a customer meeting and hold their own
A self-starter who takes ownership and isn't afraid to share ideas. Execution matters
Nice to have: comfort scoping and pricing development work. If pricing is new to you, that's fine, we can teach it
Fluency in Danish and English; additional European languages are a plus
Familiarity with retail operations or workforce management is a plus




What you'll get

At SameSystem, we are committed to transforming retail and hospitality through cutting-edge technology. Joining our team means:

Working in a dynamic environment where innovation drives success.
Contributing to the success of over 185,000 employees across 12,500+ stores in 24 countries.
Access to professional growth opportunities in a company that values expertise and collaboration.
Being part of a supportive culture that prioritizes work-life balance and employee satisfaction.
Lots of social activities and fun parties as well as "clubs" run by employees where SameSystem sponsors going to a sauna, playing badminton, drinking port wine, or whatever else the team can think of.
Lunch and as much coffee, soda or energy drink as you can muster.




If you have any questions about this position, please reach out to Nikolai May Yde at nikolai.yde@samesystem.com.

Title: Skab forretningsindsigter der påvirker beslutninger
Description:
Er du den der i en central rolle kan analysere, håndtere og synliggøre tallene for forretningen, så vi får omsat indsigter til forretningsbeslutninger?

I Andel Energi søger vi en erfaren kommerciel Forretnings- og Markedsanalytiker, der vil være med til at sikre, at vi træffer de rigtige beslutninger i en forretning under konstant udvikling.

"Vi står midt i en spændende fusion, hvor tre selskaber samles omkring en fælles måde at forstå og styre forretningen på. Vores analyser spiller en vigtig rolle i at skabe indsigt og retning, for at prioritere de indsatser, der giver værdi for både kunder og forretning” fortæller afdelingsleder Adin Gradascevic.

Vi udvikler fremtidens energiselskab

Du får en central rolle i krydsfeltet mellem analyse, økonomi og kommerciel forretning, hvor du er med til at understøtte beslutningskraften i Andel Energi. Som en del af Performance & Data afdelingen omsætter og formidler du indsigt til anbefalinger, der skaber retning og resultater.

Sammen med forretningen, finance og ledelsen arbejder du med spørgsmål som: Hvordan udvikler vores salg og kundeportefølje sig, og hvad driver udviklingen? Hvorfor performer vi bedre eller dårligere end forventet? Og hvor skal vi sætte ind for at løfte de kommercielle resultater, så vi gør det endnu lettere for danskerne at vælge grøn energi og elektrificere hverdagen?

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:


Drive og formidle performance på tværs af forretningen
Analysere udviklingen i salg, kundeadfærd og kommercielle KPI'er
Identificere muligheder og risici samt anbefale konkrete initiativer
Udarbejde analyser og beslutningsoplæg, der understøtter ledelsens beslutninger
Facilitere performancemøder med ledere og nøgleinteressenter og sikre, at aftalte indsatser følges til dørs
Videreudvikle KPI-strukturer, rapportering og styringsmodeller


Du vil opleve, at dine analyser ikke ender i en rapport, men bruges målrettet til at prioritere investeringer, forbedre kundeoplevelsen og forbedre vores position på et energimarked i hastig udvikling. Vores målsætning er klar: Vi vil skabe Danmarks største og mest innovative energiselskab.

En hverdag med både kommercielle indsigter og relationer

Din hverdag vil både bestå af løbende performance- og budgetopfølgning, facilitering af performancemøder, udvikling af rapportering og tæt dialog med forretningen. Du skal kunne gå fra det detaljerede datagrundlag til det større kommercielle billede - og formidle dine indsigter, så de kan omsættes til handling.

Det er en rolle for dig, der ikke blot vil fortælle, hvad der er sket, men også vil være med til at forstå hvorfor det sker, hvad det betyder for forretningen, og hvor vi skal sætte ind.

Du bliver en del af et team på tolv kolleger, hvor faglig sparring, samarbejde og fælles mål går hånd i hånd med en uformel og hjælpsom kultur.

Hvem er du?

Du er en erfaren analytiker med solid forretningsforståelse og et kommercielt mindset. Du motiveres af at skabe forretningsværdi gennem indsigter og trives med at arbejde tæt på beslutningstagere. Som person er du nysgerrig, initiativrig og trives med at udfordre eksisterende antagelser på en konstruktiv måde. Du følger op, skaber fremdrift og bidrager til et godt samarbejde omkring dig.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:


Har en relevant videregående uddannelse, fx cand.merc., og erfaring fra en abonnementsforretning eller anden kommerciel forretning
Har solid erfaring med performance management, kommercielle analyser og evnen til at omsætte indsigter til konkrete anbefalinger og handling
Er en dygtig formidler, der kan gøre komplekse sammenhænge enkle og relevante og skabe dialog på tværs af forretningen
Formidler komplekse emner på en klar og engagerende måde. Skaber fremdrift og gode relationer i dialogen mellem forskellige dele af forretningen
Er fortrolig med Excel og PowerPoint og bruger dem til at skabe overblik og formidle dine indsigter effektivt


Et Andel Energi i bevægelse – vil du med?

Lyder det som noget for dig, så send din ansøgning og dit CV via linket i annoncen. For at sikre gældende GDPR-lovgivning modtager vi kun ansøgninger via jobannoncen. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Adin Gradascevic på telefon nummer 28344037.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

Vi afholder samtaler i to omgange. Første samtale er med afdelingsleder og handler primært om opgaveløsning og faglige kompetencer. Går du videre til anden samtale, vil du inden få en case samt besvare to analyser: en logisk og en adfærdsanalyse. Disse er udgangspunkt for dialogen til samtalen.

Første samtaler afholdes uge 43. Anden samtaler med case og analyser afholdes d.27 oktober.

Vil du vide mere om rekrutteringsproces og kultur kan du læse mere på vores koncernhjemmeside: andel.dk/karriere.

Vi kombinerer formål, faglighed og fællesskab

Hos Andel Energi kommer du til en arbejdsplads, der engagerer sig i at gøre det nemt for vores kunder at få en grønnere hverdag. Andel Energi er en del af det andelsejede Andel, og vi arbejder langsigtet og formålsdrevet for at skabe en grønnere fremtid. I vores organisation er der plads til nye idéer, forandringer og fællesskab – og vores kultur bygger på tillid og samarbejde.

Læs mere om Andel Energi på hjemmesiden: Andelenergi.dk.

#Andelenergi

Som kollega i Andel Energi er du en del af den grønne omstilling

I Andel Energi leverer vi el, naturgas og energirådgivning til mere end 1,2 mio. privat- og erhvervskunder. Som Danmarks største energiselskab har vi et stort ansvar for at sætte fart på den grønne omstilling.

Derfor arbejder vi for at skabe energiløsninger, som er gode for alle og gode for fremtiden. Det skal være let for alle at spare på energien og træffe grønne valg.

Andel Energi er en del af Andel, en andelsejet energi- og fibernetkoncern, der skaber velfærd og vækst i det danske samfund gennem leverance af vital infrastruktur og fremtidssikrede energiløsninger. Det gør vi, når vi investerer visionært i fibernet, vindmøller, energiløsninger og ladeinfrastruktur til elbiler. I Andel vil vi være hinandens bedste forbindelse. Vi har 2,8 millioner kundeforhold og 1.700 kolleger, der tager ansvar for at skabe en fælles fremtid – for vores kunder, andelshavere og vores omverden. Andel har hovedsæde i Svinninge og primære lokationer i Ballerup, Haslev og Virum.

I Andel Energi hylder vi fællesskabet og forskelligheden og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold at søge vores ledige stillinger.

Er du den der i en central rolle kan analysere, håndtere og synliggøre tallene for forretningen, så vi får omsat indsigter til forretningsbeslutninger?

I Andel Energi søger vi en erfaren kommerciel Forretnings- og Markedsanalytiker, der vil være med til at sikre, at vi træffer de rigtige beslutninger i en forretning under konstant udvikling.

"Vi står midt i en spændende fusion, hvor tre selskaber samles omkring en fælles måde at forstå og styre forretningen på. Vores analyser spiller en vigtig rolle i at skabe indsigt og retning, for at prioritere de indsatser, der giver værdi for både kunder og forretning” fortæller afdelingsleder Adin Gradascevic.

Vi udvikler fremtidens energiselskab

Du får en central rolle i krydsfeltet mellem analyse, økonomi og kommerciel forretning, hvor du er med til at understøtte beslutningskraften i Andel Energi. Som en del af Performance & Data afdelingen omsætter og formidler du indsigt til anbefalinger, der skaber retning og resultater.

Sammen med forretningen, finance og ledelsen arbejder du med spørgsmål som: Hvordan udvikler vores salg og kundeportefølje sig, og hvad driver udviklingen? Hvorfor performer vi bedre eller dårligere end forventet? Og hvor skal vi sætte ind for at løfte de kommercielle resultater, så vi gør det endnu lettere for danskerne at vælge grøn energi og elektrificere hverdagen?

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

  • Drive og formidle performance på tværs af forretningen
  • Analysere udviklingen i salg, kundeadfærd og kommercielle KPI'er
  • Identificere muligheder og risici samt anbefale konkrete initiativer
  • Udarbejde analyser og beslutningsoplæg, der understøtter ledelsens beslutninger
  • Facilitere performancemøder med ledere og nøgleinteressenter og sikre, at aftalte indsatser følges til dørs
  • Videreudvikle KPI-strukturer, rapportering og styringsmodeller

Du vil opleve, at dine analyser ikke ender i en rapport, men bruges målrettet til at prioritere investeringer, forbedre kundeoplevelsen og forbedre vores position på et energimarked i hastig udvikling. Vores målsætning er klar: Vi vil skabe Danmarks største og mest innovative energiselskab.

En hverdag med både kommercielle indsigter og relationer

Din hverdag vil både bestå af løbende performance- og budgetopfølgning, facilitering af performancemøder, udvikling af rapportering og tæt dialog med forretningen. Du skal kunne gå fra det detaljerede datagrundlag til det større kommercielle billede - og formidle dine indsigter, så de kan omsættes til handling.

Det er en rolle for dig, der ikke blot vil fortælle, hvad der er sket, men også vil være med til at forstå hvorfor det sker, hvad det betyder for forretningen, og hvor vi skal sætte ind.

Du bliver en del af et team på tolv kolleger, hvor faglig sparring, samarbejde og fælles mål går hånd i hånd med en uformel og hjælpsom kultur.

Hvem er du?

Du er en erfaren analytiker med solid forretningsforståelse og et kommercielt mindset. Du motiveres af at skabe forretningsværdi gennem indsigter og trives med at arbejde tæt på beslutningstagere. Som person er du nysgerrig, initiativrig og trives med at udfordre eksisterende antagelser på en konstruktiv måde. Du følger op, skaber fremdrift og bidrager til et godt samarbejde omkring dig.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

  • Har en relevant videregående uddannelse, fx cand.merc., og erfaring fra en abonnementsforretning eller anden kommerciel forretning
  • Har solid erfaring med performance management, kommercielle analyser og evnen til at omsætte indsigter til konkrete anbefalinger og handling
  • Er en dygtig formidler, der kan gøre komplekse sammenhænge enkle og relevante og skabe dialog på tværs af forretningen
  • Formidler komplekse emner på en klar og engagerende måde. Skaber fremdrift og gode relationer i dialogen mellem forskellige dele af forretningen
  • Er fortrolig med Excel og PowerPoint og bruger dem til at skabe overblik og formidle dine indsigter effektivt

Lyder det som noget for dig, så send din ansøgning og dit CV via linket i annoncen. For at sikre gældende GDPR-lovgivning modtager vi kun ansøgninger via jobannoncen. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Adin Gradascevic på telefon nummer 28344037.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

Første samtaler afholdes uge 43. Anden samtaler med case og analyser afholdes d.27 oktober.

Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Bliver du motiveret af at strukturere datasæt, udarbejde forretningsanalyser samt udvikle rapporteringer, som understøtter beslutningerne i Danmarks største forsikringsselskab? Er du analytisk stærk, kan samarbejde med en bred vifte af kolleger og har en solid økonomisk og forretningsmæssig baggrund? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter som Portfolio Analyst til Portfolio Management i Commercial Lines i Danmark.

Om jobbet | Tag del i ansvaret for vores lønsomhedsstyring

Som Portfolio Analyst i Portfolio Management & Insights bliver du en central del af Commercial Lines DK. Du får ansvaret for dine egne nøgleområder inden for den operationelle rytme i porteføljestyringen og bidrager selvstændigt med indsigter og anbefalinger, der forbedrer styring af porteføljens performance.

Dine primære opgaver vil inkludere:


Løbende overvågning af produkter, prissætning, indtegning og afgang samt skadesudvikling
Udførelse af analyser og omsætning af komplekse data til indsigter og anbefalinger
Udarbejdelse og vedligehold af rapporteringer
Udarbejdelse og vedligehold af materiale til at bistå Portfolio Manager i den operationelle rytme
Udarbejdelse af beslutningsgrundlag til Portfolio Managers samt ledelsen i Commercial Lines


Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med dine kolleger for at sikre, at vores produkter er både konkurrencedygtige og lønsomme. Du får mulighed for at arbejde i et spændende og dynamisk miljø, hvor du kan anvende og videreudvikle dine kompetencer.

Om os | En central rolle i Trygs Commercial forretning

Du bliver en del af Portfolio Management & Insights, et team på 11 engagerede kolleger heraf 4 analytikere. Hver Portfolio Manager har sin egen portefølje og et tydeligt forretningsmandat, mens analytikerne understøtter med data, rapportering og dybdegående analyser. Fælles for os er en stærk analytisk tilgang og et klart kommercielt fokus. Stemningen i teamet er uformel og tillidsfuld. Vi lægger vægt på at have det godt sammen i en travl hverdag. Torsdagsmorgenmaden er en fast del af kulturen – men aldrig et krav. Vi sparrer tæt, udfordrer hinanden fagligt og deler viden på tværs - sådan træffer vi beslutninger, der holder både på kort og lang sigt.

Organisatorisk er vi en del af Commercial Lines DK, som dækker Trygs danske erhvervs- og industrikunder, der repræsenterer ca. 5 mia. kr. i præmie.

Om dig | Analytisk og nysgerrig

For at lykkes i rollen er det vigtigt, at du har et stærkt analytisk mindset, tænker konceptuelt og formår at opretholde høj kvalitet – også i et travlt arbejdsmiljø.

Da vi søger to nye kolleger, vil opgavernes kompleksitet og ansvar blive tilpasset dit erfaringsniveau. Er du tidligt i karrieren, får du mulighed for at udvikle dig gennem tæt sparring med erfarne kolleger. Har du flere års erfaring, forventer vi, at du i højere grad selvstændigt driver analyser, udfordrer eksisterende processer og bidrager med anbefalinger til ledelsen.

Vi forestiller os, at du har:


erfaring, fx fra en analyse- eller finansenhed
En stærk analytisk baggrund og erfaring med SQL, R eller Python samt kendskab til Power BI
En videregående uddannelse som cand. Merc, aktuar, økonom eller lignende
Erfaring med økonomi, analyser, regnskab og projektarbejde


Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra forsikringsbranchen eller med regnskab, men det er ikke et krav. Du trives med projektarbejde, kan holde mange bolde i luften og har mod på at drive hele processen – fra idé til implementering.

Som person er du udadvendt og pligtopfyldende samt i stand til at skabe relationer og levere resultater inden for dit ansvarsområde.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Send din ansøgning og dit CV senest 11. oktober. Vi opfordrer til, at du undlader at vedhæfte billede i dit CV.

Vi inviterer løbende relevante kandidater til samtale, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag. Når den rette kandidat er fundet, afsluttes rekrutteringsprocessen.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen i øvrigt, er du velkommen til at kontakte leder af Portfolio Management & Analytics, Ajla Idriz, på ajla.idriz@tryg.dk.

Title: Senior Analyst - Consumer Credit Risk & Underwriting
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Klarna, briefly

At Klarna, we're building an everyday finance network, helping over 120 million consumers across 26 countries save time and money, and worry less about their finances.Working at Klarna means taking on problems most companies never get to solve, and being hands-on enough that the interesting part of the work lands with you, not someone else. You'll build with AI, not watch it happen.

This is the stretch zone. Come find out what you're capable of.

About The Role

Klarna is bringing its Fair Financing product live in Denmark. As a Senior Analyst on the credit decisioning team, you'll build and defend the underwriting policies that decide who gets credit in Denmark and on what terms, working from bureau data and models built specifically for the Danish market.

You'll work alongside Product, Risk, and the regional Belgium team to bring that policy onto Klarna's Global Underwriting Platform (GUP), the shared framework that will power credit decisions across markets.

What You'll Do


You'll analyze consumer credit risk using SQL and Danish credit bureau data to find where underwriting policy should tighten or loosen.
You'll work with Product, Risk, and the Danish regional team to bring Denmark’s credit policy onto Klarna's Global Underwriting Platform.
You'll align purchase power and pre-qualification logic for the Danish market across Klarna's App and its One Card product.
You'll monitor how the Danish bureau data feeding your models performs, and flag where sourcing or model quality needs to change.
You'll turn what your analysis shows into policy changes that underwriting, product, and the regional team can act on directly.


Who you are


You've worked in consumer credit risk, underwriting, or credit policy, and you understand how a policy change affects both approval rates and portfolio health.
You're proficient in SQL and comfortable working directly with large, messy datasets.
You know credit bureau data, repayment behavior, and credit risk modeling well enough to spot where the numbers don't add up.
You work through ambiguous or inconsistent policy logic methodically until you find the actual root cause.
You can turn a data finding into a policy change that underwriting, product, and regional teams can each act on.


Bonus points for


A degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.


Things you should know before applying


Working together: we value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.
Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.
Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.
Depending on your background, this could land as an Analyst role or a Data Scientist role — we'll settle the exact title with you once we understand your experience.


Please include a CV in English.

Curious to learn more about Klarna and what it’s like to work here? Explore our career site.

Title: Analytikere til strategisk planlægning i krydsfeltet mellem økonomi og teknik
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du med på et hold af dygtige kollegaer, der arbejder med strategiske og økonomiske analyser med henblik på investering, optimering og udvikling af jernbanen?

I Banedanmark søger vi en til to analytikere med lyst til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem økonomi og teknik. Her kan du både komme til at arbejde med drift, analyser og udvikling af vores prognosemodeller til reinvesteringer i jernbanen, prissætninger i forbindelse med de store infrastrukturprojekter, strategiske og økonomiske analyser med henblik på udvikling af jernbanen samt analyser af klima- og risikoforhold, der kan påvirke jernbanens infrastruktur og behovet for investeringer og vedligehold.

Banedanmark er en af statens største styrelser, hvor mere end 2.500 medarbejdere hver dag sikrer, at Danmarks jernbane udvikles, driftes og vedligeholdes. På hovedkontoret ved Dybbølsbro i København sidder din nye sektion Strategisk Planlægning i hjertet af Banedanmark.

Alt efter dine kvalifikationer, motivation og ønsker til udvikling vil vi sammensætte din opgaveportefølje inden for vores brede portefølje af projekter og analyser.

Optimering og udvikling af jernbanen gennem dataunderstøttet planlægning

Din arbejdsdag vil blive sammensat af forskelligartede opgaver, primært indenfor:


Databearbejdning og analyser med vores prognosemodeller til reinvesteringer i jernbanen
Databaserede analyser bl.a. i form af cost-analyser, der indebærer at opstille scenarier, foretage beregninger og omsætte analyseresultater til beslutningsstøtte
Analyser af klimarelaterede risici og deres mulige konsekvenser for jernbaneinfrastrukturen, herunder arbejde med klimascenarier, data og beslutningsstøtte
Prissætning af anlægs- og fornyelsesprojekter ud fra principperne i Ny Anlægsbudgettering (NAB), der er gældende på Transportministeriets område
Strategiske analyser med henblik på at optimere Banedanmarks forvaltning af infrastrukturen


Analytikere med fokus på samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder

Vi forestiller os, at du har en videregående uddannelse med fokus på kvantitative metoder f.eks. økonom, ingeniør eller lignende, men du kan også have erhvervet den nødvendige viden gennem erhvervserfaring. Hvis du har nogle års erfaring, f.eks. fra en lignende stilling i centraladministrationen eller fra en rådgiver- eller entreprenørvirksomhed vil det være gavnligt, men du kan også godt være nyuddannet. Det vigtigste er, at vi finder den rigtige profil, der bidrager til gruppen, og som har evnerne og interessen for at arbejde i en teknisk, økonomisk og politisk verden.

Det Er Vigtigt, At Du


Har gode analytiske og metodiske evner og trives med data og tal
Kan arbejde på egen hånd og samtidig indgå i samarbejde på tværs af fagområder
Kan dykke ned i detaljer uden at miste det strategiske overblik
Er god til at formidle komplekse problemstillinger enkelt og klart
Kan tage ejerskab over opgaver, styre processer og overholde deadlines


Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med Excel og gerne programmering, fx Python.

Din nye arbejdsplads

Du vil blive en del af sektionen Strategisk Planlægning, hvor du får 20 dygtige og engagerede kollegaer, der arbejder med planlægningen af de projekter, der bliver til konkret jernbane i Danmark. Title: Commercial Insights Manager til Salg & Fastholdelse
Description:
Kan du finde historien i data – og omsætte den til handling, der styrker kommerciel udvikling?

Vi søger en Commercial Insights Manager, der – via data - kan gøre os klogere på vores kunder og styrke grundlaget for vores kommercielle beslutninger. Du bliver en central del af et af OK's mest strategisk prioriterede områder, hvor kundevækst og fastholdelse står højt på agendaen.

Fra data til kommerciel handling

Som Commercial Insights Manager følger du udviklingen, identificerer mønstre og muligheder og sikrer, at vores indsigter bliver omsat til konkrete kommercielle initiativer.

Stillingen er nyoprettet, hvilket giver dig en unik mulighed for at sætte dit præg på rollen. Sammen med dine kolleger bliver du med til at definere rammerne for funktionen, udvikle arbejdsformer og sikre, at data skaber størst mulig værdi for forretningen.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med blandt andre Salg, Partnerskaber, BI, Product Management og Marketing og får en vigtig rolle i at skabe sammenhæng mellem data og forretning.

Dine opgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at:


Analysere udviklingen i salg, churn, leadflow og konvertering og identificere muligheder for vækst og forbedringer
Evaluere effekten af kampagner, kanaler og kommercielle indsatser og omsætte resultaterne til konkrete anbefalinger
Understøtte arbejdet med vores churn prediction-model i tæt samarbejde med BI og omsætte modellens indsigter til handling
Udvikle rapportering og performancevisualisering samt understøtte budgettering, forecasting og performanceopfølgning
Deltagelse i kommercielle tværfaglige udviklingsprojekter
Sikre et stærkt datagrundlag for partneropfølgning og bidrage med analyser og effektmålinger til tværgående projekter


Herudover vil du også løbende løse ad hoc-opgaver, hvor du selv dykker ned i data, finder svar på konkrete forretningsspørgsmål. Det er en naturlig del af rollen, at du både arbejder strategisk og har hænderne nede i data, når behovet opstår.

Vi forestiller os, at du


Har et par års erfaring fra en analytisk og kommerciel rolle i en større og kompleks organisation
Er stærk inden for dataforståelse, analyse, visualisering og datadrevet beslutningsstøtte
Forstår de mekanismer, der driver salg og fastholdelse - gerne fra en abonnementsforretning og med kendskab til fx CLV og CPA
Trives i krydsfeltet mellem forretning, data og teknologi og kan formidle komplekse sammenhænge klart og enkelt
Er nysgerrig på AI og nye teknologier og arbejder proaktivt med at skabe værdi gennem dem


Det vigtigste er ikke, at du kan sætte flueben ved alt. Vi leder efter dig, der kombinerer analytisk styrke med forretningsforståelse og har lyst til at bruge data til at gøre en mærkbar forskel. Du tager ansvar og er god til at skabe resultater i samarbejde med forskellige fagligheder

Vi tilbyder


En rolle med indflydelse, hvor dine analyser og anbefalinger bliver brugt til at træffe kommercielle beslutninger
Et spændende fagligt miljø, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med både forretningen, BI og andre specialister
Et stærkt fællesskab med god energi og en sund kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at lykkes
Gode udviklingsmuligheder og attraktive personalegoder, bl.a. sundheds- og tandforsikring, rabataftaler, en aktiv personaleforening og in-house massageordning
Fleksibilitet og moderne rammer i Viby, så arbejdsliv og privatliv kan hænge godt sammen


Vil du være med til at gøre data til handling?

Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Anne Bay Schimmelmann, Director, Salg & Fastholdelse, på tlf.: 2132 9741.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Vi sætter pris på alles input og supplerer hinandens viden i hverdagen. Sektionen er uformel, og du vil opleve en oprigtig interesse i at føre dig godt ind i fællesskabet og opgaverne.

Sektionen er en del af området Strategisk Asset Management, der består af omkring 40 specialiserede medarbejdere fordelt på tre sektioner.


Alt efter sammensætningen af dine opgaver vil du enten komme til at referere til teamleder Ida Bach Kunckel med ansvaret for prissætninger og økonomiske analyser eller sektionschef André Røssel med ansvaret for prognosemodeller og strategiske analyser. Du får en i begge tilfælde en nærmeste leder, der er tillidsfuld og anerkendende.


Du vil opleve en arbejdsplads med gode muligheder for at vokse og udvikle dig fagligt. Du vil blive kastet hurtigt ud i opgaverne, hvor der vil blive krævet noget af dig, men der vil altid være rum og mulighed for sparring hos din leder og dine kollegaer. Du vil desuden få en høj grad af frihed til at organisere og planlægge din tid og dine opgaver inden for de deadlines, vi har.


Vi arbejder systematisk og målrettet med diversitet, inklusion og ledelse, så Banedanmark har plads til alle, der kan og vil en attraktiv jernbane.


Banedanmark kommer til at opleve en spændende udvikling i kraft af store investeringer i jernbaneinfrastrukturen i fremtiden. Det giver dig som medarbejder mulighed for at udvikle dig og bidrage til, at Danmark forbliver trafikalt forbundet i fremtiden.


Du kan se frem til gode ansættelsesvilkår i offentligt regi, herunder fleksible arbejdsforhold og fokus på work-life balance. Arbejdssted er Carsten Niebuhrs Gade 43, 1577 København V - tæt på Dybbølsbro St. og nemt at komme til uanset om du er med tog, bil eller på cykel. Her får du bl.a. betalt frokostpause, fælles kantine, frugtordning, café og motionsrum.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Hvis du er akademiker, ansættes du efter den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten.


Du indplaceres på baggrund af akademisk anciennitet og erfaring som fuldmægtig på basistrin eller som specialkonsulent jf. gældende overenskomst, som du finder her og Medarbejder- og Kompetencestyrelsens lønoversigt, som du finder her.


Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der vil være tilknyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning på 18,07 %.


Ansøgning og kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionschef André Røssel (tlf. 41879925) eller Ida Bach Kunckel (tlf. 20296450). Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår kan du kontakte vores personalekonsulenter på mail banedanmarkpersonale@BANE.dk.


For at søge stillingen skal du klikke på linket ‘Søg stilling’ og følge instrukserne. Send os din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt, da vi vurderer ansøgningerne og afholder samtaler løbende.


Går du videre fra de indledende samtaler, kan der blive indhentet referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgiver. Du vil blive informeret inden, at der bliver indhentet en reference.


Forskellige perspektiver gør os stærkere. Derfor værdsætter Banedanmark mangfoldighed og opfordrer alle interesserede kandidater, uanset personlig baggrund, til at søge.

Title: Digital Innovation&Transformation Sup
Description:
Manufacturing Intelligence & Data Supporter

DPM KA Business Support | Temporary Position (12 Months)

Location: Kalundborg

Department: Drug Product Manufacturing KA, Business Support

Do you want to be the link between data and decision-making?

Are you motivated by turning data into solutions that create real value in manufacturing? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology, business, and people? If so, you may be the Manufacturing Intelligence & Data Supporter we are looking for.

In this role, you will be a key partner to both manufacturing and the business. You will not only work with data, visualization, and digital solutions, but also understand user needs and translate them into solutions that support better decision-making and increased productivity. A significant part of the role is therefore being close to the business and understanding how data can support daily operations and long-term decision-making.

You will play a central role as the link between operations, data, and decision-makers.

The Position Consists Of Two Main Areas Of Responsibility

Data Engineering and Productivity Improvements

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Identifying and understanding business needs for data.
Preparing, structuring, and modelling data for analysis and visualization.
Developing and maintaining dashboards and visualization solutions.
Supporting productivity improvements through digital solutions.
Contributing to the development of software solutions such as Power BI, RPA, web applications, or similar tools.
Collaborating closely with users and stakeholders to ensure solutions create value.


Local Data Support

You Will


Ensure visibility and understanding of data and data flows across DPM KA.
Develop and maintain data flows from primary data sources such as PLC systems and SQL servers to Novo Nordisk’s Enterprise Data Lake.
Support high data quality and availability.
Contribute to the development of future solutions within Databricks and AI-based data platforms.
Ensure robust and scalable data solutions for the organization.


Who are you?

We welcome candidates with diverse backgrounds and levels of experience.

Experience from a manufacturing environment is an advantage, but not essential. Most importantly, you are curious, business-oriented, and motivated by understanding users’ challenges and translating them into value-creating solutions.

You hold a relevant educational background within areas such as Data Science, Computer Science, Software Development, Automation, Digitalisation, Engineering, IT, or a related field.

We are open to both Bachelor's and Master's degree holders.

We imagine that you have experience in several of the following areas:


Data visualization using Power BI, Grafana, or similar tools.
Data modelling and data preparation.
Programming in C#, SQL, Python, or similar technologies.
Development of data flows and data integrations.
Statistical analysis and data processing.
Dashboard development and reporting.
Modern data platforms and cloud-based solutions.


Experience with Databricks, AWS, Alteryx, or similar technologies is an advantage but not a requirement.

As a Person, You Are


Analytical and structured.
Business-oriented.
Collaborative.
Results-driven.
Comfortable working on complex data projects.
Curious about users’ needs.
Skilled at building relationships across the organization.


You enjoy dialogue and collaboration and are not afraid to engage directly with processes and the people who use the solutions you help develop.

Why should you apply?

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To


Transform complex operational data into decision-making insights.
Work at the intersection of technology and business.
Gain broad exposure across the organization.
Deliver tangible improvements through data and digitalization.
Collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders.
Contribute to the digital transformation of Drug Product Manufacturing.


In other words, you will have the opportunity to serve as the link between the data we collect and the decisions that drive the business forward.

About The Department

You will become part of Business Support in Drug Product Manufacturing Kalundborg.

DPM KA consists of approximately 570 employees responsible for transforming active pharmaceutical ingredients into finished medicines for patients around the world. The production area includes environmental monitoring, washing and sterilization, formulation, aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and visual inspection.

Business Support functions as a cross-functional support organization across the department. The team collaborates with many different stakeholders and supports operations, digitalization, and continuous improvement initiatives. This gives you a broad range of interfaces and the opportunity to work across a variety of processes and professional disciplines.

Practical Information

Start date: As soon as possible, and no later than November 1

Duration: 12 months, with the possibility of extension

Employment is subject to a background check and criminal record certificate

Salary: For this position, the annual base salary ranges between DKK 499,600 and DKK 734,400, depending on the position level. Placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s competencies, qualifications, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Bonus and employee benefits: The compensation package may include short-term and/or long-term incentive schemes as well as additional employee benefits, depending on job level, geographical location, professional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

For further information, please contact Sr. Manager Kenneth Normand at +45 34480982 or knod@novonordisk.com

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Place: Glostrup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Do you thrive on turning complex data into strategic decisions and tangible business impact?

At Verisure, we are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded professional who is passionate about transforming data into insights, recommendations, and measurable business outcomes.

In this high-impact role, you will work closely with the Portfolio Marketing Director and the wider leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor on key commercial initiatives across customer retention, pricing, portfolio performance, growth, and operational improvement.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious analyst, consultant, or strategy professional who wants to move beyond analysis and play a direct role in shaping business decisions and driving results.

About The Role

As our Strategy & Performance Manager, you will be a key member of the Portfolio team and play a critical role in supporting strategic decision-making across the business.

You will develop insights from large and complex datasets, create executive-level recommendations, and help drive initiatives from ideas through implementation. The role offers significant exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to influence some of Verisure's most important commercial priorities.

Key Responsibilities


Lead advanced commercial and quantitative analyses across customer, pricing, sales, retention, and performance data
Translate complex datasets into actionable business insights and strategic recommendations
Develop business cases, decision materials, and executive presentations for senior leadership
Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards, KPIs, reporting solutions, and analytical tools in Power BI and Excel
Develop and maintain data models, measures, and performance tracking frameworks
Partner with stakeholders across commercial, operational, finance, and customer functions to improve business performance


About You

You are curious, commercially aware, and motivated by solving complex business challenges through data. You combine strong analytical capabilities with the ability to communicate clearly and influence decision-making.

We Imagine That You


Have 3-6 years of experience in strategy consulting, business analytics, commercial strategy, transaction services, audit, or a similar analytical environment
Have advanced capabilities in Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint
Are experienced in data modelling, reporting, and performance analysis
Have excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience engaging with senior stakeholders
Thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment
Experience within subscription-based businesses, telecom, utilities, SaaS, recurring-revenue models, customer retention, pricing, or AI-driven analytics will be considered an advantage.


Why Join Verisure?

At Verisure, you will join a market-leading and fast-growing international company where data and commercial insights play a central role in driving continued success.

We Offer


A high-visibility role with close collaboration with senior leadership
The opportunity to influence strategic decisions and business performance
Significant ownership and autonomy from day one
Exposure to a broad range of commercial and strategic initiatives
Strong development and career growth opportunities
A collaborative, ambitious, and high-performing culture

At Verisure, we protect what matters most. As Europe's leading provider of professionally monitored security solutions, we help create peace of mind for millions of customers across Europe and Latin America.

Title: Data Management Consultant
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & Technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include


Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.
Structuring and collection of data from various sources.
Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.
Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.
Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.


About You

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:


ETL and Database technologies.
Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.
Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Title: Senior Business-oriented Data Analytics Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about translating data into actionable insights? Do you have experience within Data & Analytics?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Senior Business-oriented Data Analytics Engineer.




Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.




We are seeking a passionate Senior Business-oriented Data Analytics Engineer to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in being the trusted partner to business stakeholders to enable data-driven decision-making across Drug Development Domain. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborating with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining the Drug Development Data Domain (4D) team consisting of 3 colleagues, and report directly to People Leader in Global IT, Babak Bajelan and Global Head of Digitalization, Ivanna Rosendal who are based in Hellerup, Denmark. You will be based in Hellerup, Denmark.




Your key responsibilities will be:

Understand business needs and translate them into data solutions
Design & develop data products that drive business value and decisions
Explore and transform complex data into insights with fit-for-purpose analytics
Collaborate across teams to build end-to-end solutions

Title: Senior Performance Intelligence Manager
Place: Humlebæk, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you an analytical and technically strong performance manager who can translate complex R&D data into decision-ready insights? Do you have experience designing performance frameworks, KPI architectures, and portfolio intelligence capabilities that help senior leaders prioritize investments, strengthen business performance, and maximize innovation value?

Join our PMO, Innovation Portfolio Management within R&D Chronic Care organisation

Coloplast has a long history of developing innovative products that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will join the PMO department within the R&D Innovation Portfolio Management organization, where we drive portfolio management and execution across the innovation portfolio, enable strategy deployment, and advance performance management across the R&D organization.

As Senior Performance Intelligence Manager, you will play a key role in establishing a trusted performance management system across R&D. You will create a single source of truth for portfolio, functional, and organizational performance, enabling leaders across the organization to make better business decisions, strengthen business performance, and maximize the value delivered through innovation investments. Through KPI frameworks, dashboards, analytics, and performance insights, you will help leaders to drive continuous performance improvement across both the Innovation Value Stream portfolio and the wider R&D organization, ensuring leaders have the insights needed to improve outcomes, productivity, and value delivery

Turn performance insights into better R&D decisions

In this role, you move beyond traditional reporting. You will help build the performance foundation that gives R&D leadership one trusted view of performance and portfolio progress, risk and value — so they can act with confidence.

Your key responsibilities include:


Develop and maintain performance management framework and KPI matrix used to track value creation across the IVS portfolio and R&D organisation.
Design and build the Power BI data model, dashboards and reporting logic, from architecture through to visual design
Establish one trusted source of truth for portfolio, business and value performance, supporting better decisions and performance improvement across R&D and the Innovation Value Stream
Create one integrated portfolio view of milestones, cost, risk and value across programs and projects
Turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support value-optimising decisions for senior leadership
Work closely with Finance, R&D and IVS stakeholders to provide insights and analytical support that help leaders improve business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and make better business decisions
Develop and run value realization tracking, ensuring initiatives deliver against the impact they promised
Support portfolio scenario design and decision preparation with fact-based analysis
Apply hands-on BI, AI, data and analytics capabilities to improve reporting quality, automation and insight generation




Turn complexity into clear insights and recommendations

First and foremost, you are an analytical, technically strong performance manager who builds dashboards people actually trust. When you present a number, stakeholders don't question whether it's right — they ask what it means for the decision ahead.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy creating structure where complexity exists. You turn fragmented information into insights that leaders can act on, and you're motivated by building performance management practices that create real business value.

You combine business understanding with solid hands-on BI, data and analytics experience. You are comfortable working with data models, dashboards, reporting logic and performance metrics — and you can translate technical complexity into clear insights for senior stakeholders.

What you bring:


Minimum 5 years of experience in performance management, strategic PMO, portfolio management, business performance, or analytics-driven decision support
Master’s degree in business, Finance, Engineering, Data/Analytics, Life Science, Technology or equivalent
Strong experience designing performance management frameworks, KPI architectures, dashboards, and decision-support capabilities in a project, program, or portfolio environment.
Solid hands-on technical experience building and developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modelling, reporting logic and visual design - this is a core, hands-on part of the role
Experience supporting portfolio scenario design, trade-off discussions and fact-based decision-making
Strong stakeholder management skills and a proactive, solution-oriented approach
Experience from R&D, medical devices, pharma, life science or another regulated industry — this is an advantage
Communicate effortlessly in written and spoken English




Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Anna Revva, Head of PMO, R&D Innovation Portfolio Management at dkanre@coloplast.com.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.
